About The Company

At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder.

Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world.

The Opportunity

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer will own the reliability and evolution of the company’s data and analytics infrastructure, including data models, the warehouse, pipelines, integrations, and billing data. This role moves beyond reporting into data modeling, analytics architecture, instrumentation strategy, and cross-functional enablement. The person will independently identify opportunities, translate ambiguous business needs into clear analytics initiatives, and drive those initiatives from definition through implementation and adoption.

This individual will serve as the technical bridge between raw data and business decision-making, leading the design of robust data models, optimizing SaaS metrics, and ensuring accurate tracking across web and native applications. Success in this role requires ownership of both technical quality and business outcomes.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. The person is expected to demonstrate leadership through initiative ownership, sound judgment, proactive communication, and cross-functional influence. People management is not currently a requirement.

Responsibilities

Analytics Architecture & Data Modeling

• Design, build, and maintain scalable analytics data models to support business reporting and decision-making.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations.

• Own source-of-truth definitions and reconcile data across application, billing, and analytics systems.

•

• Own the structure and optimization of SaaS metrics, including subscription lifecycle, billing, churn, retention, LTV, and revenue analytics (Stripe).

• Ensure data integrity, consistency, and governance across systems.

• Monitor data flows and proactively detect, troubleshoot, and recover from pipeline failures or missing data.

• Partner with Engineering to assess the data impact of product releases and prevent breaking changes to collection systems.

Instrumentation & Event Tracking

• Define tracking specifications and lead the auditing and validation of event strategy across web and native applications in partnership with Engineering.

• Partner with engineering and product teams to define, implement, and audit tracking standards.

• Improve reliability and completeness of user event data (Segment, Mixpanel, or similar tools).

Data Analysis & Insights

• Perform advanced analysis using SQL and Python to generate actionable insights.

• Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities within SaaS performance metrics.

• Translate complex datasets into clear business recommendations for leadership.

Analytics Platform Ownership

• Build and continuously improve the company’s analytics framework and reporting ecosystem.

• Develop dashboards and data visualization assets that provide reliable, self-serve insights for stakeholders.

• Optimize data pipelines and queries for performance and scalability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Lead cross-functional analytics initiatives by aligning Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Finance on the business problem, requirements, KPIs, measurement approach, milestones, and expected outcomes.

• Act as the subject-matter expert in analytics and data interpretation across the organization.

• Proactively surface relevant trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide leadership with clear recommendations and forecasting support.

Initiative Leadership & Ownership

• Independently identify and prioritize analytics opportunities aligned with business needs.

• Lead analytics initiatives from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.

• Establish clear scope, milestones, success criteria, and ownership for assigned initiatives.

• Proactively communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed to the manager and relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, analytics, or related data-focused roles, preferably in a SaaS environment, including demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong proficiency in SQL (advanced querying, modeling, performance optimization).

• Experience using Python for data analysis and automation.

• Experience designing, building, and maintaining databases, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integrations across multiple business systems.

• Experience with cloud data infrastructure; AWS experience is preferred.

• Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (MRR, churn, CAC, LTV, retention cohorts, subscription analytics).

Nice to Have

• Experience with Amplitude or comparable product analytics tools.

• Experience working with SaaS subscription and billing data, including Stripe.

• Experience with data visualization platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

• Experience partnering with Engineering on instrumentation and data-impacting product releases.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Self-sufficiency and sound judgment.

• Fast learning and adaptability.

• Proactivity and a willingness to identify and solve problems without waiting for detailed direction.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate proactively, manage stakeholder expectations, surface risks and tradeoffs, and translate technical findings into business impact.

• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with ambiguity, establish direction, and move initiatives forward without requiring detailed day-to-day guidance.

Compensation: USD $5,200–$6,000 per month, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

Benefits

• 15 days of paid time off in your first year, increasing to 20 days in your second year, covering vacation, personal time, and sick leave.

• Paid company-observed U.S. holidays.

• Reimbursement of up to USD $125 per month toward your own medical coverage.

Location: Remote — Latin America. Candidates must be available to work with substantial overlap during standard U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

postings.title: Analista Funcional de Inteligencia Artificial
postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Estamos buscando Analista Funcional de Inteligencia Artificial (Semi Senior)

¿Te interesa ser el puente entre el negocio y la tecnología para llevar la IA a casos de uso reales? Sumate a Industrias Juan F. Secco en el área de Datos y Ciberseguridad .

🎯 El rol

Vas a relevar y analizar las necesidades de las áreas de negocio, evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada caso de uso de IA (generativa y predictiva, on-premise o en la nube) y traducirlos en definiciones funcionales claras para los equipos de Arquitectura, Ingeniería y Datos. Acompañarás cada solución desde la idea hasta su adopción, para que resuelva el problema de negocio y genere el valor esperado.

🧩 Tus principales responsabilidades

• Relevar y documentar requerimientos con key users, e identificar oportunidades de mejora aptas para IA.

• Evaluar y priorizar casos de uso según impacto, calidad de datos, riesgo, esfuerzo y madurez tecnológica.

• Elaborar especificaciones funcionales historias de usuario, reglas de negocio, criterios de aceptación y métricas de éxito.

• Definir con el negocio los criterios de evaluación de las soluciones y coordinar las pruebas de aceptación (UAT).

• Acompañar el ciclo de vida de cada solución (PoC, piloto, producción y mejora continua) y gestionar el backlog funcional.

• Validar con los dueños del dato las fuentes, su significado de negocio y su calidad.

• Comunicar en lenguaje de negocio los alcances, limitaciones y riesgos de la IA (sesgos, respuestas incorrectas, dependencia de datos).

• Trabajar con Gobernanza, Seguridad y Legal para incorporar privacidad, trazabilidad, ética y supervisión humana.

• Impulsar la adopción y la gestión del cambio capacitación, material de apoyo y medición de KPIs.

• Mantener actualizado el catálogo de casos de uso de IA de la organización.

Requisitos

• Título en Sistemas, Informática, Ciencias de la Computación, Ciencia de Datos, Inteligencia Artificial o carreras afines.

• Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia en análisis funcional o de negocio en proyectos de sistemas (ERP, BI/analítica), consultoría funcional o proyectos de datos y automatización, con interacción directa con usuarios clave.

• Inglés intermedio.

• Relevamiento y especificación de requerimientos (entrevistas, talleres, historias de usuario, casos de uso y criterios de aceptación).

• Modelado de procesos (BPMN) y análisis de brechas as-is / to-be.

• Conocimiento conceptual de IA generativa y predictiva LLMs, RAG, agentes, aprendizaje supervisado y no supervisado, y sus limitaciones (alucinaciones, sesgos, deriva de datos).

• Nociones del ciclo de vida de proyectos de datos y ML (CRISP-DM, MLOps) y de métricas de evaluación de modelos a nivel funcional.

• SQL básico-intermedio y lectura de datos de sistemas transaccionales (ERP).

• Metodologías ágiles (Scrum / Kanban) y gestión de backlog.

• Nociones de despliegue on-premise vs. cloud, y de gobierno y riesgo de IA (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act).

• Formacion Academica Finalizada preferentemente

Carreras a fines Sistemas, Informática, Ciencia de Datos, Ciencias de la Computación, Inteligencia Artificial.

Somos una empresa argentina con más de 80 años de trayectoria ofreciendo soluciones integrales. Contamos con cuatro unidades de negocio

Generación de Energía

Producción Industrial

Equipos para Movimiento de Materiales

postings.title: Data Engineer Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com

We are seeking a Data Engineer Analyst to contribute to our next level of growth and expansion.

Job Description

What is this position about?

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion frameworks supporting batch processing, streaming, and change data capture (CDC) patterns.

• Develop and optimize data processing workflows using Apache Spark and PySpark, ensuring reliable and performant transformation across large datasets.

• Implement and manage data lake architectures on AWS, leveraging S3 as the primary storage layer and Apache Iceberg for table format management, schema evolution, and time-travel capabilities.

• Work with AWS-native services including Glue for ETL orchestration, Athena for serverless querying, and Lambda for event-driven data processing.

• Manage data access controls and security configurations using AWS IAM, ensuring compliant and least-privilege access across the data platform.

• Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and platform engineers to understand data requirements and deliver production-ready solutions.

• Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot data quality issues, and implement improvements to ensure data reliability and freshness.

• Contribute to the documentation of data flows, architecture decisions, and engineering standards within the team.

Qualifications

• Advanced hands-on experience with AWS services, including:
• AWS Glue

• Amazon S3

• Amazon Athena

• AWS IAM

• Apache Spark / PySpark for data processing.

• Data lake architectures, ideally with knowledge of Apache Iceberg.

• Data ingestion patterns, including batch processing, streaming, and CDC patterns

• Experience with SQL for data querying, validation, and exploratory analysis

• Solid understanding of data modeling and large-scale data processing

• Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code or pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Step Functions, dbt) is a plus.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and engineering productivity tools

What about languages?

English: Advanced (required for effective communication with global teams)

How much experience must I have?

2+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles, with hands-on work building and maintaining cloud-based data pipelines and lake architectures on AWS.

Additional Information

Our Perks and Benefits:

📚 Learning Opportunities:

• Certifications in AWS (we are AWS Partners), Databricks, and Snowflake.

• Access to AI learning paths to stay up to date with the latest technologies.

• Study plans, courses, and additional certifications tailored to your role.

• Access to Udemy Business, offering thousands of courses to boost your technical and soft skills.

• English lessons to support your professional communication.

👨🏽‍💻 Travel opportunities to attend industry conferences and meet clients.

👩‍🏫 Mentoring and Development:

• Career development plans and mentorship programs to help shape your path.

🎁 Celebrations & Support:

• Special day rewards to celebrate birthdays, work anniversaries, and other personal milestones.

• Company-provided equipment.

⚖️ Flexible working options to help you strike the right balance.

Other benefits may vary according to your location in LATAM. For detailed information regarding the benefits applicable to your specific location, please consult with one of our recruiters.

postings.descriptionText:
Somos una empresa líder global de soluciones logísticas, en continuo crecimiento. Con una sólida trayectoria de más de 40 años, en cada operación reafirmamos nuestra capacidad de evolucionar e innovar, desarrollando servicios orientados a impactar positivamente en la vida de las personas, brindando soluciones cuándo y dónde se necesiten.

Somos el aliado estratégico de nuestros clientes, impulsando el crecimiento y desarrollo de sus operaciones comerciales. Adaptamos nuestros servicios para cumplir con las exigencias específicas de diferentes industrias, asegurando que nuestros clientes puedan operar de manera eficiente y competitiva en un mercado en constante cambio.

Estamos comprometidos con seguir innovando, manteniendo nuestro enfoque en ofrecer calidad y confiabilidad para satisfacer las necesidades de las empresas que confían en nosotros.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Administrador de Salesforce bajo nuestra Gerencia de Planeamiento Comercial y Marketing .

Te compartimos más información debajo:

MISION DE LA POSICIÓN
Impulsar el uso estratégico de Salesforce y los datos para mejorar la generación, segmentación y seguimiento de oportunidades comerciales. Además, el puesto busca colaborar en la toma de decisiones basadas en datos, proporcionando análisis, automatización e insights clave para las áreas de marketing, ventas y desarrollo de negocio.

PRINCIPALES TAREAS

• Administrar, configurar y mantener la plataforma Salesforce (Sales/Marketing Cloud) como herramienta central de gestión comercial.

• Analizar datos de Salesforce y de otras fuentes, como SAP, Power BI y Excel.

• Diseñar, construir y mantener reportes y dashboards para los equipos comerciales, de marketing y otros sectores de la compañía que utilicen el CRM.

• Asegurar la calidad y consistencia de los datos dentro del CRM.

• Identificar oportunidades de automatización y mejora en los procesos comerciales.

• Analizar el rendimiento de las campañas, la generación de leads y la evolución del embudo comercial.

• Participar en proyectos de segmentación, scoring y generación de audiencias.

• Colaborar con equipos de tecnología y ventas para implementar nuevas funcionalidades o integraciones en Salesforce.

• Capacitar a usuarios internos en el uso eficiente del CRM y los reportes generados.

REQUISITOS
Experiencia previa en administración o análisis con Salesforce (excluyente).
Manejo avanzado de Excel.
Conocimientos en Power BI o herramientas de visualización de datos similares.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Conocimientos en SQL (deseable).
Experiencia en herramientas ETL o de integración de datos (deseable).

SE OFRECE

• Contratación directa : posición efectiva

• Medicina prepaga para colaborador y grupo familiar

• Desarrollar tu propia carrera en un ambiente cambiante y altamente desafiante

postings.title: Performance Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Remote position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

Avature is a large, highly configurable platform serving hundreds of client instances across multitenant environments, running on both on-premise and cloud infrastructure. As a Performance Analyst , you will investigate how that system behaves under real load: why a response time degraded, whether the infrastructure can absorb a planned campaign, where capacity is being wasted, and what a degradation in production is actually telling us. You will be one of the first people engineering turns to when something looks slow, and you will work with development, infrastructure and support teams to get to the root cause and a possible solution.

Your Challenges And Objectives

• Build a working model of our platform: its modules, services, and how they interact under load.

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code.

• Turn observations into evidence: use statistics to separate a real degradation from noise, and correlation from causation.

• Take on progressively more complex and more ambiguous problems as you grow in the role.

• Improve how we see the system: cross data sources, script your own analyses, automate what you repeat, and maintain the dashboards and tooling the team relies on.

Your Day-to-day Activities

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code, and hand your findings to the team that owns the fix.

• Analyze response times, throughput, and resource usage across logs, metrics, traces, and profiles, using statistics to separate a real degradation from noise and correlation from causation.

• Act as an entry point for engineering when a performance question appears, triaging it and connecting the right teams.

• Validate planned changes before they reach production: run performance tests with artificial load in dedicated environments, and confirm whether infrastructure and configuration can absorb limit extensions, bulk imports, go-lives, and campaigns.

• Work on capacity and cost efficiency: sizing rules, resource utilization, and where we are over- or under-provisioned.

• Plan preventive measures: take part in post-crisis procedures, learn from what went wrong, and think ahead about preventing issues rather than only diagnosing them.

About You

• You have a background in STEM, or equivalent practical experience.

• You are comfortable with statistics: distributions, percentiles, variance, correlation, and the difference between a real signal and noise.

• You have strong analytical skills, you are autonomous and curious, and you enjoy open-ended investigation more than well-defined tasks.

• You can reason about software systems without being a developer: how components interact, where time goes in a request, and what logs, metrics and dashboards tell you about what is actually happening.

• You can read code well enough to follow a call path and understand what it does.

• Intermediate oral and written English (B1), mainly for internal communication.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and genuinely interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About Us

Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What We Offer

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

postings.title: Senior FP&A - Fractional & Advisory
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.

Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.

The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.

We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.

About the role

We’re looking for a strong FP&A professional who enjoys working across different businesses, solving different problems, and partnering directly with founders and CFOs.

In this role, you’ll support multiple high-growth US companies and help them improve forecasting, modeling, cash planning, management reporting, and strategic decision-making.

This is especially suited to someone who enjoys variety, can switch contexts quickly, and is comfortable building trusted relationships with multiple stakeholders.

What you’ll own

• Build and maintain financial models, budgets, and rolling forecasts across multiple companies

• Own or support cash-flow forecasting, working-capital analysis, and scenario planning

• Review monthly performance and explain the key drivers behind variances

• Build management reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and decision-ready analysis

• Work directly with founders, CFOs, and senior business leaders

• Translate different business models into financial assumptions and forecasts

• Manage priorities across multiple companies at the same time

• Help clients improve planning, reporting, and finance processes

• Support strategic decisions around growth, hiring, pricing, investment, and cash management

• Bring structure and clarity to businesses that may still be building out their finance function

Must-haves

• 5+ years of finance experience, with meaningful FP&A or strategic finance exposure

• Strong budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling skills

• True multi-client, portfolio, advisory, or consulting exposure

• Experience working across multiple companies or business units at the same time

• Strong cash-flow and working-capital understanding

• Comfortable working directly with founders, CFOs, or senior leaders

• Strong communication and stakeholder management

• Excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• Fractional CFO, outsourced CFO, finance advisory, or consulting background

• Experience with startups, SMBs, or high-growth companies

• SaaS, DTC/eCommerce, CPG, retail, consumer, or marketplace exposure

• Experience building models from scratch

• Process improvement, automation, or finance transformation experience

• Board, investor, or fundraising support experience

Why this role is exciting

You’ll get broader exposure than a traditional in-house FP&A role, work across several business models, and build strong client-facing and strategic finance experience — a great step toward senior advisory, Finance Lead, or Fractional CFO opportunities.

Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.

Why we’re opening this role

We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.

• Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.

• Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.

• Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.

• Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.

• Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead and new team members.

Requirements

• Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.

• Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).

• End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.

• Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.

• AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.

• Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.

Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.

Location
Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.

Benefits

• 100% remote work, forever.

• Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.

• Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.

• Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

• Parental leave and flexible support.

• A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

How we hire

A focused process : application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

🔎 Important Notice: All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (e.g., Instagram, Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.

Acerca del Puesto

Como Customer Engagement Lead Immunology DA serás responsable de enfocarte exclusivamente en el relacionamiento con los clientes a nivel país. Somos una empresa biofarmacéutica impulsada por I+D y potenciada por IA, comprometida con mejorar la vida de las personas y entregar un crecimiento convincente. Nuestro profundo entendimiento del sistema inmunológico y pipeline innovador, nos permite inventar medicinas y vacunas que tratan y protegen a millones de personas alrededor del mundo. Acerca de Ti

Experiencia

• Experiencia en transformación digital, IA y analítica de datos aplicadas a la experiencia del cliente.

• Experiencia con gestión de proyectos ágiles y liderazgo de equipos multifuncionales.

• Dominio digital y metodologías modernas: Conocimiento de herramientas digitales de relacionamiento, aplicación de IA para personalizar interacciones, y manejo de metodologías como Agile, Scrum, Lean Startup, Nudge y Design Thinking.

Educación: Título profesional universitario en Marketing, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

Por Qué Elegirnos

Persigue el Progreso. Descubre lo Extraordinario.

Únete a Sanofi y entra en una nueva era de la ciencia - donde tu crecimiento puede ser tan transformador como el trabajo que hacemos. Invertimos en ti para llegar más lejos, pensar más rápido, y hacer lo que nunca se ha hecho antes.

Ayudarás a empujar límites, desafiar convenciones, y construir soluciones más inteligentes que lleguen a las comunidades que servimos. ¿Listo para perseguir los milagros de la ciencia y mejorar la vida de las personas? Persigamos el Progreso y Descubramos lo Extraordinario – juntos.

postings.title: Account Manager - E-commerce Marketing Agency
postings.descriptionText:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client's marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers' Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients' marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers' Associates to ensure that your assigned clients' marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

• Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well

• Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing

• Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you'll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)

• Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met

• Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients

• Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly

• Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients

• Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients

• Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers' demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly

• Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue

• Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director

• Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients' satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team

• Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision

• Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers

• Participating in the Account Managers' group calls

• Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise

• Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing

• Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building

• Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner

• Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers' Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director

• Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments

• Directly reporting to the Account Managers' Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

• Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours

• An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently

• Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD

• Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement

• Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)

• Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)

• Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

• Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers' Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

• At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)

• A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients

• Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards

• Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines

• Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries

• Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism

• Any remote work experience is a major advantage

• Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department

• Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues

• Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency

• Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus

• Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)

• Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)

• Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (i.e, 140 hours per month)

• Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language

• Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

postings.title: Consumer Insight & Sensory Manager - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos un Gerente de Consumer Insights y Análisis Sensorial altamente motivado para transformar el conocimiento del consumidor, la ciencia sensorial y la inteligencia de mercado en oportunidades de negocio que impulsen la innovación, el compromiso de los clientes y el crecimiento sostenible.

Este puesto liderará las actividades de Consumer Insights y Análisis Sensorial mediante la generación de inteligencia accionable, asegurando que las decisiones comerciales, de innovación y de negocio estén respaldadas por evidencia sólida del consumidor. Actuará como socio estratégico de los equipos Comercial, Marketing, Creación, Aplicación e Innovación, conectando las necesidades de los consumidores con oportunidades de desarrollo de productos y el éxito de los clientes.

La persona promoverá una cultura centrada en el consumidor, impulsará la excelencia en investigación del consumidor y ciencia sensorial, y desarrollará capacidades que fortalezcan la habilidad de la organización para ofrecer soluciones ganadoras a clientes y consumidores.

En dsm-firmenich, las personas están en el centro de la empresa. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades laborales y valoramos la diversidad en el lugar de trabajo.

Tus principales responsabilidades

• Liderar e implementar estrategias de Análisis Sensorial y Consumer Insights alineadas con los objetivos del negocio, las prioridades de innovación y las oportunidades de mercado.

• Diseñar, gestionar y supervisar programas de evaluación sensorial e investigación del consumidor, garantizando rigor científico, excelencia metodológica e insights accionables.

• Impulsar la excelencia sensorial mediante el desarrollo de metodologías, la gestión de paneles, programas de capacitación y prácticas estandarizadas de evaluación.

• Traducir datos sensoriales, preferencias de consumidores y tendencias de mercado en recomendaciones estratégicas que apoyen el desarrollo de productos, la innovación y la comercialización.

• Colaborar con los equipos Comercial, Marketing, Creación, Aplicación e Innovación, aportando experiencia sensorial e insights del consumidor para fortalecer la relación con clientes y el crecimiento del negocio.

• Garantizar la calidad, consistencia y mejora continua de las actividades de investigación sensorial y del consumidor, gestionando recursos, socios externos y la alineación con estándares regionales y globales.

Lo que ofrecemos

• Una rica historia y un futuro prometedor de innovación científica audaz y creación apasionada junto con nuestros clientes;

• Un espacio para crecer que fomenta y apoya la curiosidad y una mentalidad abierta;

• Una cultura que prioriza la seguridad y el bienestar, tanto físico como mental;

• La oportunidad de trabajar en una empresa donde la sostenibilidad es mucho más que una declaración y constituye el centro de nuestra estrategia y propósito;

• Un entorno laboral flexible que permite a las personas asumir la responsabilidad por su trabajo y sus resultados;

• Comunidades sin barreras dentro de nuestra organización, donde cada persona es igualmente valorada y respetada, independientemente de su origen, creencias o identidad;

Lo que aportarás

• Título universitario en Ciencia de los Alimentos, Ingeniería de Alimentos, Ingeniería Química, Psicología, Marketing, Investigación de Mercado o áreas relacionadas.

• Dominio avanzado del inglés.

• Experiencia sólida en Ciencia Sensorial, Consumer Insights e Investigación de Mercado, preferentemente en las industrias de alimentos, bebidas, ingredientes, sabores o bienes de consumo.

• Conocimiento sólido de metodologías de evaluación sensorial, investigación cualitativa y cuantitativa y análisis estadístico.

• Experiencia comprobada en gestión de proyectos, liderazgo de equipos y colaboración multifuncional, con capacidad para influir en stakeholders clave.

• Sólidas habilidades analíticas, de comunicación y storytelling, con capacidad para transformar datos sensoriales y del consumidor en recomendaciones de negocio accionables.

En dsm-firmenich, estamos plenamente comprometidos con la inclusión, porque cuando las personas se sienten involucradas y empoderadas, su creatividad e innovación impulsan un progreso sin precedentes. Nuestro objetivo es construir un lugar de trabajo donde las oportunidades sean verdaderamente iguales para que todas las personas puedan prosperar. No discriminamos: hay un lugar para todos en dsm-firmenich.

En dsm-firmenich, somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y aplica acciones afirmativas. Nuestra gente es tan diversa como nuestros clientes. Para nosotros, esto incluye el compromiso de garantizar igualdad de oportunidades laborales para todos los candidatos y empleados. Las decisiones laborales se basan en motivos relacionados con el puesto, independientemente de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, nacionalidad, discapacidad, estado civil, información genética, condición de veterano protegido o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

Nos comprometemos a brindar apoyo razonable a las personas con discapacidad durante todo nuestro proceso de selección. Si necesita ayuda y se siente cómodo compartiéndolo, háganoslo saber.

Acerca de dsm-firmenich

Como innovadores en nutrición, salud y belleza, dsm-firmenich reinventa, fabrica y combina nutrientes vitales, sabores y fragancias para una población mundial en crecimiento. Con nuestra amplia gama de soluciones, ingredientes naturales y renovables, y reconocidas capacidades científicas y tecnológicas, trabajamos para crear lo que es esencial para la vida, deseable para los consumidores y más sostenible para el planeta. dsm-firmenich es una empresa suizo-neerlandesa que cotiza en Euronext Ámsterdam, con operaciones en cerca de 60 países e ingresos superiores a 12.000 millones de euros. Con un equipo global y diverso de casi 30.000 empleados, damos vida al progreso todos los días, en todas partes, para miles de millones de personas."

Santo Domingo, DO

ADMISSIONS MANAGER

Job Description

LOCATION Saint George School – Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

JOB PURPOSE: As a key member of the Marketing, Admissions & Communications (MAC) team, the Admissions Manager is responsible for driving student enrolment by ensuring that both prospective and current families receive an exceptional experience at every stage of their journey with the school. The role contributes directly to the school’s growth strategy by strengthening market positioning, increasing enrolment, and supporting retention, while ensuring alignment with Nord Anglia Education standards.

REPORTING TO: Director of Marketing, Admissions & Communications

Internal

• Head of School

• Academic Dean

• Heads of Primary & Secondary

• Teaching & Administrative Staff

• MAC Team

External

postings.title: Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead
postings.descriptionText:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in Argentina.

As Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead, you will own the digital experience that turns visitors into customers and first-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers. You will lead website optimization, lifecycle marketing, email communication, and brand positioning across multiple product lines. Working closely with leadership, product, design, engineering, and marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into compelling messaging and measurable business outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, experiment with new ideas, and implement improvements from concept to execution. In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue. This is an opportunity for a hands-on marketing leader who combines analytical thinking, persuasive copywriting, and a strong sense of ownership to drive meaningful growth.

Accountabilities

• Website Strategy and Conversion Optimization: Own the structure, messaging, and conversion performance of the website and key product pages. Develop and execute A/B tests, collaborate with design and engineering teams, and implement improvements that increase conversion rates.

• Lifecycle Marketing: Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding, reorder triggers, retention campaigns, win-back initiatives, and repeat-purchase flows. Partner with the Head of Marketing to drive recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.

• Positioning and Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for each product line and customer segment. Maintain a consistent source of truth for messaging across the website, advertising, sales materials, and AI-powered sales tools.

• Email Marketing: Plan, write, launch, and optimize lifecycle and marketing email campaigns that support customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

• Customer Research and Insights: Gather insights from sales calls, customer conversations, and reviews, translating them into stronger messaging, improved web pages, and actionable experimentation opportunities.

• Performance Measurement and Reporting: Track and analyze business-critical metrics, including conversion rates, repeat revenue, repeat order value, and CRM performance. Use data to prioritize initiatives and demonstrate measurable impact.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership and relevant teams to influence product direction, improve customer workflows, and align marketing execution with broader business objectives.

Requirements

• Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience in B2B or e-commerce marketing, with hands-on ownership of website conversion optimization, messaging, lifecycle marketing, or email programs.

• Customer-Centric Copywriting: Demonstrated ability to create effective copy and landing pages grounded in customer research, market insights, and real-world feedback rather than assumptions.

• Lifecycle Marketing Expertise: Experience building and managing lifecycle or email marketing programs, with measurable results in revenue, activation, retention, or repeat purchases.

• Experimentation and Analytics: Solid understanding of A/B testing principles, including sample sizes, primary success metrics, and minimum detectable or practically meaningful effects. Ability to interpret results and make evidence-based decisions.

• End-to-End Ownership: Proven ability to take initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, testing, launch, and optimization, working independently with minimal supervision.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and develop persuasive messaging for different audiences.

• Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Strong business acumen, logical reasoning, and the ability to break down ambiguous challenges into practical, high-impact solutions.

• Accountability and Adaptability: A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, combined with the ability to respond quickly to constructive feedback, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.

• Preferred Qualifications: Experience with hybrid self-service and sales-led funnels; hands-on knowledge of CRM systems such as HubSpot or Pipedrive and email marketing platforms; experience developing prompts or knowledge bases for AI sales or support agents; and familiarity with custom manufacturing, branded merchandise, or print-on-demand businesses.

Benefits

• Competitive Compensation: A flexible, competitive compensation package tailored to the candidate's experience, capabilities, and expected impact.

• Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere globally, with flexible working hours and no requirement to report to a physical office.

• Full-Time Engagement: An exclusive, full-time independent contractor arrangement offering substantial responsibility and autonomy.

• Direct Leadership Exposure: Work closely with executive leadership, gaining visibility into strategic decisions and opportunities for professional development.

• Strategic Influence: Contribute directly to product development, customer experience improvements, business workflows, and company strategy.

• Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your domain, lead initiatives end to end, and make decisions with minimal bureaucracy.

• Growth Opportunities: Join a scaling business where you can expand your responsibilities, strengthen your expertise, and accelerate your professional growth.

• Flexible Work Environment: Collaborate with a distributed, international team in a results-oriented environment that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.

How Jobgether Works

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. postings.title: Creative Director
postings.descriptionText:
About JumpSeat

JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.

We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.

Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.

We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.

The role

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.

This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.

You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.

And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.

This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.

What You'll Do

Lead the department.

• Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.

• Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.

• Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.

• Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

Run the engine.

• Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.

• Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.

• Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.

• Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.

• Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

Raise the creative bar.

• Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.

• Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.

• Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.

• Oversee website design and development.

• Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.

• Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.

• Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

Shape How We Use AI.

• Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.

• Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?

• Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.

• Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

Who You Are

• A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.

• A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.

• A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.

• Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.

• A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.

• Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.

• Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.

• Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.

• A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

Nice to have

• Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.

• B2B experience. Helpful, not required.

• You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

How We'll Get To Know You

• A conversation with our Talent team.

• A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.

• A conversation with senior team members.

What's In It For You

• Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.

• Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.

• Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.

• Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

Ready to take the seat?

If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale our Commercial Partners Programme in Southern Latam — bringing together resellers, systems integrators, and consulting firms who help deploy ElevenLabs' technology to their clients across the Southern Latam market.

You'll own the reseller, integrator, and consulting partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs, consultancies, and resellers, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design and pilot partner incentive and enablement models, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against regional growth targets, while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–9 Months)

• Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through GSIs, RSIs, cloud providers, VARs, and technology partners reaching at least 20% of regional revenue

• Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise opportunities in target industries

• Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

• Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

• Strategic Account Penetration: new enterprise accounts and executive relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

• 12+ years building and scaling an in-country SaaS/Cloud solution, with a strong network you can leverage from day one

• 4+ years owning RSI, GSI, and hyperscaler partnerships, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell, and revenue — not just relationship management

• A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

• Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and customers

• Based in Buenos Aires

Bonus: Mix of 3-4 years in sales + 3-4 years in partnerships/alliances; mix of 3-4 years at a large company + 3-4 years at a smaller/less established company

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

postings.title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Department: Creative

Location: Argentina

Description

Why This Role Exists

This is a founding role — which means your ceiling is uncapped and your fingerprints will be on how an entire function works for years to come.

You'll own how CDM identifies, develops, and scales creative — video and static — built Paid Social–first , with support for our Paid Search team, so our clients grow faster than their competitors can copy them.

Here's the bet we're making: creative is the most durable lever in performance marketing. Budgets, algorithms, audiences, and targeting all converge over time — everyone eventually gets access to the same tools. The creative is what still separates the winners from everyone else. CDM believes the agencies that dominate the next decade will be the ones that treat creative strategy as a rigorous, repeatable discipline instead of a guessing game.

You will be the person who builds that discipline here.

Key Responsibilities

Who We Are

Clever Digital Marketing is a performance marketing agency helping large home improvement companies across the US and Canada grow through Paid Social, Paid Search, CRO, and strategic advising.

We manage a large portfolio of accounts, an in-house creative team, and significant monthly ad spend. As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What You'll Own

This is a senior, strategic role. You won't be editing every asset or running campaigns day-to-day. Your job is to raise the quality of the thinking, research, and strategy behind everything we produce and test.

• Generate net-new creative. Develop original concepts, messaging angles, hooks, formats, and storytelling approaches for video and static ads — not variations on the same three ideas.

• Find the ideas before you have them. Run customer, competitor, and market research to uncover motivations, objections, and pain points that haven't been explored yet. Mine reviews, sales calls, and customer feedback for the insight that makes an ad work.

• Turn performance into strategy. Analyze why creative wins or loses and translate it into clear next steps. Write sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, direct-response principles, and a defined testing hypothesis — and push iteration beyond surface-level hook and footage swaps.

• Build the system. Create CDM's creative-strategy frameworks, brief standards, testing processes, and a shared learning repository. Spot what's working in one account and determine where it can be adapted across others.

• Level up the whole team. Coach Media Buyers and editors so stronger creative thinking becomes a department-wide capability, not something that lives with one person. Partner with CRO to align messaging, personas, offers, and landing-page experiences. Provide direction for UGC, founder-led, and spokesperson-led formats.

• Use AI as a force multiplier. Build AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate research, ideation, and production for the entire team — more on that below.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in performance-focused creative strategy.

• Deep understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response creative.

• Strong direct-response copywriting and short-form storytelling skills.

• A track record of developing concepts from customer research and performance data — not just intuition.

• Fluency with creative metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and the judgment to weigh them against lead quality and down-funnel performance.

• Experience across multiple brands, accounts, or verticals.

• A structured approach to testing — hypotheses, iteration strategy, isolating variables.

• Demonstrated ability to build systems, processes, frameworks, or knowledge bases.

• Advanced, practical experience using AI for research, analysis, ideation, workflow design, or creative enablement.

• The ability to explain not just what you'd test, but how you found the opportunity and why you believe it will work.

• Strong communication, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• A bias for speed — you generate learning quickly without over-engineering every test.

What "AI-First" Means to Us

We are not looking for someone who asks AI to spit out scripts and hooks.

We're Looking For Someone Who Uses AI To

• Analyze customer reviews, calls, and feedback at scale.

• Identify creative patterns across many accounts at once.

• Build and maintain shared account context.

• Surface cross-account testing opportunities.

• Automate recurring creative research and reporting.

• Improve the speed and quality of briefs and production workflows.

• Build systems that help the whole team make better creative decisions.

You bring strong, independent creative judgment. AI is how you increase the depth, speed, and scale of that judgment. Familiarity with tools like Motion, Looker Studio, Asana, Slack, and Claude is a plus.

Nice to Have

• Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.

• Home improvement experience.

• CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.

• UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.

• Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

• CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.

• Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.

• Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.

• Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.

• AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.

• CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

• Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses

• Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)

• Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.

• Company-provided MacBook computer

• Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started

• Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!

• The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team

• A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be utilized during the interview or candidate evaluation process to support the fair and efficient screening, assessment, and selection of applicants.

Persona is a recruiting and staffing company that hires exceptional people from 98 countries into full-time, long-term remote roles with the most ambitious companies on earth.

Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises, fast-growing startups backed by Sequoia, Founders Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz, and high-performing companies of every size in between. We offer roles in project management, operations, finance, design, marketing, customer success, and more. Every hire is for a specific open position: one person, one dedicated client, built to last.

Every offer we make is for an open role with a single client — the kind of role that’s almost impossible to find on your own: industry-leading pay set against your experience and skill, real career growth, and a stable seat at a serious company, working from home, anywhere in the world.

Persona was founded in 2018 by two Stanford graduates on a simple idea: talent is everywhere, but opportunity isn’t. By recruiting globally for specific client roles, we’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing companies in the global staffing industry. Every applicant goes through the same steps, and each one is designed to let you show what you can actually do.

We hire people who care about the craft of their work, take ownership without being asked, and want to build a career rather than just hold a job. If that’s you, and one of our open roles fits, we’d like to meet you.

Role Summary
We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to manage a book of growing advertiser accounts at a performance-marketing / commerce-media company. You will own mid-market and test-stage accounts day to day ($10K-$20K pilots and steady monthly spenders) while supporting senior team members on the largest enterprise accounts. This role is hands-on and operational, built for someone who lives inside an Ads Manager, uses AI agents and SQL/Hex to pull performance data, and is the first person to notice when an account is overspending, underdelivering, or broken.
You must be technically comfortable — not an engineer, but able to set up a postback, test a tracking link, and explain to a client in plain language why their CPA moved. • Take new advertisers from signed IO to live in Ads Manager: campaigns, ad groups, targeting, offers, creatives, budgets, and CPA targets at the ad group level

Required Qualifications

• 2-4 years in customer success, account management, or campaign operations — ideally in performance marketing, affiliate, commerce media, or ad tech

• Fluent in performance metrics: CPC, CPA, CTR, CVR, pacing, and IO cap management are part of your everyday vocabulary

• Technically curious — you've worked with tracking links, pixels, or postbacks, or you can follow API and integration docs on your own

• Comfortable with daily account hygiene across many budgets, launches, and client threads simultaneously

• Strong written communication; can draft a concise client recap and explain a performance change without jargon

• AI-forward: already uses AI tools to work faster and wants to get better at it

• Proactive: flags problems early, asks for help when stakes are high, doesn't wait to be told to check an account

• Fully fluent in English

• Ability to work U.S. business hours (PT, CT, or ET)

• Ability to commit long-term and full-time

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with a mobile measurement partner / MMP (Singular, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust, Kochava)

• Direct experience with an affiliate or performance network (Impact, Rakuten Advertising, Pepperjam, Awin, CJ Affiliate, Partnerize)

• Working knowledge of SQL and notebook tools (Hex, Mode, Hex, Deepnote, Jupyter)

• Experience with mobile app install campaigns, DTC lead-gen, or app event optimization

• Prior experience at an ad network, affiliate network, DSP, or performance agency

Tools & Technologies

• Ads Manager platforms, Singular, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust, Kochava, Impact, Rakuten Advertising, Pepperjam, Awin, Hex, Mode, SQL, Looker, Google Analytics 4, Postman, Charles Proxy or Proxyman, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Claude, ChatGPT

Core Competencies

• Operator mindset; lives inside the Ads Manager

• Technically curious without needing to be an engineer

• Highly organized across many budgets, launches, and QA checks

• Proactive problem-solver; catches issues before clients do

• Clear communicator; translates performance moves into plain English

• AI-fluent and leverages tooling to move faster

• Calm under end-of-month pacing pressure

• Service-minded; makes clients confident in the numbers

What We Offer

• Best salaries in the industry

• work remotely from the location specified for this role permanently

• Opportunities for growth and advancement

• A warm, people-first company culture

This is a full-time, long-term remote position dedicated to one client company. Persona provides onboarding and ongoing employment support for this position.

Our client is a digital marketing agency that helps multi-location businesses with a physical presence turn strong in-person operations into online revenue. Its clients include med spas and aesthetics practices, clinics, OB/GYN practices, senior living communities, and dispensaries across the US and Canada. They usually have good operations and good reviews, and little online presence.

The agency is AI-native. It runs on Claude and on its own internal operating system and client portal. Anything digital is in scope, from search, SEO, and visibility in AI answers to websites, booking paths, reviews, social, paid media, branding, and fractional CMO support.

This role suits someone who wants the whole account rather than a single channel, and who's comfortable building parts of the process as they go. If you'd prefer to hand execution to a team once the plan is written, it probably isn't the right fit.

You'll

You Bring

Bonus Points
