postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

postings.title: Lead Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
About Belong
We didn't build a better property management company. We replaced the need for one.
Belong is the operating system for rental homeownership. One system that runs rent, maintenance, finances, residents, and visibility end to end. Not a person juggling disconnected tools. A system that gets smarter every single day, with every home we add.
We've survived Covid, the tech crash, and the toughest capital markets cycle in a generation. We are growing fast, we are AI-first, and we are building something that has never existed before.
Our 200+ Belongers are strong, curious, and unreasonably ambitious. If you want a passive role at a company that's okay with average, this is not it.
The Role
Belong needs an experienced accountant who combines technical depth, hands-on execution, and leadership in a lean team. You lead an automation-enabled close, work alongside teammates who own payroll and payables as well as receivables and collections, handle the complex entries and edge cases, and remain accountable for accurate, timely books and reporting.
As Lead Accountant, you are the day-to-day accounting lead for Belong's Buenos Aires finance team. You own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of the books and coordinate the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close across the Finance Operations Specialist, the AR & Collections Specialist, and our automated workflows.
Much of the recurring volume is automated or prepared by the team. You supervise those processes, review the work and exception queues, personally handle complex and non-recurring accounting, and make sure every material balance can be explained and supported.
This role combines full-cycle accounting, team leadership, and systems ownership. You define accounting treatment and review standards, preserve the audit trail, resolve issues that require judgment, and partner with our Finance Data Engineer to make the close faster and more reliable as Belong grows.
What You'll Own
Lead an Automation-Enabled Close
Own the close calendar and orchestrate a coordinated close across the finance team and automated processes. Set deadlines and account ownership, review team deliverables and system-generated outputs, personally prepare complex and non-recurring entries, resolve exceptions, and deliver an accurate, repeatable close on schedule.
Own the Balance Sheet
Set the reconciliation standard for every material balance-sheet account. Prepare the most complex reconciliations, review material reconciliations completed by the team, investigate differences, clear aged items, correct errors at the source, and ensure every balance is supported.
Produce Reporting That Explains the Business
Prepare monthly financial statements and budget-versus-actual reporting. Identify the drivers behind material variances, work directly with budget owners to understand them, and turn the close into a clear explanation of what happened, why it happened, and where action is needed.
Lead the Audit from Inside Belong
Lead Belong's side of the external audit. Organize and review PBC schedules and supporting documentation, respond directly to auditor questions, coordinate requests across the team and company, resolve accounting issues, and keep the books audit-ready throughout the year.
Lead the Team and Set the Accounting Standard
Serve as the day-to-day accounting lead for the Finance Operations Specialist and AR & Collections Specialist. Set priorities, review standards, and close responsibilities; provide practical guidance; and help the team grow. Apply US GAAP consistently and document policies, procedures, account ownership, and key controls.
Build a Better Finance Machine
Partner with our Finance Data Engineer to improve automated postings, transaction matching, reconciliations, and close workflows. Define the accounting logic, review thresholds, and exception rules; test the output; supervise the exception queue; and keep human judgment and a clear audit trail at the center of the process.
What We're Looking For
On Experience

• 5 to 9 years of progressive, full-cycle accounting experience, including substantial general-ledger and close ownership.

• Hands-on accounting experience in a venture-backed startup, scale-up, or similarly fast-growing company is required. You understand the pace, ambiguity, evolving systems, and incomplete processes that come with growth.

• A demonstrated record of leading a close in a lean team while personally owning complex journal entries, material reconciliations, schedules, and financial statements.

• Strong command of US GAAP, accrual accounting, cut-off, balance-sheet substantiation, and financial-statement preparation.

• Direct experience supporting or leading an external audit, including PBC schedules and auditor follow-up.

• Experience preparing budget-versus-actual reporting, working with non-finance budget owners, and coordinating the close work of a small accounting team.

• Strong accounting-systems experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage, or similar) and the ability to learn new workflows quickly.

• Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills. Complex formulas, pivots, lookups, tie-outs, and data validation are routine tools for you.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a Contador Público qualification. Experience supporting a US company or multi-entity environment is strongly preferred.

On Mindset

• You are an accountant who enjoys the work. You take satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, a close that ties, and finding the reason a number is wrong.

• You lead from the work. You stay close enough to the ledger, systems, and exceptions to understand the numbers firsthand while setting a clear standard for the team.

• You are a startup operator. You are energized by fast growth, evolving systems, shifting priorities, and the opportunity to build structure while keeping the business moving.

• You are precise and investigative. When an account does not reconcile, you keep going until you understand the difference and fix the underlying cause.

• You take ownership early. You surface risks before deadlines, drive follow-up with auditors and budget owners, and keep the team focused on the next action.

• You communicate clearly. You can explain an accounting conclusion to an auditor and a budget variance to an operating leader in direct, practical language.

• You are systems-minded. You use automation to remove repetitive work and create more time for judgment, investigation, and improvement.

• You are comfortable in an intense environment. You move quickly, maintain a high bar, and stay composed when the close, the audit, and an operating issue arrive at the same time.

Nice to Have

• Real estate, proptech, fintech, or marketplace experience.

Why This Role Matters
The person in this seat owns the accounting engine that lets Belong run as a system instead of a collection of manual processes. When the close ties on schedule instead of slipping into next month, that is this role. When an auditor's question gets a clear, well-supported answer instead of a scramble, that is this role. When a budget owner finally understands why a number moved, that is this role.
Every close, reconciliation, and financial statement delivered is a brand moment. Each one either strengthens confidence in the Belong OS, or weakens it. The decisions made in this role affect how fast Belong can close its books, how well it withstands audit scrutiny, and how much the business can trust its own numbers to make real operating decisions.
Why Belong
You get a front-row seat at a venture-backed company redefining one of the largest and most broken industries in America. This is a high-ownership role in our Buenos Aires office, working closely with teammates who solve problems in real time rather than across time zones and handoffs.

This role can grow into Assistant Controller as you deepen ownership of the close, controls, audit, and team, with longer-term potential to grow toward Controller as Belong scales. That path is available to anyone who builds the track record here.
We do not manage properties. We run an operating system. And the people who represent that system to the world are not just employees. They are Belongers.

Job Title: Financial Controller

Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: Mondays - Fridays 9:00 am - 5:00 pm EST

Salary: USD 2,000-2,500

Location: PH and Latin America

About The Company

We are an accounting technology company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Our comprehensive accounting services help start-ups and small businesses gain an operational advantage by providing operational bookkeeping, high-level accounting, financial modeling and forecasting, full-cycle accounting, and strategic financial consulting services.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Financial Controller to join our growing team at a company providing financial and accounting services to small/medium-sized businesses. In this role, you will manage bookkeeping staff, oversee all core accounting functions, support the month-end close, and work closely with the fractional CFO. You will be an essential part of the team as we continue to expand.

• Manage and supervise bookkeeping staff and oversee division of duties.

• Take full responsibility for accounts receivable (AR) and accounts payable (AP) management across multiple client accounts.

• Ensure comprehensive month-end close, including booking transactions, making adjusting journal entries, and preparing financial statements for review.

• Maintain proficiency in and day-to-day use of Ramp (AP platform) and QuickBooks Online.

• Provide reliable financial data for forecasting and support the fractional CFO with financial modeling (mainly Excel) and data entry when needed.

• Review and correct financials prior to CFO review, minimizing the need for additional adjustments.

• Participate in special projects as needed, including due diligence for fundraising or acquisition, and preparation for audits.

Qualifications

• At least 2-5 years of experience as a Controller

• Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting process management.

• Proficiency with QuickBooks Online required; Ramp experience preferred but not required.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience with financial reporting (P&L, Balance Sheet, Statement of Cash Flows).

• Willingness and ability to work US business hours.

• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and eager to learn; experience with due diligence or audit processes is a plus.

🚀 Litigation & Collections Paralegal Bilingüe | Remoto (100% Remote)

📍 Modalidad: 100% Remota

🕒 Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 10:00 a. m. a 8:00 p. m.

✈️ Requisito de viaje: Disponibilidad para viajar a los Estados Unidos cuando sea necesario. 🇺🇸 Visa de EE. UU.: Requerida

🌟 Descripción del Puesto

Asistente Legal Senior de Litigios y Cobranzas. Buscamos un asistente legal senior con experiencia para apoyar a nuestro equipo legal de Norteamérica en la gestión, recuperación y litigio de cuentas de clientes morosos. Este puesto requiere un profesional con experiencia práctica en procedimientos de litigio civil en Massachusetts, derechos de los acreedores, litigios de cuantía menor (*small claims*) y arbitraje comercial.

El candidato seleccionado desempeñará un papel clave en la gestión interna de litigios y apoyará al equipo legal en todas las fases de las actividades previas al litigio y del litigio en sí.

📋 Responsabilidades Clave
Litigios y Cobranzas Legales
• Revisar cuentas morosas derivadas por los equipos de Cuentas por Cobrar y Cobranzas.
• Analizar contratos, facturas, historial de pagos y documentación de respaldo para evaluar la viabilidad de iniciar acciones legales.
• Preparar estrategias de cobranza legal y recomendar los pasos a seguir.
• Monitorear los plazos de prescripción y los plazos procesales. Fase Pre-litigio
• Redactar cartas de requerimiento de pago y correspondencia de cobranza.
• Comunicarse con los deudores respecto a las obligaciones pendientes.
• Asistir en acuerdos, planes de pago y resoluciones negociadas.
• Preparar acuerdos de conciliación, declaraciones juradas (*affidavits*), documentos de liberación de responsabilidad y documentación legal relacionada. Litigios y Arbitraje

✅ Requisitos Obligatorios
• Minimo de 3 años de experiencia como Paralegal in commercial litigation, collections, creditors' rights, civil litigation, or a litigation-focused law firm (En Massachusetts, EE. UU.)
• Experiencia directa en procedimientos de litigio civil en Massachusetts.
• Visa estadounidense válida con capacidad para viajar a los Estados Unidos según sea necesario (Obligatorio)
•Nivel de inglés avanzado C1 (Obligatorio)
• Sólidos conocimientos sobre presentación de documentos judiciales, procedimientos legales, plazos y gestión de casos.
• Experiencia en la preparación de demandas, reclamaciones, mociones, declaraciones juradas, acuerdos de conciliación y documentos de litigio.

• Colaborar en el análisis de cuentas como facturas a recibir, gastos de importaciones y exportación, anticipos proveedores locales y del exterior, seguros a cobrar.

Beneficios

postings.descriptionText:
Requisition ID: 297085

• Relocation Authorized: None

• Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project

• Work Location: Buenos Aires

Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.

Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.

Country Overview

Argentina: Building Our Presence

Bechtel is building a strong local organization in Argentina, partnering with industry, government, suppliers, and communities to support our customers and projects. We’re bringing global expertise to develop local talent, strengthen regional capabilities, and deliver lasting value — establishing a trusted, long-term presence that supports sustainable growth and positions Argentina as a cornerstone market for mining, energy, and infrastructure development.

Job Summary

Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, this position is responsible for leading the Corporate Finance & Accounting function for a newly established Corporate Office. The role will ensure compliance with Bechtel policies and local statutory requirements while supporting the setup of processes, controls, and reporting.

This position will have an initial scoped but is expected to evolve in parallel with business growth, increasing in complexity, transaction volume, and leadership responsibilities, supporting progression toward a high level.

Major Responsibilities

• Leading Finance & Accounting activities for the Buenos Aires Corporate Office, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, taxes, cash management, and statutory reporting.

• Maintaining corporate and statutory accounting books ensuring accuracy and completeness.

• Preparing financial statements, trial balances, and supporting schedules. Performing and overseeing monthly reconciliations, including corporate vs. statutory records.

• Managing cash flow and prepare forecasts in coordination with Santiago office Cash Management group.

• Ensuring timely and accurate tax filings and statutory submissions. Coordinating with project teams and functions to resolve accounting issues.

• Providing financial analysis and management reporting. Acting as the primary accounting interface for the Argentina Corporate Office.

• Contributing to the establishment of a strong control environment aligned with Bechtel standards.

• Supporting the design and improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting procedures.

• Supporting and progressively lead audits, tax inspections, and compliance reviews.

• Providing recommendations on complex accounting, tax, and compliance matters.

• Participating in system implementations and process standardization initiatives.

• Supporting scaling of the accounting function, including onboarding and supervision of staff.

• Contributing to budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.

Education And Experience Requirements

• Requieres Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field with 7–10 years of relevant experience in accounting and statutory compliance.

• Professional certification (CPA or equivalent) or active Certified Public Accountant registration/licensure in the country of practice

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting. Experience with general ledger, reconciliations, and financial statements.

Required Knowledge And Skills

• Experience in multinational or project-based environments. Knowledge of Argentina tax and statutory framework.

• Experience supporting audits and regulatory interactions. Experience in process improvements or system implementations.

• Potential to assume expanded leadership responsibilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (e.g., Oracle).

• Fluency in Spanish and working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrate leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement. Communicate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Identify risks and propose solutions proactively. Ensure timely delivery and escalate issues early. Uphold Bechtel’s ethics and compliance standards.

Total Rewards/Benefits

For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards

Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary

As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.

We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.

Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Applicants with a disability, who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, may e-mail their request to acesstmt@bechtel.com.

Desde 1898, hemos ayudado a clientes a completar más de 25,000 proyectos en 160 países en los siete continentes que han creado empleos, hecho crecer economías, mejorado la resiliencia de la infraestructura mundial, aumentado el acceso a la energía, recursos y servicios vitales, y hecho del mundo un lugar más seguro y limpio.

Diferenciados por la calidad de nuestra gente y nuestro incansable impulso para ofrecer los resultados más exitosos, alineamos nuestras capacidades con los objetivos de nuestros clientes para crear un impacto positivo duradero. Nuestros Servicios abarcan desde la planificación e inversión inicial, hasta la puesta en marcha y operaciones.

El núcleo de Bechtel es nuestra Visión, Valores y Compromisos. Son lo que creemos, lo que los clientes pueden esperar y cómo cumplimos. Más información sobre nuestros equipos extraordinarios que crean proyectos inspiradores en nuestro Impact Report.

Perspectiva del País

Argentina Construyendo Nuestra Presencia

Bechtel está construyendo una organización local sólida en Argentina, asociándose con la industria, el gobierno, los proveedores y las comunidades para apoyar a nuestros clientes y proyectos. Estamos aportando experiencia global para desarrollar talento local, fortalecer las capacidades regionales y ofrecer un valor duradero, estableciendo una presencia confiable a largo plazo que respalde el crecimiento sostenible y posicione a Argentina como un mercado fundamental para el desarrollo de minería, energía e infraestructura.

Resumen del Puesto

Con sede en Buenos Aires, Argentina, este puesto es responsable de liderar la función de Finanzas Corporativas y Contabilidad de una Oficina Corporativa recientemente establecida. El puesto garantizará el cumplimiento de las políticas de Bechtel y los requisitos legales locales, al tiempo que respaldará la configuración de procesos, controles e informes.

Esta posición tendrá un alcance inicial, pero se espera que evolucione en paralelo con el crecimiento del negocio, aumentando en complejidad, volumen de transacciones y responsabilidades de liderazgo, apoyando la progresión hacia un alto nivel.

Principales Responsabilidades

• Mantener libros contables corporativos y estatutarios que garanticen la precisión y la integridad.

• Preparar estados financieros, balances de prueba y cronogramas de respaldo. Realizar y supervisar conciliaciones mensuales, incluidos los registros corporativos frente a los legales.

• Gestionar el flujo de caja y elaborar previsiones en coordinación con el grupo de Gestión de Caja de la oficina de Santiago.

• Garantizar la presentación oportuna y precisa de impuestos y presentaciones legales. Coordinar con los equipos y funciones del proyecto para resolver problemas contables.

• Proporcionar análisis financieros e informes de gestión. Actuando como la interfaz contable principal para la Oficina Corporativa de Argentina.

• Contribuir al establecimiento de un entorno de control sólido alineado con los estándares de Bechtel.

• Apoyar el diseño y mejora de procesos contables, controles internos y procedimientos de presentación de informes.

• Apoyar y liderar progresivamente auditorías, inspecciones fiscales y revisiones de cumplimiento.

• Brindar recomendaciones sobre asuntos complejos de contabilidad, impuestos y cumplimiento.

• Participar en implementaciones de sistemas e iniciativas de estandarización de procesos.

• Apoyar la ampliación de la función contable, incluida la incorporación y supervisión del personal.

• Contribuir a los procesos de presupuestación, previsión y planificación financiera.

Requisitos Educación y Experiencia

• Requiere una licenciatura en Contabilidad, Finanzas o campo relacionado con 7-10 años de experiencia relevante en contabilidad y cumplimiento legal.

• Certificación profesional (CPA o equivalente) o habilitación profesional equivalente en el país de ejercicio

• Sólido conocimiento de los principios contables y la información financiera. Experiencia con contabilidad general, conciliaciones y estados financieros.

Conocimientos y habilidades requeridas

• Experiencia en entornos multinacionales o basados en proyectos. Conocimiento del marco tributario y estatutario argentino.

• Experiencia apoyando auditorías e interacciones regulatorias. Experiencia en mejoras de procesos o implementaciones de sistemas.

• Potencial para asumir responsabilidades de liderazgo ampliadas.

• Dominio de Microsoft Excel y sistemas ERP (por ejemplo, Oracle).

• Fluidez en español y dominio práctico del inglés.

• Demostrar liderazgo, responsabilidad y mejora continua. Comunicarse de manera efectiva en todas las funciones y geografías.

• Identificar riesgos y proponga soluciones de forma proactiva. Garantizar la entrega oportuna y escale los problemas con anticipación. Mantener los estándares de ética y cumplimiento de Bechtel.

postings.title: Loan Processor & Underwriter (Private Real Estate Lending)
postings.descriptionText:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH

Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Openings: 2

Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending

Compensation: $1,700 to $2,300 USD/month

Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About The Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, originators and capital partners to deliver fast, reliable funding.

As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every loan file accurate, complete and moving on time.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Processor & Underwriter to own underwriting, loan file completeness and follow-up on every file through the satisfaction of underwriting conditions.

You will analyze borrower, property and deal risk, collect and verify documentation, manage appraisals, and keep borrowers, brokers and originators informed until each loan is ready to close.

This is not a data entry or conventional mortgage processing role. We are looking for someone with real underwriting and processing experience at a hard money or private lender, who brings strong judgment, persistence and excellent borrower service.

What You'll Do

Underwriting

• Underwrite business-purpose Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and Ground-Up Construction loans

• Analyze credit, borrower experience, liquidity, LTV/LTC, as-is value, ARV, DSCR, construction budgets and exit strategy

• Approve loans within delegated guidelines and escalate exceptions

Loan File Management

• Collect, verify and organize borrower, guarantor, entity and property documents

• Maintain accurate conditions and loan files in the company's loan portal and CRM

Appraisal Review

• Order, track and review appraisals, including comparable sales and values

• Work with the appraisal management company on corrections or reconsiderations

• Promptly advise the originator of any material changes in value or risk

Follow-Up & Communication

• Proactively follow up with borrowers, brokers, originators and vendors until all outstanding documents and conditions are resolved

• Respond promptly and deliver outstanding service to borrowers, brokers and partners

Closing Support

• Coordinate with the closer on underwriting-related items through funding

• Correct any underwriting deficiencies identified after closing

Qualifications

Required

• At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction)

• Practical underwriting and loan processing experience at a comparable lender

• Advanced written and spoken English

• High attention to detail and strong analytical skills

• Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow

• Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders

• Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls

• Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

• Loan files are complete, accurate and organized at every stage

• Underwriting decisions are well supported and stay within guidelines

• Outstanding conditions are cleared quickly, with minimal reminders

• Appraisal issues and material changes are flagged early

• Borrowers, brokers and originators receive timely, professional updates

Why Join Us?

• Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,700 to $2,300 USD per month

• Meaningful Responsibility: Own loan files from underwriting through clear to close

• Professional Growth: Deepen your experience in U.S. private real estate lending

Important Notes

• Candidates must reside in Latin America

• Direct experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender is required

• Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required

• Excellent English communication skills are essential

• Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled

This is a remote/telecommute position.

postings.descriptionText:
Krantz Executive Search | Atracción, Evaluación y Búsqueda de Talento
¡Buscamos talento para nuestro equipo!

En Krantz Executive Search , consultora especializada en la atracción, búsqueda y evaluación de talentos, nos encontramos en búsqueda de un/a Psicólogo/a de Reclutamiento y Selección que quiera asumir un rol dinámico, combinando la ejecución integral de procesos de selección con una marcada orientación al cliente, habilidades de relacionamiento y un genuino interés por la gestión comercial.

Buscamos a una persona que destaque por su alta inteligencia social, excelentes habilidades interpersonales y comunicacionales, y capacidad para construir relaciones de confianza . Alguien que, además de contar con solidez técnica en evaluación de personas, tenga interés por comprender las necesidades del negocio, desarrollar vínculos de largo plazo con clientes e identificar oportunidades que contribuyan al crecimiento de la consultora.

¿Cuál será tu propósito?
Gestionar procesos de reclutamiento y selección de principio a fin, asegurando la identificación, evaluación y presentación de candidatos alineados con los requerimientos técnicos, culturales y estratégicos de cada cliente. Asimismo, contribuir al fortalecimiento de las relaciones comerciales mediante una atención cercana y consultiva, identificando necesidades y oportunidades de colaboración que agreguen valor al servicio entregado.

Principales responsabilidades

• Gestión integral de procesos de selección: levantar perfiles de cargo junto a clientes internos y externos, identificando las competencias, experiencia y características clave para cada posición.

• Atracción y búsqueda de talento: publicar ofertas laborales, realizar filtros curriculares, desarrollar búsquedas directas y utilizar distintas estrategias para identificar candidatos pertinentes.

• Evaluación psicolaboral: conducir entrevistas por competencias y aplicar herramientas de evaluación, considerando las exigencias del cargo y el contexto organizacional.

• Elaboración de informes y presentación de candidatos: preparar informes por competencias y psicolaborales, reportes de evaluación, comunicando hallazgos y recomendaciones de manera clara, objetiva y fundamentada.

• Gestión de clientes y candidatos: coordinar entrevistas, realizar seguimiento de los procesos, entregar retroalimentación oportuna y mantener una comunicación fluida con los distintos interlocutores.

• Desarrollo de relaciones comerciales: comprender las necesidades de los clientes, fortalecer vínculos profesionales, detectar oportunidades de nuevos requerimientos y contribuir al desarrollo de relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.

• Mejora continua: proponer iniciativas que permitan optimizar las metodologías, la experiencia de los candidatos y la calidad del servicio entregado.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

• Título profesional de Psicólogo/a.

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en procesos de reclutamiento y selección .

• Experiencia en entrevistas por competencias, evaluación psicolaboral y elaboración de informes.

• Alta inteligencia social , con capacidad para comprender distintos contextos interpersonales, adaptarse a diversos interlocutores y desenvolverse con criterio en situaciones profesionales.

• Excelentes habilidades comunicacionales , tanto orales como escritas, para conducir entrevistas, presentar candidatos, transmitir recomendaciones y relacionarse eficazmente con clientes.

• Marcado interés por la gestión comercial , con motivación por comprender las necesidades del negocio, desarrollar relaciones con clientes e identificar oportunidades de crecimiento.

• Orientación al cliente y capacidad para generar relaciones de confianza, entregando una experiencia de servicio cercana, profesional y de calidad.

• Iniciativa, autonomía y proactividad para gestionar procesos, anticipar necesidades y proponer soluciones.

• Organización y capacidad para administrar múltiples procesos de manera simultánea, resguardando la calidad del trabajo y el cumplimiento de los plazos.

¿Qué será valorado?

• Experiencia previa en consultoras de Recursos Humanos, empresas de Executive Search o áreas de Reclutamiento y Selección de distintas industrias.

• Experiencia en la gestión directa de clientes y coordinación con distintos niveles organizacionales.

• Interés o experiencia en desarrollo comercial, fidelización de clientes y detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

¿Qué esperamos de quien se incorpore?

Una persona que combine rigurosidad técnica con habilidades relacionales y visión de negocio; que disfrute conectando personas con oportunidades, comprenda el impacto de una buena decisión de contratación y tenga la motivación para contribuir tanto a la calidad de los procesos como al desarrollo de la consultora.

Si te interesa formar parte de un equipo donde la evaluación del talento, las relaciones humanas y el desarrollo comercial se complementan, ¡nos encantaría conocer tu perfil!

postings.title: People and Culture Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital Holdings is the group behind Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club - a fast-growing, bootstrapped ecosystem spanning DeFi education, private co-investment, and membership communities. Each entity operates with its own brand, hiring managers, and pace, but shares a single People & Culture function.

That function is small, lean, and stretched across five businesses at once - which is exactly the problem this role exists to solve.

Our Impact

Across the group, we have built and scaled teams from the ground up while empowering thousands of members and investors globally. We hire fast, we hire often, and we hire across very different functions - sales, ops, tech, finance, investment, and executive support - sometimes all in the same week.

Our Vision

We want every entity in the group to hire with the same rigor: structured, scorecard-first, and fast enough that a great candidate never slips away while we figure out process. Getting there requires a dedicated recruiter who can operate across the whole group, not just one company's pipeline.

Are You Ready?

This is a build role inside a lean team - you will run full-cycle recruiting for multiple businesses at once, with real autonomy and a direct line to the person who owns People & Culture for the entire group.

The Role

The People & Culture Specialist reports directly to the People & Culture Manager and covers two things across every Catalyst Capital Group entity (Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club): full-cycle recruiting and People Operations and HR administration .

You will run multiple concurrent searches for different hiring managers while also keeping the group's people admin accurate, compliant, and on time. Expect roughly 60% recruiting and 40% People Ops, shifting week to week with hiring volume. You are the connective tissue that keeps quality and process consistent across all five businesses.

What You'll Own

• Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

• Run requisitions end to end: intake with the department lead, job description and scorecard build in Workable, sourcing, screening, structured interview logistics, through to offer

• Run searches concurrently across multiple entities and role types without dropping quality standards

• Sourcing & Pipeline

• Source directly via LinkedIn, Workable, free and Web3-specific job boards, and outbound headhunting rather than waiting on inbound applicants

• Build and maintain warm talent pipelines for recurring, high-volume role types (setters, closers, mentors, VAs) so new reqs open with a head start

• Screen for CV fraud and AI-tailored application patterns - a known and recurring issue across recent hiring cycles

• Cross-Entity Coordination

• Partner with department leads and hiring managers across all five entities, each with different hiring maturity and norms

• Enforce the group's standard hiring process - approval, structured interview sequence (Loom review, Talent Team interview, Hiring Manager interview, exercises and assessments, etc.)

• Systems & Reporting

• Maintain Workable pipeline hygiene: accurate stages, notes, and candidate status across every open requisition

• Maintain a live recruiting report for the People & Culture Manager - time-to-fill, pipeline volume, and source effectiveness by entity

• Coordinate a minimum of two reference checks per hire before any offer is extended

• Offer Support

• Draft first-pass offer language aligned to each entity's comp structure and route for sign-off before it goes to the candidate

• Onboarding & Offboarding

• Run the new-hire process end to end: contracts, pre-start paperwork, tool and system access, equipment, Day 1 and Week 1 schedule

• Run offboarding: access removal, equipment return, final admin, and exit documentation

• Keep one consistent onboarding experience across all entities

• HR Administration & Records

• Maintain accurate contractor records, org charts, and entity assignments in our HRIS and shared drives

• Prepare and issue employment and contractor agreements, amendments, and role or comp change letters from approved templates

• Collect and prepare inputs for payroll and contractor invoicing, and coordinate with Finance on accuracy and timing

• Arranging of Birthday gifts, gifts for special occasions, and company swag for all team members.

• Policy, Compliance & Team Member Support

• Maintain the handbook, policies, and People & Culture templates, and keep them current

• Be the first point of contact for contractor questions on policy, leave, payroll, and tooling

• Escalate industrial relations issues to the People & Culture Manager promptly

• Keep records audit-ready and handle all personal data with strict confidentiality

• People Reporting

• Maintain a live headcount and people dashboard: joiners, leavers, open roles, and entity splits

• Flag admin backlogs and compliance gaps to the People & Culture Manager

Requirements

What You Need

• 3+ years in recruiting and/or HR operations, with at least 2 years of full-cycle recruiting across multiple business units, brands, or portfolio companies at once

• Hands-on experience with HR administration: onboarding and offboarding, contracts, employee records, and payroll or contractor inputs. Experience with remote, international, or contractor-heavy teams is a plus

• Comfortable running several concurrent searches across functions while keeping admin work on schedule, without a coordinator behind you

• Fluent with an ATS (Workable strongly preferred) and an HRIS (BambooHR), and confident building structured interview scorecards

• High attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information

• Experience partnering directly with a People & Culture leader and with hiring managers across multiple entities

• Excellent written English and comfortable working async across time zones, with availability for EST hours or overlap with both EST and CET

Nice to Have

• Recruiting or HR experience in Web3, DeFi, fintech, or membership/education businesses

• Experience in a holding company or group structure with multiple P&Ls

• Familiarity with Testlify or similar assessment tools

• Working knowledge of employment practices for contractors and employees across multiple countries, or experience with an employer-of-record provider

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and ClickUp

Benefits

What we offer you

• Competitive salary

• Unlimited PTO

• Flexible work schedule

• Team off-sites

• Fully remote with a very supportive team

postings.title: Talent Development Team Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America and Africa to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development projects. Our mission is to build a worldwide Movement empowering the poor in their fight for equal access to healthcare, education, and a safe home. Our vision is a world free from the constraints of poverty. MEDLIFE works with students from around the world in order to broaden their perspectives and better equip them to advocate for social justice.

Our Ideal Talent Development Team Lead

We're looking for a hands-on, mission-driven people leader who is eager to learn and to build. You work side by side with team leads on feedback, follow-up, clear KPIs and development plans for their teams. You learn how an organization works, propose improvements and make them happen rather than waiting for direction. You lead your team with clear standards and accountability, and you develop each person on it. Above all, you bring MEDLIFE's values: FIRE (energy, urgency and ownership of results), GROWTH (curiosity, openness to feedback and constant learning) and IMPECCABLE CHARACTER (integrity, consistency and discretion with sensitive information). As we continue growing, we'd love for you to be part of the MEDLIFE Movement.

About The Role

You will build MEDLIFE's leaders, culture and performance system, so every team has clear KPIs, regular feedback and development plans, and our leaders grow from within. Your main focus will be helping team leads give feedback, follow up with their teams, set clear KPIs and build development plans for their people. You will also lead the Talent Development team, which includes Talent Acquisition and People Administration, so those areas deliver on their goals. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will design and personally run our core talent programs, supported by a part-time administrative assistant. You will report directly to MEDLIFE's Founder and work closely with the Leadership team and team leads across all departments.

What will your day-to-day look like at MEDLIFE?

• Work side by side with team leads on giving direct feedback, running regular 1:1s, following up with their teams and holding hard conversations.

• Build and facilitate our Leadership Development Program, and agree a development plan with each team lead.

• Help every team lead define 3 to 4 clear KPIs and a weekly scorecard, and review them regularly with each lead.

• Make sure every employee has a role scorecard, clear goals and a development plan, and run performance review cycles hands-on with team leads.

• Bring MEDLIFE's values to life: run recognition programs (including our monthly Level Win meeting), behavior assessments and team-building initiatives.

• Run engagement and climate surveys end to end, from design to results, and lead the action plans.

• Identify skill gaps and own our training framework (Core MEDLIFE, Sales and Leadership development).

• Run 360 feedback, quarterly talent reviews and succession planning for critical leadership roles.

• Lead, coach and develop the Talent Acquisition and People Administration team, setting the area's KPIs and weekly scorecard.

• Learn our current people processes, document the key ones as simple SOPs, and put improvements into practice.

What will you bring?

• 4+ years of experience in HR, Talent Development or Organizational Development, with real experience leading people or coordinating other leaders.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Organizational Development or a related field.

• Hands-on execution, not only design: you have personally built and facilitated trainings, run review cycles, created scorecards or rubrics, and presented results.

• Experience developing leaders: coaching managers or team leads to give direct feedback, run 1:1s, follow up with their teams and hold difficult conversations.

• Practical experience in performance management (goal setting, role scorecards, review cycles, correction plans) and/or Learning & Development (skills-gap analysis, onboarding, leadership training), with working knowledge of the other.

• Experience running culture, values, recognition or engagement initiatives and turning results into concrete action plans.

• Experience setting clear expectations and KPIs, running 1:1s and holding people accountable for results.

• A KPI and data mindset: you define simple metrics, track them consistently and use evidence to make decisions.

• Process improvement: you learn how work is done today, document it, propose improvements and put them into practice.

• Practical use of generative AI to build training content and automate HR reporting.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, an ATS (e.g., Hiring Room) and HR tools (performance management, survey platforms, LMS).

• Advanced English and Spanish.

Nice To Have

• Experience in non-profit or mission-driven organizations.

• Experience in multi-country or fast-growing organizations.

• Experience designing or facilitating a leadership development program.

• Exposure to succession planning, talent reviews, or compensation and benefits.

• Knowledge of labor regulations in Latin America (Peru is a plus).

What do we offer you?

• Full-time position, Monday to Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm (Peru time, GMT-5).

• Flexible work model: hybrid for candidates based in Lima, Peru, and remote for candidates based in other countries.

• Competitive salary commensurate with the role.

• Birthday day off.

• Growth opportunities in a fast-growing, multi-country organization.

• Mission-driven work: the chance to shape the people system that helps MEDLIFE serve more students and communities.

Please note: We welcome applications from candidates across Latin America. We are grateful to all interested candidates, but only those chosen for an interview will be contacted.

Early Careers Attraction Project Manager

Rank: Supervising Associate

The Opportunity

The Early Careers Attraction Project Manager will serve as the central coordinator for EY's project manager led school strategy, leading the execution of campus strategy plans and ensuring alignment across recruiting teams, alumni stakeholders, and campus partners. This role will virtually manage and support stakeholder teams responsible for university engagement efforts, ensuring they have the resources, tools, materials, communications, and guidance needed to effectively support stakeholders and maintain strong campus relationships. The individual will oversee campus strategy, communications, governance processes, event and engagement requests, budget tracking, and reporting.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate and remotely support university engagement activities by partnering with University Relationship Leaders (URLs), client-serving professionals, alumni, and recruiting stakeholders to execute targeted campus initiatives.

• Support necessary event planning, logistics, outreach, communications, and operational coordination to ensure successful execution of campus engagement efforts.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholder teams, ensuring they have the necessary resources, materials, guidance, and information to effectively support university relationships and recruiting activities.

• Communicate with candidates identified from school teams who are interested in career opportunities with EY

• Manage engagement requests and help align campus activities with talent priorities, local market needs, skills-based hiring objectives, and high-potential candidate development strategies.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to tailor engagement approaches based on university priorities, stakeholder objectives, and evolving talent attraction needs.

• Track project milestones, stakeholder commitments, and engagement outcomes while providing regular updates, reporting, and recommendations to leadership.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• 5-7 years of experience in recruiting, talent operations, or stakeholder-facing roles

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapting priorities and shifting focus as business needs and firm objectives change.

• Experience working with recruiting systems, CRM tools, or candidate tracking platforms

• Strong teaming and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and drive results across diverse stakeholder groups in a highly matrixed environment.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

• Experience supporting Early Careers or campus recruiting programs

• Familiarity with stakeholder engagement at senior levels (e.g., PPMDD, client leaders)

• Experience in process improvement, operations, or workflow optimization

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate a relationship-first mindset while maintaining a strong commitment to process integrity and fairness. The ideal candidate thrives in a highly collaborative environment, values consistency and accountability, and is motivated to enhance both candidate and stakeholder experiences at scale.

EY’s Commitment to Fairness and Consistency

This role operates within established recruiting frameworks and does not influence hiring decisions. All referrals are managed consistently, with no preferential treatment, and communication is provided transparently without overpromising outcomes.

Ideally, you'll also have

postings.title: Sales Trainer US
postings.descriptionText:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market .

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do:

• Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.

• Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.

• Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.

• Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.

• Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.

• Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.

• Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.

• Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.

• Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements:

• Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.

• 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.

• Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.

• Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.

• Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.

• Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.

• Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.

• Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

• Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.

• Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.

• Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.

• Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.

• Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.

• Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.

• Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you:

• A supportive and proactive work environment.

• Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month

• Fully remote and full-time collaboration.

• Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

• Tangible results measured by student success.

postings.title: Instructional Designer, TRM Academy (Compliance)
postings.descriptionText:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Instructional Designer on TRM Academy designs and builds the courses, certifications and learning paths that help financial institutions, crypto businesses, regulators and law enforcement understand crypto risk, apply compliance principles and combat crypto-enabled financial crime. You turn the expertise of TRM's intelligence, policy and compliance teams into published, assessment-backed training across self-paced courses, live sessions and product documentation, in multiple languages. What makes this role different: you use AI to build faster, and you own the accuracy that government agencies and financial institutions rely on when they train and certify their people.

The Impact You Will Have

• Design learning pathways for a widening range of learners. Turn the Academy's catalog into clear paths through self-paced courses, live sessions and scenario-based assessments, with a particular focus on helping compliance teams understand crypto activity, assess risk and apply regulatory requirements in practice.

• Keep TRM's certifications accurate and defensible. Run the review cycle for the Academy's certification programs. Route content and exam items to subject-matter experts for sign-off, check figures and citations against their sources, and update courses quickly as crypto risks, regulatory requirements and source material evolve.

• Turn expert knowledge into strong training. Coach subject-matter experts with editorial feedback so their expertise becomes clear, well-built courses, hands-on exercises and trainer toolkits for live delivery. Help learners connect technical and regulatory concepts to everyday compliance decisions.

• Co-own product documentation and training across TRM's platforms. Keep help content, onboarding and product training accurate and in step with releases, connecting platform capabilities to practical compliance and investigative workflows.

• Deliver content in multiple languages without losing accuracy. Run the localization workflow: first-draft translation, native-speaker review and SME sign-off for technical and regulatory material.

• Make the team faster, and prove the training works. Draft with AI and own the verification, so no unsupported figure, source or regulatory detail reaches a learner. Build reusable workflows the Academy adopts, and measure both the build time saved and learner outcomes beyond completions.

What We’re Looking For

• 3 to 5+ years of instructional design or curriculum development for adult learners, with a portfolio of published, assessment-backed courses.

• Experience building on an LMS and writing valid assessments and item banks.

• Ability to translate technical and regulatory subject-matter content into practical curriculum; familiarity with crypto compliance, anti-money laundering, sanctions or financial-crime risk is a strong plus.

• Production AI fluency: you already use AI daily to draft content, generate assessment items and speed up build and research workflows.

• Readiness to build reusable AI workflows others adopt, including item generation checked against source and comparisons of existing modules against new intelligence and regulatory developments, and to own the human verification step.

• Excellent written communication and a track record owning courses end-to-end as the single accountable owner.

About The Team

• You will join TRM Academy’s Training and Certification team, which builds engaging, mission-relevant content and teaches to every level of expertise.

• The work is intellectually demanding: you keep curriculum accurate across crypto, compliance and investigations, with an emphasis on translating evolving risks and regulatory expectations into practical education and valid certification assessments.

• Mission-first, execution-oriented culture that values speed, high build quality and measurable business impact through education.

• AI-native team: designers use AI daily to build content and ship reusable assets the whole Academy adopts.

Team Operating Rhythms

• Distributed, not distant: a team that collaborates across time zones with regular overlap for syncs and content reviews.

• Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

• Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus regular content-build and review rhythms tied to launch windows.

• Close working cadence with SMEs in Intelligence, Policy and Compliance and with Product for accuracy.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

• Schedule: Business hours with overlap across US time zones for internal syncs and content reviews.

Travel Requirements

• Schedule: Minimal; occasional travel for team or customer content sessions if needed.

Onsite Requirements

• Schedule: None required; distributed role.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

• Within your first 30 days, scope a requested course and stand up a V1 using AI to draft the slides, workbook and assessment, so a first version is ready to review that same month.

• Within 60 days, ship a reusable AI item-generation workflow, with items checked against source, that at least one other Academy team member adopts.

• Within 90 days, publish practical crypto compliance or certification content end-to-end, with measurable completion or assessment results, and standardize the build play so it repeats.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

• Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

• The estimated base salary range for this role is $155,000–$175,000.

• Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

• Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

• Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

• Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

• First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

• Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

• References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

• Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

• Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

• Accelerate repeatable workflows

• Structure and solve problems

• Improve output quality

• Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

• Priorities and targets to change quickly

• Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

• A high level of personal ownership and accountability

• Close collaboration across teams and functions

• Frequent, high-touch communication

• Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

• A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

• Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

• Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

• Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating you
