postings.title: Senior Paid Media Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Paid Media Specialist (Remote / Digital Marketing / Full-Time)

Thrive Internet Marketing Agency is a full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Arlington, Texas, with a talented team of over 150 members, known as “Thrivers,” from 10 countries worldwide. Founded by Matt Bowman in 2005, Thrive has earned a strong reputation for sustainable, strategic growth by prioritizing relationships and results for our clients.

Our Core Values shape a culture where team members thrive and clients succeed. Known for our award-winning culture and exceptional employee experience, Thrive is proud to maintain a 5.0 overall rating on Glassdoor — a reflection of our commitment to people, collaboration, growth and doing meaningful work together. Recognized as an industry leader by Google, AI search platforms, our clients and word of mouth, Thrive has earned a spot on the INC 5000 list for seven consecutive years.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior PPC Specialist to join our Demand Generation team and own the paid acquisition engine that drives Thrive’s growth. You’ll be responsible for turning advertising spend into qualified leads, sales opportunities, and revenue.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who knows Google Ads inside and out, understands how paid search connects to the sales pipeline, and makes decisions based on business outcomes rather than clicks alone.

Thrive serves businesses across the United States with a full range of digital marketing services, including SEO, PPC, web design, social media, ecommerce marketing, AI visibility, and local marketing. In this role, you’ll work closely with sales leadership and internal teams to build, optimize, and scale campaigns that generate measurable business growth.

Schedule: Remote, with at least four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time.

In This Role, You’ll Get To:

• Own Thrive's paid acquisition end to end: strategy, build, launch, optimization and budget pacing across Thrive's own Google Ads account, with targets set on qualified leads and pipeline.

• Drive lead volume and lead quality together. Grow clicks and leads first, then tighten towards sales-qualified leads (SQLs) and closed deals.

• Design a clean account structure (brand, core services, ecommerce, industry verticals, location) so every campaign has enough budget and data to learn.

• Run national and local campaigns side by side , deciding where to go wide for volume and where to focus (for example DFW verticals).

• Own conversion tracking and data integrity: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Calendly and form tracking, call tracking, enhanced conversions and offline conversion imports from our CRM (Zoho). Primary vs secondary actions set correctly, nothing counted twice.

• Close the loop with sales: feed CRM lead stages back into Google Ads, set realistic conversion values, and move to value-based bidding when volume supports it.

• Protect budget from junk: spam and bot filtering, search partner testing, negative keyword lists and weekly search-term reviews.

• Build and test offers and funnels with sales and web: landing pages, lead magnets (such as our free website offer), CRO and A/B tests.

• Test new channels beyond Search when the data supports it: Demand Gen, YouTube, Performance Max, Meta and LinkedIn.

• Report weekly on pipeline, not vanity metrics: spend, leads, SQLs, cost per SQL, pipeline and revenue influenced, with a clear view of what changed and why.

• Be the in-house expert: turn outside advice into a clear, prioritised plan and document changes so the team stays aligned.

• Use AI well: adopt AI agents and automation for audits, reporting, search-term reviews and ad copy, keeping human judgment on decisions that matter.

You Could Be a Great Fit for This Role If You Have:
A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in fields such as Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, Information Systems, or related areas.
Signature Thriver Traits :

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable insights.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical team members.

• Creative problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards overcoming challenges.

Essential Relevant Skills and Experience:

• 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads , including at least 2 years running demand generation or lead gen for a B2B or agency/services business.

• 3+ years of hands-on LinkedIn Ads for B2B lead gen

• 3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads for B2B lead gen

• Current Google Ads certifications: Search plus at least one of Performance Max, Measurement or Display. Google Analytics (GA4) certification required.

• Proven pipeline results. Be ready to walk us through 2–3 accounts you owned: starting point, what you changed, and the numbers in leads, SQLs, cost per SQL or revenue, not just CTR and CPC.

• Budget experience of $5,000–$25,000+ per month in a single account, with disciplined pacing.

• Strong tracking skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion imports and CRM integrations, set up and debugged without a developer.

• Smart Bidding judgment: you know when Maximize Clicks, Maximize Conversions, tCPA or value-based bidding fit, and how much data each needs.

• Commercial mindset: comfortable working with sales on lead quality, offers and handoff, and judged on revenue.

• Fluent written and spoken English , clear communication with senior stakeholders, and the ability to explain a bad week honestly.

• Self-directed: you make decisions, document them and own the outcome.

Other Beneficial Skills and Experience:

• ChatGPT Ads for B2B lead gen

• Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce experience

• Marketing agency background, either in-house growth or client-side

• Landing page tools (Unbounce, Webflow, WordPress) and CRO testing

• Looker Studio dashboards and Google Ads scripts

• Microsoft Ads

• Claude skills and/or familiarity

• Familiarity with ads in AI search surfaces (AI Overviews, ChatGPT ads)

Technical Requirements:

• Reliable, fast internet connection and a dependable computer setup.

Thrive’s Commitment to You:
Remote Work and Flexibility : We value work-life balance and embrace remote work.
Growth and Development : We support continuous professional growth through learning opportunities.
Collaborative Culture : We foster a team environment that values creativity and diverse perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Spirit : We encourage innovation and ownership in your role.
Recognition and Rewards : We recognize and celebrate outstanding contributions.
Comprehensive Benefits :

• Competitive compensation

• Company bonuses

• Generous paid time off

• Wellness allowances for global Thrivers

• Remote work stipends for setting up your workspace

• Parental leave

• Charity matching program

• An exceptional culture and much more!

Check out our website: https://thriveagency.com/

Our Interview Process:
We follow a multi-step interview process that allows you to get to know us as we get to know you. We believe in a thorough approach to ensure a good fit for everyone involved.

postings.title: Email Marketing Associate
postings.descriptionText:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Associate - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle - translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

• Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

• On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

• You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

• On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

• You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

• You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

• Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

• Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Associate to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

• You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

• You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

• You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

• You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

• You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

• You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

• 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

• Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

• Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

• Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

• Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

• Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

• Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

• Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace, we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:
Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses that are experienced in remote hiring and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have experience in offshore team-building and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:
We're hiring a Performance Creative Strategist for a growing food and beverage eCommerce company. In this hands-on role, you'll turn customer insights, raw footage, and performance data into video and static ads for Meta. Working with the founder and relevant teams, you'll build a consistent testing workflow, analyze what works, and use sound judgment to guide new concepts and iterations.

• Develop creative concepts and testing plans. Use Amrita's existing customer avatars and buying motivations to develop hooks, angles, messages, and offers. Maintain a testing calendar across concepts, formats, and variations.

• Coordinate creative assets. Work with creators and internal team members to obtain footage and other production inputs. Organize assets into a reusable content library.

• Use AI to improve execution. Apply AI and automation to research, ideation, copywriting, editing, transcription, versioning, and asset management. Review outputs for accuracy, quality, and brand fit.

• Launch creative tests. Upload, launch, and manage creative tests in Meta Ads Manager and other agreed platforms. Coordinate with paid-media specialists on campaign setup, audiences, and budgets.

• Analyze performance and iterate. Review results, identify likely reasons creatives succeed or underperform, and turn those findings into new concepts and variations.

• Align ad and landing-page messaging. Check that ads connect consistently with the landing page, product page, and offer. Coordinate messaging updates with relevant team members.

• Collaborate with the founder. Communicate priorities, insights, and asset needs clearly. Maintain an organized workflow that reduces the founder's day-to-day involvement in creative execution.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

• Creative production: Canva, CapCut, Descript, or comparable editing tools

• Creative research and analysis: Creative OS, Motion, Foreplay

• Paid media: Meta Ads Manager and relevant AI-assisted advertising tools

• Creator platforms: TikTok, Trybe, ReacherApp

• eCommerce and landing pages: Shopify, Replo

• Collaboration and reporting: Google Sheets, Google Docs

• AI and automation: Claude, ChatGPT, and other tools that improve creative production and workflow efficiency

Experience with every listed tool is not required. Candidates should be comfortable learning the platforms needed for the role.

Qualifications:

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, paid social creative, creative design, or a similar role.

• Strong experience developing Meta/Facebook and Instagram ads for eCommerce, DTC, or consumer brands.

• Strong understanding of hooks, creative angles, messaging, ad copy, UGC, and customer buying motivations.

• Hands-on experience producing both video and static ads , including turning existing footage and brand assets into multiple concepts and variations.

• Proficiency with Canva and a video-editing tool such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Descript, or a comparable platform.

• Ability to interpret creative performance data, explain likely drivers, and recommend what to test next.

• Comfort using Meta Ads Manager to upload and launch ads and review performance.

• Practical experience using AI tools, with the judgment to refine their outputs.

• Strong written and verbal English, including clear communication of creative ideas and performance insights.

• Strong organization, initiative, and ownership, with the ability to manage priorities independently and work directly with a founder.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with food and beverage, CPG, or wellness brands.

• Familiarity with creator platforms such as TikTok, Trybe, or ReacherApp.

• Familiarity with Motion, Foreplay, Creative OS, or similar creative research and analysis tools.

• Experience with Shopify and landing-page tools such as Replo.

What Success Looks Like

• A consistent workflow for developing, producing, testing, and improving creative.

• Video and static ads informed by customer insights and performance data.

• Clear recommendations on what to test next and why.

• Organized assets and communication that reduce the founder's involvement in daily creative execution.

• Creative that supports profitable customer acquisition.

Shift Schedule:

• Monday–Friday, with approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours for collaboration, creative reviews, and meetings. Remaining hours may be completed asynchronously.

• Exact working hours will be agreed upon directly between the contractor and the client.

postings.descriptionText:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 160 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,500 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

The Role

Decentralized Masters is looking for an Affiliate & Partnerships Coordinator to own the day-to-day operations of our affiliate and partnership program. The program spans affiliate networks, newsletter and media placements, and creator partnerships. This is an execution-focused role. You'll set up tracking, keep partner placements and copy current, run compliance checks, and produce the weekly reporting that keeps the program accountable.

You don't need to be an elite affiliate strategist to do this well. The focus is execution and consistency: taking over the operational workflow and keeping it running cleanly. You'll work closely with the Head of Partnerships, who owns strategy and partner relationships. Your job is to make the machine run.

What will you be doing?

• Link & tracking setup: Create and manage affiliate tracking links and offers in Everflow. Make sure attribution is configured correctly and firing end to end

• Partner copy & updates: Manage and update creative and copy for partner placements. Keep offers, links, and assets current across all partners

• Creator & media partnerships: Help source and coordinate placements with newsletters, YouTube and podcast channels, and other media and creator partners. Brief them on messaging and compliance, hand over tracking links and creative, schedule go-lives, and chase deliverables so campaigns launch on time

• Compliance checks: Review partner copy and placements against our compliance guardrails before anything goes live. This is a regulated space, so accuracy and defensibility matter

• Reporting: Produce detailed weekly performance reports across partners and affiliates. Surface what's working, what isn't, and where attribution is breaking

• Analysis: Read performance data (spend, ROAS, CPA, conversion) and flag issues, opportunities, and anomalies

Requirements

What will you bring?

• Hands-on experience running partnerships. Affiliate or partner tracking (Everflow or comparable) is ideal, but strong influencer, creator, or media and newsletter partnership experience counts too

• Strong analytical skills, with real comfort working across performance and attribution data

• High attention to detail, especially around compliance and reporting

• Solid written communication and the ability to manage and edit partner copy

• Organized and reliable, able to own a recurring workflow without hand-holding

Nice to have

• Experience managing influencer, creator, YouTube, or podcast partnerships

• Business development or appointment-setting experience. Helpful but not required, since this can be shared with the wider team

• Familiarity with HubSpot, Hyros, or Snowflake

• Background in financial publishing, crypto, DeFi, or another regulated performance-marketing space

Benefits

What do we offer you?

• Competitive salary package

• Full time/40 hours a week

• Unlimited PTO

• Flexible work schedule

• Team off-sites

• Young & dynamic culture with team members across 30+ countries

• Fully Remote with a very supportive team. You have the ability to work from anywhere in the world!

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

postings.title: Brand Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Healthee is an AI-powered platform that transforms how employees understand, navigate, and use their health benefits. We're on a mission to make healthcare simple, personal, and accessible — and we believe the way we show up in the world should feel just as fresh, human, and bold as the product we build.

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional, deeply experienced Marketing Brand Designer to join our Creative & Brand team and help build Healthee's marketing brand from the ground up. Reporting to the Creative & Brand Team Manager, you'll partner closely on where the brand goes — and take real ownership of bringing it to life.

You'll be a driving creative force behind our brand expression — raising the bar for quality and creativity everywhere Healthee meets the world: social media, video, events and conferences, swag, sales enablement, campaigns, and the creative ideas nobody has thought of yet.

What You'll Do

• Build and evolve Healthee's marketing brand — contributing to the visual identity, design language, and brand system as we create it from scratch and scale it across every channel

• Raise the quality and creativity of the external touchpoints you work on: if a prospect, customer, or candidate sees it, you help make sure it's beautiful, on-brand, and unmistakably Healthee

• Design social media creative that stops the scroll — concepts, templates, and campaigns that give Healthee a distinctive, recognizable voice in the feed

• Lead video and motion work — from social-first video and motion graphics to sales enablement videos, product stories, event openers, and beyond. Concept, storyboard, and produce (hands-on or with partners)

• Create swag people actually want to keep, and design conference and event experiences — booths, signage, environments, giveaways — that make Healthee the brand everyone remembers

• Elevate digital and print sales enablement materials — pitch decks, one-pagers, brochures, leave-behinds — that make our sales team proud to hit send

• Bring creative initiatives to the table — spot opportunities, pitch bold ideas, and execute them end to end without waiting to be asked. You run your own projects from concept through delivery

• Help build reusable systems and toolkits so the brand scales: guidelines, template libraries, and frameworks that empower the whole company to create on-brand work

• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, people, and product teams — balancing stakeholder requests with what's right for the brand

• Keep us current — stay ahead of design, social, motion, and AI-creative trends, and bring the best of them into our work

Requirements

• 6+ years of brand, visual, or marketing design experience — ideally in-house at a fast-growing B2B / SaaS company or at a top-tier agency — with an outstanding portfolio that shows range: identity, social, video/motion, events, and print

• Demonstrated experience helping build brands and brand systems from early stages — you contribute ideas and craft, not just execution of existing guidelines

• Exceptional craft: you obsess over typography, color, composition, and detail, and it shows in everything you touch

• A self-starter's engine: you're energized by ambiguity, generate your own ideas, and drive them from concept to delivery independently

• Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; strong motion/video skills (After Effects, Premiere, or equivalent) and comfort producing video end to end

• Production fluency for both digital and physical — you know how to prepare files for print, production, and vendors, and how to make a booth or a hoodie look as sharp as a landing page

• Strategic communication: you can articulate how visual decisions support business goals, present concepts with confidence, and iterate gracefully on feedback

• Strong project management, juggling multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment without letting quality slip

• Fluency with modern AI creative tools, applied pragmatically to move faster without compromising craft

Bonus Points

• Experience in healthtech, health insurance, or benefits — or a knack for making complex topics feel simple and human

postings.title: AI Sales Operator
postings.descriptionText:
About the Role

You will be the person who makes our AI better at selling. You will read its conversations, notice what is working and what is not, and change the instructions it follows so the next thousand conversations go better.
You do not need to know everything on day one. We will teach you our tools, our playbooks and how to write and test prompts. What we cannot teach is the instinct for conversations, a feel for sales, and the curiosity to dig into the data and ask why.
What You'll Do

• Review AI-drafted text messages each day, and approve, edit or rewrite them before they send.

• Spot patterns across conversations, such as an opener that gets replies but no orders, and figure out the cause.

• Update each brand's prompts and playbook to fix problems at the source, then test the change before it goes live.

• Respond to brand requests and turn them into playbook updates.

• Help launch new brands: deep research on their brand, write the persona and opening messages, and check that offers work.

• Run and track A/B tests, and report what won.

Requirements

• You read people well. From one text you can tell whether a shopper is ready to buy, has a question, or is done, and you reply the way a real person would.

• You have sales instinct. You answer an objection and then ask for the sale, without arguing or pushing the customer away.

• You are curious about data. You can open a table of conversations and ask the right questions: how many, compared to what, at which brand, since when. You notice when a number looks off and go find out why.

• You fix the cause, not the symptom. When the AI says something wrong, you look for the reason (a missing fact, a vague rule, two rules that conflict) and fix the instruction so it does not happen again.

• You are comfortable with AI tools. You use ChatGPT, Claude or similar tools regularly and understand that how you ask shapes what you get back.

• You are online. These are live conversations. You are responsive during working hours and quick to pick things up in Slack.

• You learn fast and like feedback. You pick up new tools quickly and want to get better each week.

Nice to Have

• Experience in sales (SDR, BDR, retail or any role with a close rate), customer support, or live chat.

• Experience at a DTC brand or ecommerce agency.

• Familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, Postscript or similar tools.

• Spreadsheet skills, or basic SQL.

• Something you have built or automated with AI on your own.

What We'll Teach You

• Our console, approval queue and playbook system.

• How to write, test and ship prompt changes.

• Shopify basics, discount codes and how they combine.

• How we run and read A/B tests.

postings.title: Technical Product Owner
postings.descriptionText:
Who is UJV?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

• UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.

• We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.

• We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.

• We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity

• and attention to detail.

• We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.

Role Mission

The Technical Product Owner leads the strategy and delivery of UJV's e-commerce platform: the B2B, B2C, client, advisor, partner, and white-label online booking portals, and the API integrations behind them. Together, these products shape how UJV does business with clients, advisors, partners, and vendors. You will sit at the intersection of users, business, and technology: understanding what each audience needs, deciding what is worth building, and working with engineering to bring it to life.

As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap, prioritize with a clear view of impact and effort, and measure success through adoption and business results. You will work hands-on, using customer research, data, and AI-enabled tools to test ideas early and make confident decisions. This is a high-visibility role for someone who enjoys real ownership, thrives in a small and fast-moving team, and wants to build the technology behind a leading luxury travel brand.

You will also serve as UJV's product practice lead. Several leaders across reservations operations, the Admin platform, and supplier inventory (the Product Vault) own products without the PM title, and part of your role is to make them stronger at scoping, prioritizing, writing requirements, and measuring adoption. You lead by example and by coaching, not by authority.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Roadmap

• Own the roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for UJV's e-commerce platform (B2B, B2C, client, advisor, partner, and white-label online booking portals, including API integrations), turning business goals into multi-quarter roadmaps and quarterly goals.

• Act as the single point of product ownership: the one person engineering, operations, and leadership go to for product decisions.

• Lock requirements and acceptance criteria before each sprint, and manage change through the roadmap rather than mid-cycle.

• Decide what will not be built this sprint or quarter, protecting a coherent experience for advisors, hotels, partners, and clients.

Discovery and Prototyping

• Stay close to the user's pain points: run discovery directly with advisors and hotel partners, including time embedded with hotel operations.

• Build working prototypes and applications with AI tools (such as Lovable, Cursor, or Claude) to validate workflows before engineering commits.

• Translate user pain points into clear technical requirements, with cost, impact, and effort made explicit for each.

Adoption, Analytics, and Observability

• Own adoption, not just delivery: drive advisor activation, search-to-booking conversion, and bookings.

• Define and instrument product analytics from day one, including activation funnels, conversion, performance, and failure points, and report on them in the weekly leadership meeting.

• Set non-functional acceptance criteria with engineering, including performance on production-scale data.

Cross-Team Partnership

• Direct the Portal engineering team and any external build partners on product priorities, acting as the bridge so engineers do not have to field raw user requests.

• Sequence which inventory and verticals (hotels, services, packaging, and beyond) reach the Portal together with the Product Vault owner, and coordinate shared trip-building logic with the Admin product owner.

• Partner with Hotel Partnerships on hotel relationships, reporting, and co-op marketing; with Marketing on the public site and landing pages; and with Data on reporting.

• Work with the Tech Lead to design and embed AI assistants and agentic workflows into the portals.

Backlog and Prioritization

• Own the Jira backlog for the portals end to end: intake, triage, prioritization, ticket quality, and sprint readiness. A ticket without a clear problem statement, acceptance criteria, and test cases does not enter the sprint.

• Run one prioritization system across Jira (engineering execution, bugs, QC) and Asana (business requests, cross-department projects, quarterly rocks), so every request has one home, one owner, and one priority. If you bring better tickets or want to build one, we are open to explore buy vs build.

• Run weekly backlog grooming with engineering leads and external build partners, and publish what moved up, what moved down, and what was cut, with the reason.

• Trace every ticket to a quarterly rock or roadmap item, and challenge work that cannot be traced.

• Keep Jira and Asana data clean enough to feed the leadership scorecard: sprint completion, bug pipeline, and cycle time.

• Protect the quarter from scope creep: split mid-cycle requirements into phases and make the tradeoff explicit to stakeholders.

Raising the Bar Across the Teams

• Coach the operations and platform leaders who carry product responsibility: turn ideas into scoped, phased requirements, and quarterly rocks into measurable milestones that are clearly on or off track.

• Build and roll out a lightweight UJV product playbook: problem brief and requirements template, acceptance criteria standards, a shared prioritization framework (impact, effort, confidence), and a release and adoption checklist.

• Teach AI product craft: prototyping with AI tools inside our shared setup, and designing evals (accuracy, guardrails, business impact) before AI output is trusted in production.

• Run regular product reviews or office hours where any leader can bring an idea and leave with a scoped, prioritized next step.

• Measure your impact by the team's output: fewer tickets bounced back for clarification, less rework, and more rocks landing on scope.

Qualifications

• 5+ years in product management, with at least 3 years owning a transactional e-commerce or two-sided marketplace product: search-to-purchase funnels, checkout and booking flows, supply onboarding, and conversion. Travel experience is a plus, not a substitute.

• Proven experience running both discovery (new products) and delivery (existing products and teams).

• Hands-on AI fluency: you prototype with tools such as Lovable, Cursor, or Claude and use AI daily for research and documentation.

• Strong analytical skills: product analytics, SQL, and event instrumentation for funnels and conversion.

• Working API literacy to write specs against booking and inventory APIs, plus comfort with Jira, Asana, or Linear and Figma.

• Sound product judgment, an ownership mindset, and rigor at speed: you can say no, act without perfect requirements, and keep a high bar before anything ships.

• Track record of making the people around you better at product work, with or without direct reports, such as introducing a prioritization framework, coaching non-PMs on requirements, or building a playbook a team actually adopted.

• Experience designing AI-assisted search or conversational experiences.

• Near-native English proficiency.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience in travel, hospitality, or travel tech (OTAs, wholesale, advisor or hotel tech), or in e-commerce and marketplace products.

• Experience with advertising or sponsored placements in a marketplace, or selling to and validating with B2B partners such as hotels.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

postings.title: AI Product Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Vas a ser la primera contratación del equipo de Producto para sumarte a trabajar codo a codo con el CEO y el CTO de nuestro cliente. Vas a aprender como nunca sobre los problemas de las empresas de la economía real ya que somos una startup que revoluciona la forma en la que operan mediante agentes IA. Es condición necesaria el hambre de construir procesos, equipos y apalancarse al máximo de la IA, queremos que armes tu propio equipo de agentes y te mantengas en la punta de la lanza tecnológica. Vas a challengear todo lo que hicimos hasta ahora en cuanto a producto, rearmar lo que necesario y te vas a convertir en el owner del roadmap de producto.

El cliente se hace cargo, con agentes de AI, del trabajo administrativo que las empresas hacen alrededor de su sistema de gestión. No lo reemplazamos: nos montamos sobre el que la empresa ya usa y transformamos la forma en la que lo operan. Le permitimos a nuestros usuarios customizar sus propios agentes IA explicándoles las particularidades de su operación. Eliminamos el data entry de la gestión documental, ordenamos la información y auditamos millones de datos a la vez buscando eficiencias, desde conseguir mejores precios, o detectar fraudes e inconsistencias hasta prevenir quiebres de stock.

En dos años superaron los 300 clientes. Somos 18 personas y duplicamos el equipo en 8 meses. Seguimos acelerando el crecimiento, sumando funcionalidades, y queremos asegurar que agreguen el máximo valor para el cliente, mientras mantenemos la coherencia del producto.

Qué vas a hacer

Armado del departamento. Necesitamos alguien que quiera embarrarse y entender cómo conviene operar el área de Producto. Armás y ejecutás los procesos sobre los cuales va a correr el trabajo del área, asegurando una buena coordinación con el resto de los equipos.

Estrategia y roadmap. Sos el principal responsable de construir el roadmap de producto garantizando la ejecución de la visión y ajustándola cuando sea necesario. Tenés que estudiar las últimas tendencias del mundo de la tecnología para mantenernos en la punta de la lanza y hablar con otras Startups, clientes, y/o partners para entender cómo agregar más valor.

Discovery . Estructurás la forma en la que hacemos discoveries para destilar los insights que permitan establecer los próximos pasos de producto, agregando el máximo valor para el cliente. Hablás con usuarios reales, traducís estas conversaciones en insights, en propuestas de nuevos productos, y participás de su diseño.

La coherencia del producto . Asegurás que la experiencia de los usuarios a través de la plataforma fluya correctamente, que la navegación y la interacción entre las partes del producto sea coherente y funcional para el usuario. La mirada sobre el usuario y la usabilidad la traes vos.

Cómo trabajamos?

• AI-first: Se espera que te apalanques de las últimas tendencias de IA al punto que armes tu propio equipo de agentes IA de Producto trabajando para vos, y que te muevas muy rápido en conjunto con el resto de la startup. Necesitamos mucha velocidad de ejecución y capacidad de adaptación a nuevas condiciones (otros tipos de clientes, nuevos mercados y/o nuevos problemas).

• Tenemos una cultura enfocada en deleitar a nuestros clientes.

• Vas a trabajar mano a mano con el CEO y el CTO.

Qué buscamos

• 3+ años en un rol de producto.

• Hambre de 0→1 por encima de todo lo demás, disfrutás de resolver problemas difíciles.

• Espíritu crítico: preguntar por qué sobre cada cosa, incluidas las decisiones de producto que ya tomamos nosotros, sabés decir que no y defender tu postura con argumentos.

• Corriste discovery vos: hiciste entrevistas, armaste análisis de uso, construiste prototipos, y tomaste decisiones con impacto tangible en el producto a partir de eso.

Suma (no excluyente):

• Haber sido dueño de un producto con agentes de AI en producción, con volumen y no un piloto, y haber trabajado con evals.

• Tener experiencia en startups.

• Tener experiencia en soluciones B2B sobre sistemas de terceros y dominios donde el error tiene un costo grande para los clientes.

• Tener experiencia con ERPs/sistemas de gestión o sistemas contables.

postings.title: Sr. Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
En Homie estamos transformando la forma en que las personas rentan vivienda en LATAM. Combinamos tecnología, operación y servicio para construir una experiencia de renta más rápida, transparente y sin fricciones para propietarios e inquilinos.

Somos una startup en crecimiento, con retos reales, decisiones rápidas y un producto que conecta distintos tipos de usuarios, necesidades y momentos clave dentro del ciclo de renta. Para seguir evolucionando, necesitamos personas capaces de entender problemas complejos, priorizar con criterio, traducir oportunidades en soluciones concretas y construir productos que generen impacto real en la experiencia del usuario y en el negocio.

Si te gusta descubrir problemas, cuestionar cómo funciona un producto, trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y convertir ideas en soluciones medibles, este rol puede ser para ti.

Misión del rol

Liderar la evolución estratégica del producto de Homie, identificando oportunidades de mejora en la experiencia de inquilinos, propietarios y equipos internos, y transformándolas en soluciones digitales claras, medibles y alineadas con los objetivos del negocio.

Este rol es clave para definir qué problemas debemos resolver, por qué son importantes, cómo priorizarlos y cómo llevarlos a ejecución junto con Tecnología, Diseño, Operaciones y áreas de negocio. Su trabajo permitirá que Homie construya un producto más simple, confiable y escalable, capaz de mejorar la conversión, reducir fricciones operativas y fortalecer la relación con propietarios e inquilinos.

Tareas

• Mejorar la forma en que los inquilinos encuentran propiedades, entienden sus opciones y avanzan hacia una renta, identificando oportunidades para elevar conversión, confianza, velocidad de cierre y calidad del match entre usuario y propiedad.

• Diseñar experiencias que permitan a propietarios e inversionistas tener mayor visibilidad sobre su portafolio, incluyendo ocupación, pagos, rendimiento, mantenimiento, comunicación con Homie y estado general de sus propiedades.

• Identificar fricciones en los distintos puntos de contacto del usuario y traducirlas en soluciones claras, medibles y alineadas con las prioridades del negocio.

• Entender a profundidad las necesidades de distintos usuarios —inquilinos, propietarios, equipos internos y stakeholders de negocio— para construir soluciones que equilibren experiencia, eficiencia operativa y viabilidad técnica.

• Definir problemas de producto con claridad, estructurando hipótesis, objetivos, alcances, criterios de éxito y métricas que permitan evaluar si una solución realmente genera impacto.

• Priorizar iniciativas de producto con criterio estratégico, considerando impacto en negocio, experiencia de usuario, complejidad técnica, urgencia operativa y capacidad del equipo.

• Construir y mantener roadmaps claros, realistas y accionables, asegurando foco en los problemas más relevantes y evitando dispersión en iniciativas de bajo impacto.

• Trabajar de cerca con Ingeniería y Diseño para convertir oportunidades en soluciones concretas, asegurando que cada iniciativa tenga contexto suficiente, alcance bien definido y criterios claros de entrega.

• Usar herramientas de IA de forma práctica y crítica para acelerar investigación, prototipado, documentación, exploración de soluciones, redacción de specs o validación temprana de ideas.

• No buscamos usar IA por tendencia. Buscamos a alguien capaz de identificar dónde realmente puede mejorar la experiencia, reducir fricción, acelerar aprendizaje o validar soluciones antes de comprometer tiempo de ingeniería.

• Medir el impacto de las iniciativas lanzadas, aprender de los resultados y ajustar el producto con base en datos, feedback cualitativo y entendimiento del negocio.

• Aportar estructura, claridad y pensamiento estratégico en un contexto de startup, donde los problemas pueden ser ambiguos, los recursos limitados y la velocidad de ejecución clave.

Requisitos

• 5+ años de experiencia en Product Management en empresas de tecnología, productos digitales o plataformas con retos complejos de usuario y operación.

• Experiencia en marketplaces, plataformas transaccionales, productos con múltiples tipos de usuario o negocios donde la confianza, la conversión y la operación sean factores críticos.

• Capacidad sólida para definir problemas, priorizar oportunidades, construir roadmaps, escribir specs y medir impacto.

• Criterio fuerte de UX. No necesitas diseñar interfaces, pero sí saber detectar fricciones, entender comportamientos de usuario y explicar por qué una experiencia funciona o no.

• Experiencia llevando productos, features o iniciativas de 0 a 1, desde descubrimiento y definición hasta lanzamiento, medición e iteración.

• Capacidad para trabajar con Ingeniería, Diseño y stakeholders de negocio, traduciendo necesidades complejas en decisiones de producto claras y accionables.

• Comodidad trabajando con datos, métricas de producto, funnels, conversión, adopción, retención, eficiencia operativa o indicadores de negocio.

• Habilidad para moverte entre estrategia y ejecución, entendiendo tanto la visión general del producto como el detalle necesario para que las cosas avancen.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de IA para investigar, prototipar, redactar documentación, explorar soluciones o acelerar ciclos de aprendizaje.

• Ownership alto, pensamiento estructurado y comodidad trabajando en contextos de startup, con ciclos cortos, cambios frecuentes y poca burocracia.

• Comunicación clara para alinear equipos, defender decisiones, explicar trade-offs y mantener foco en los problemas más importantes.

• Mentalidad emprendedora, curiosidad y criterio para cuestionar lo existente sin perder pragmatismo ni velocidad de ejecución.

Colaboración interna

Este rol colabora principalmente con Tecnología, Diseño y stakeholders de negocio para definir, priorizar y construir soluciones de producto que impacten directamente en la experiencia de propietarios, inquilinos y equipos internos.

Trabajará de cerca con Operaciones para entender procesos, fricciones, necesidades internas y oportunidades de automatización; con Comercial y Marketing para mejorar conversión, adquisición, calidad de leads y experiencia de los usuarios en etapas clave del funnel; y con Servicio al Cliente para identificar patrones de contacto, dudas recurrentes y problemas que puedan resolverse desde producto.

Este rol será un puente entre usuario, negocio y tecnología, asegurando que las decisiones de producto no se basen solo en intuición, sino en evidencia, contexto operativo y objetivos estratégicos de Homie.

En Homie creemos que los mejores equipos se construyen con perspectivas distintas. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias, formas de pensar, trayectorias, identidades y contextos, porque sabemos que eso nos ayuda a tomar mejores decisiones y construir soluciones más completas.

Buscamos crear un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar con libertad, aprender, retarse y crecer. Si quieres sumarte a una empresa que está construyendo una mejor experiencia de renta para LATAM y te interesa construir producto con impacto real, nos gustaría conocerte.

postings.title: Product Operations Intern, Rewards
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

• Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.

• Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

• Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.

• Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.

• Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

• Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.

• Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

What We Look For:

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes

• Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time

• A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation

• Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend clearly for a non-technical audience

• Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to operations, product, fintech, data analysis, trust & safety, or startups is a plus. We hire for potential, not just pedigree.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Product Operations Intern is $2.800.000 COP monthly.

Como Analista de Packaging en Mars, vas a diseñar y desarrollar nuevos conceptos, renovar formatos de empaque actuales y liderar proyectos desde la idea inicial hasta la puesta en marcha en manufactura, transformando el diseño conceptual en un formato de empaque final (primario, secundario y terciario).

• Gestionar los flujos de aprobación de Master Data de punta a punta, incluyendo códigos de ítems de empaque, listas de materiales (BOMs) y rutas de materiales en SAP y plataformas globales de especificaciones (por ejemplo, Veritas y cPLM).

Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

The Bridgenext Salesforce & Agentforce Functional Architect plays a critical role in the success of Salesforce engagements, serving as the intersection of application strategy, technical solution design, and client partnership. This role is responsible for deeply understanding client business challenges and leading the definition of innovative, scalable solutions within the Salesforce ecosystem.

You will also act as the Product Owner for the engagement, owning the backlog, priorities, and acceptance criteria that turn the solution vision into delivered outcomes.

As a Salesforce & Agentforce Functional Architect, you’ll guide cross-functional teams, spanning multiple time zones, through successful delivery while ensuring continuous alignment with client goals. You will serve as a strategic partner to stakeholders, foster collaboration, drive key decisions, and own the end-to-end solution vision from discovery through enablement and handoff.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Solution Definition and Vision

• Own the solution definition and vision from discovery through handoff, setting the direction that business teams, designers, architects, and developers build toward and keeping it coherent as scope, people, and priorities change.

• Apply NorthStar, Bridgenext’s framework for aligning project and program definition to the client’s desired outcomes, to guide solution design and architecture choices within agreed financial, timing, staffing, quality, and platform boundaries.

• Design scalable solutions across Salesforce, Agentforce, related SaaS products, and web technologies, advising on when to use declarative versus custom approaches.

• Shape Agentforce solutions, including agent design, topics, actions, and prompts, and set guardrails proactively so agents are secure, accurate, and used responsibly.

Client Partnership and Business Alignment

• Build trusted advisory relationships with executive and technical client stakeholders and maintain shared direction throughout the engagement.

• Act as the client’s day-to-day product partner, digging into the business goals, success measures, and constraints behind each request.

• Facilitate discovery workshops that uncover business priorities, user needs, and operating realities, applying the NorthStar framework.

• Roadmap and Work Definition

• Own the product backlog and maintain an outcome-driven roadmap that sequences initiatives by business impact, delivery risk, effort, and dependencies.

• Translate business needs into epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria, measurable value, and scope boundaries, agreed with engineering, QA, and UX.

• Keep upcoming work prioritized and refined so the engineering team stays focused on the highest-value outcomes.

Delivery Leadership

• Define the technical critical path and lead teams through execution, adapting the Agile approach to the needs of the engagement.

• Run backlog refinement, sprint planning, and solution demonstrations, ensuring decisions and feedback shape upcoming work.

• Coordinate Technical Architects, UX Designers, Developers, QA professionals, and client contributors to resolve issues and deliver a cohesive solution.

• Own delivery outcomes through go-live, holding yourself and the team accountable for timely, high-quality results.

Decision Support and Communication

• Keep internal and client stakeholders informed of progress, decisions, concerns, and dependencies, and manage expectations along the way.

• Act as a strategic advisor: frame solution and scope alternatives, explain trade-offs across value, timing, effort, quality, and risk, and recommend a path. Push back on scope that adds complexity without adding value.

• Explain technical concepts in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.

• Solution Readiness and Client Enablement

• Lead user acceptance testing and outcome validation, confirming that delivered capabilities meet acceptance criteria and produce the intended business results.

• Prepare client teams for sustained use through onboarding, knowledge transfer, and role-appropriate training.

Engagement Health and Account Growth

• Monitor assumptions, delivery exposure, and unresolved gaps, surfacing risks early and recommending changes when they could affect results.

• Identify needs beyond the current scope that could shape later phases or expand platform value, bringing the client innovative ideas.

• Partner with sales on follow-on work, quarterly business reviews, and account planning.

Workplace: Remote, LatAm

Must Have Skills

• 7+ years of experience designing complex solutions on the Salesforce platform, using both out-of-the-box capabilities and Salesforce-friendly customizations, including implementation, product development, or (even better) both.

• 4+ years of professional services consulting experience leading strategic engagements, ideally as a product owner.

• Experience owning solution definition and vision on complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, with strong examples of implementations spanning multiple technology stacks.

• Experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog with clear acceptance criteria, and leading teams using Agile frameworks, including writing user stories and running sprint demos.

• Fluency in Agentforce functionality, with a working understanding of how to design agents and a proactive approach to setting guardrails.

• Successfully led collaborative discovery workshops with client stakeholders to define business needs and align on solution direction, drawing on both customer experience insights and technical strategy.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce declarative tools and working with development teams across multiple time zones, including leading teams without formal reporting lines.

• Comfortable presenting to the C-suite and leading enterprise engagements.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation, client-facing artifacts, and explaining technical concepts in plain language.

• Examples of using Salesforce innovatively to solve problems.

Preferred Skills

• Salesforce certifications such as App Builder, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Agentforce Specialist, plus an Agile certification such as CSPO, CSM, or equivalent.

• Experience leading $1M+ programs or large enterprise initiatives.

• Industry experience in Financial Services Cloud (FSC), insurance, and/or transportation.

• Experience writing prompts for Agentforce, including prompts that use Data Cloud.

• Knowledge of managed package development and AppExchange.

• Understanding of user-centered design and design thinking using the Salesforce Lightning Design System.

• Experience with Classic to Lightning migrations.

Professional Skills

• Confident running a room, whether it’s a workshop, a demo, or an executive meeting.

• Willing to say no and hold the line on scope when a request doesn’t serve the client’s goals.

• Leads through influence and trust, without relying on formal reporting lines.

• Shows up for the team when it counts, including off-hours go-lives and critical issues.

• Curious, creative, and eager to keep growing skills.

• Strong team and individual player who understands that when we win, everyone wins, and who stays composed and collaborative in any situation.

• Holds high standards of professionalism and quality, and is self-sufficient, requiring very little supervision.

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Product Validation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity

Allegro MicroSystems is seeking an enthusiastic and hands-on Product Validation Engineer (PVE) to join our Sensors business unit. In this early-career role, you will work closely with senior validation leads, Analog Design, Systems Engineering, and Test Engineering to evaluate, characterize, and validate first-silicon performance against product requirements and datasheet specifications. You will design bench test setups, automate data collection across temperature and voltage corners, and perform detailed data analysis to ensure our magnetic and power sensor ICs achieve world-class automotive quality.

What You Will Do

• Develop, debug, and execute automated bench test setups and scripts (e.g., using Python, LabVIEW, or MATLAB) to validate silicon functionality across supply, voltage, and temperature corners (-40°C to 150°C).

• Execute the Silicon Validation Plan, characterizing critical analog and mixed-signal performance parameters (such as noise, offset, linearity, sensitivity, and ADC/DAC behavior) against requirements.

• Support the creation and execution of the validation timeline, assisting in the definition, layout review, and assembly of custom bench evaluation hardware and socketed test boards.

• Perform Bench-to-System and bench-to-ATE correlation studies with Test Engineering to establish robust test limits and verify register/EEPROM trimming behavior.

• Identify, document, and track silicon anomalies and bugs using issue-tracking platforms, participating in root-cause debug sessions alongside Analog and Digital Design Leads.

• Compile and summarize characterization data, contributing to executive summaries and updating core parameter presentations to support project milestone phase gates.

What You Will Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 1–3 years of hands-on semiconductor lab evaluation, characterization, or academic/internship validation experience.

• Proficiency using bench test equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power supplies, SMUs, arbitrary waveform generators, DMMs).

• Experience with test automation languages (Python preferred, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or C/C++).

• Solid foundational understanding of analog mixed-signal circuits (op-amps, bandgaps, regulators, ADCs, sensor front-ends).

Senior Product Designer (AI Enabled): Building Digital Climate Platforms

Application link: https://noteforms.com/forms/senior-ai-product-designer-job-application-qybqv8

Are you a senior designer who builds, not just designs, and wants your work to actually matter?

Open Earth Foundation is a California-based nonprofit on a mission to create groundbreaking technology that helps combat the climate crisis.

Our climate platforms support cities around the world with data-driven climate planning and delivery.
We’re a diverse, global team working remotely and collaborating with partners worldwide to make real change possible.

With strong funding and a powerhouse team of innovators, we’re ready to tackle big challenges for a resilient Earth for generations to come and we need the planet’s brightest minds to help solve them!

We're growing our design team and looking for Senior AI Enabled Product Designers: generalists and makers who use AI to go from idea to working prototype fast, own problems end to end, and ship alongside engineers, data teams and product leads.

This is not a research role, and it's not a role for someone who only wants to design flows in isolation.

It is a role for someone who sees design as a way to make things real.

Priority will be given to applications submitted by November 15th.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it:

As a Senior Product Designer at Open Earth Foundation, you will:

• Lead the design of digital climate platforms used by real cities and institutions, including a new global digital service for cities built with international partners.

• Lead projects and epics as a designer, from problem framing to shipped solution, with autonomy under ambiguity.

• Use AI to build and validate fast: turn ideas into working prototypes, test them, and iterate before committing engineering time.

• Bring product thinking to every decision, balancing user needs, technical constraints, partner expectations and impact.

• Help shape the design system that keeps our products consistent, accessible and fast to build.

• You'll help turn complex climate, urban, and data-heavy challenges into tools people can actually use.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end design of features and products using Figma as the primary design tool.

• Build AI-assisted prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions and align stakeholders quickly.

• Translate complex problems and datasets into clear, accessible interfaces and flows.

• Run lightweight validation (usability tests, quick interviews, analytics review with tools such as PostHog or GA4).

• Collaborate closely with developers to ensure feasibility and quality implementation.

• Contribute to and evolve our design system: components, patterns, documentation and design-to-code consistency.

• Have created or managed design systems or are eager to develop that expertise, including reusable components, design foundations, accessibility, and documentation.

• Communicate design rationale clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including external partners.

• Mentor and support other designers and collaborators when needed.

• Able to maintain and support in the product development cycle, both ongoing and from scratch (i.e.: helping to define a design system or UI kit together).

How We Work:
• Remote-first , async-friendly, highly collaborative.

• This position is international.

• Schedule flexibility is expected, with willingness to collaborate during overlapping hours of 8am-11am PST.

• LATAM time zones or availability within ±3 hours of ART (GMT-3) are strongly preferred.

The Ideal Candidate:

We're intentionally looking for someone who:
Is an AI-enabled designer
• Already uses AI as part of how they work, not as an experiment.

• Has built functional prototypes, tools or MVPs with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, Figma MCP, or similar).

• Cares about responsible and ethical use of AI.

Is a versatile product designer. A generalist, not a specialist
• Moves comfortably between strategy, UX, UI, prototyping and implementation support.

• Favours lightweight, pragmatic validation over lengthy research processes, learning by building and testing.

• Is comfortable wearing different hats when the team needs it.

Is a startup-minded maker
• Has worked in startups, scale-ups or small, fast-moving teams, and thrives in constant change.

• Adapts methods to the problem instead of following a rigid "ideal" design process.

• Takes ownership, makes decisions and follows through to delivery.

Cares deeply about climate
• Has experience in climate tech, clean energy, sustainability, civic tech or the public sector (highly valued), or a genuine personal commitment to climate.

• Is motivated to learn about climate science, global climate governance, and how cities operate.

• Wants their design work to contribute to real-world impact.

Bonus: experience with design systems
• Have you built, rebuilt or owned a design system? We'd love to hear about it. We're investing in ours, and that experience is a real plus, but it's not a requirement.

Interpersonal Skills:
• Clear, confident communicator in written and spoken English (required; non-native speakers very welcome).

• Strong collaborator across disciplines and time zones.

• Comfortable giving and receiving feedback.

• Proactive, curious, and accountable.

• Able to take ownership and contribute as a core team member in a remote environment.

Qualifications:
• 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UX Designer, or similar role, with a track record of owning and shipping digital products.

• A portfolio showing problem-solving, ownership and shipped outcomes, not just polished screens, including at least one example of something built or prototyped with AI.

• Experience in startups, climate tech, sustainability, civic tech, or open-source projects is a strong plus.

• Experience creating or owning a design system (tokens, Figma variables, component libraries mapped to code, accessibility) is a strong plus.

• Experience with data-heavy products, B2B/B2G SaaS or data visualization is a plus.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frontend concepts, for collaborating with developers.

• Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits:
• Full-time position.

• Salary range: USD $40,000 – $50,000 per year , depending on experience and location. Paid in USD.

• Professional development budget.

• Unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.

• Fully remote, international work environment.

• Annual in-person team retreat.

OEF is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, religion, national origin, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion in our teams and believe people should align their work with their purpose. Join us if you love Earth.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We use AI-assisted tools to help organize and summarize application materials. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by people.
