Technology, Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP)– Product Owner

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 900 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function safeguards the integrity, resiliency, and security of technology in an ever-evolving digital landscape. We align with industry standards, support innovation, enable policy compliance through effective ownership, assess and minimize technology risks, and improve our technology resilience capabilities. Our primary objectives are to optimize and automate EY's processes by leveraging emerging technology and artificial intelligence, embedding a strong risk and security culture, and rationalizing our services to improve customer satisfaction, deliver added value, and reduce risks.

We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career with support, coaching, and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role provides an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!

Your key responsibilities

As a leader in this role, you will guide both the technical and business aspects of TARP software applications, ensuring their successful integration across teams through Agile practices and comprehensive risk management. Your communication skills will be crucial in fostering relationships and advocating for the adoption of internal technology solutions. You will collaborate with the TARP team and stakeholders to refine the application roadmap and prioritize feature backlogs, while partnering with Product Owners to enhance the overall user experience. Your duties include analyzing product performance, understanding business requirements, and ensuring that service capabilities are delivered at the right time for maximum business value. You will help oversee the Product Owner Team, providing direction and support, managing project progress, and addressing any roadblocks or team conflicts. Additionally, you will be accountable for delivering requirements within budget, gathering customer feedback, leading vendor and internal team efforts to maintain optimal service, and managing and developing direct reports.

Skills and attributes for success

• Superior interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, coupled with decisive judgment and strong analytical abilities.

• Adaptability and cultural sensitivity, with the capacity to forge robust relationships across a diverse, global, and matrixed organization.

• A collaborative spirit, effectively working within cross-cultural teams and valuing diverse perspectives.

• Proven competence in managing multiple tasks and setting priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.

• Flexibility to navigate shifting demands and priorities, embrace change, and consistently display executive presence and confidence.

To qualify for the role you must have

• 3-5 years of experience in project management and Agile methodology, with a strong foundation in system administration and financial management.

• Proficiency in English with exceptional writing and presentation skills, and the ability to convey technical concepts effectively to a diverse audience.

• Skilled in communication with various stakeholders including business partners, software developers, project managers, product owners, and data analysts.

• Expertise in Service Delivery, scripting, automation tools, and the capability to lead and manage direct reports.

• Strong leadership qualities with experience in executive presentations and briefings, complemented by excellent management, interpersonal, and decision-making skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Proven expertise in product management with a solid understanding of policy frameworks like ISO, COBIT, and the unified compliance framework, coupled with substantial knowledge and experience in technology governance, risk, and compliance.

• The ability to create and execute actionable roadmaps efficiently, driving all risk management initiatives, while proactively maintaining an in-depth knowledge of EY's core business, financial drivers, and the IT operating environment to support risk mitigation and service improvement.

• An appreciation for the business advantages of robust internal control and risk management beyond compliance requirements, recognizing their value in contexts beyond just SOX, PCI, or other regulatory frameworks.

What we look for

We’re looking for a leader who can collaborate globally with different regions and cultures with an open mind and a creative approach. Critical thinking and a problem-solving approach are vital traits to be successful in the role. An individual with strong customer service and communication skills.

What we offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world

Security Technology Services (STS), part of Information Security, enables more than 425,000 people across 150+ countries to access systems and information securely. • Experience owning product or technology roadmaps and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risk and product performance to non-technical executives.

Ideally, you'll also have

• Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Platform Owner or Technology Manager in a global, regulated or highly matrixed enterprise.

• Experience with agile product delivery, backlog management, customer discovery, release planning and adoption measurement.

• Budget planning, vendor management, capability rationalization and benefits-realization experience.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, ITIL, CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or cloud and container security credentials.

What we look for

• Strong product judgment, customer empathy and the ability to make decisions amid ambiguity and change.

Apply now.

El objetivo del puesto consiste en elaborar informes técnicos, económicos y de coyuntura vinculados al sector agropecuario y al accionar institucional de CARBAP, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones, la comunicación pública y el posicionamiento gremial de la entidad.

Las principales responsabilidades serán

• Análisis técnico y económico.

Relevar y analizar información sobre producción agropecuaria, infraestructura, mercados, precios y políticas públicas.

Elaborar informes sobre el impacto económico de medidas impositivas o regulatorias, realizando comparativos históricos, proyecciones y escenarios.

• Redacción de informes e insumos institucionales.

Redactar documentos, informes, presentaciones y comunicados institucionales, transformando información compleja en contenidos claros para dirigentes, medios y productores.

• Seguimiento normativo y político.

Monitorear proyectos de ley, ordenanzas, resoluciones y programas que afecten al sector, elaborando resúmenes ejecutivos y análisis de su impacto político y productivo.

• Apoyo a la gestión institucional

Preparar material de soporte para reuniones, asambleas y exposiciones, y coordinar con las entidades de base para recabar información del territorio.

• Comunicación y presentación.

Colaborar en documentos de posición, comunicados de prensa y contenidos para redes institucionales, participando eventualmente en reuniones técnicas o institucionales en representación de CARBAP.

Orientamos nuestra búsqueda a profesionales de las carreras de Economía Agraria, Administración, Agronomía o afines, preferentemente con al menos 2 años de experiencia en redacción de informes, análisis de datos o trabajo institucional, siendo requisitos ideales, no excluyentes. Buscamos una persona con interés genuino por la realidad agropecuaria y el rol gremial, excelente redacción, capacidad de síntesis, pensamiento analítico y criterio político.

Se valorarán conocimientos sobre políticas agropecuarias, estructura productiva argentina, análisis económico y fiscal, manejo de fuentes estadísticas y redacción institucional. Asimismo, se valorará el dominio de Excel, PowerPoint y Word, herramientas de diseño básico como Canva y herramientas de inteligencia artificial.

Modalidad de trabajo Es básicamente híbrido. Si será presencial en oficinas de Buenos Aires cuando se reúne la Comisión directiva los últimos miércoles y jueves de cada mes.

El trabajo es de dedicación plena y la remuneración será acorde a la responsabilidad y experiencia del candidato/a.

We are seeking a talented and motivated Shopper Risk Fraud Operations analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time:

• Monday -Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time (Central time zone).

This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

For this Fraud Operations Analyst the compensation range is $1,500 - $2,000 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

What You'll Do

• Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

• Able to work through holidays

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus

• Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

• Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus

• Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer

About You

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working At Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.title: Manager, CMO Quality (Contract Manufacturing Organizations) - CSL Seqirus
postings.descriptionText:
About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is one of the world's largest influenza vaccine companies and a global leader in pandemic preparedness. As part of the CSL Group, we operate at the intersection of cutting-edge science and meaningful human impact — protecting millions of lives every year. When you join CSL Seqirus, you join a team where quality is not a department, it's a commitment.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Global Head of External Quality , the Manager, CMO Quality plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity, compliance, and continuity of our external manufacturing network. You will be the primary quality partner for assigned Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) — overseeing outsourced production activities including API, Fill/Finish, and Packaging — and serve as the trusted bridge between CSL Seqirus and our global CMO partners.

This is a high-visibility, globally connected role where your decisions directly protect product supply, patient safety, and regulatory standing across multiple markets.

What You'll Do
CMO Relationship & Quality Oversight

• Serve as the primary regional quality interface for assigned CMOs, fostering strong, trust-based partnerships

• Ensure CMO quality systems are aligned with CSL Seqirus standards and applicable regulatory requirements

• Represent CSL Seqirus Quality in Joint Operational Meetings, Business Reviews, and on-site CMO visits

Quality Agreements & Governance

• Draft, negotiate, and maintain CMO Quality Agreements in compliance with FDA, EMA, PIC/S, TGA, and Health Canada regulations

• Oversee day-to-day execution of Quality Agreement commitments including training, recalls, and complaint management

Deviation, CAPA & Change Management

• Review, assess, challenge, and approve CMO deviations and CAPAs to ensure product quality and compliance

• Manage CMO-initiated changes and proactively communicate relevant updates to MAH stakeholders

• Review and approve GMP-controlled documents including SOPs, specifications, and validation reports

Performance Monitoring & Escalation

• Track and report CMO quality performance through globally aligned KPIs

• Identify quality trends and ensure timely corrective actions are implemented

• Escalate critical quality issues to senior stakeholders and drive resolution

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

• Drive harmonization of quality processes across the CMO network (change management, batch record review, complaints, recalls)

• Enhance CMO Quality Maturity and execute Quality Road Maps

Regulatory & Inspection Support

• Support regulatory inspections and audits at CMO sites as needed

• Assess and communicate potential regulatory impacts on CSL Seqirus business

Commercial Readiness & Growth

• Support Tech Transfer, product launches, and regulatory submissions for new CMO projects

• Act as Quality SME in cross-functional commercial readiness teams

What You'll Bring
Education

• Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a GxP environment within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated industry

• Demonstrated knowledge of FDA, PIC/S, EU GMP, TGA, and Health Canada regulatory frameworks

• Prior experience in CMO / third-party quality management highly preferred

• Proven ability to work effectively in a global matrix organization

Skills & Competencies

• Strong quality system knowledge — internal and external manufacturing environments

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones

• High cross-cultural sensitivity and interpersonal effectiveness

• Managerial courage — able to hold compliance positions under pressure

• Strategic mindset with strong decision-making and risk assessment capabilities

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

• Fluency in English and Spanish is required (written and spoken)

What We Offer

• A globally connected role with real impact on product supply and patient safety

• Collaboration with world-class quality professionals across Americas, EMEA, and APAC

• A culture that values integrity, courage, and continuous improvement

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with multinational pharma standards

• Approximately 25% travel to CMO sites and CSL Seqirus locations

Our Commitment
CSL Seqirus is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

postings.title: SOC Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

The SOC Manager is a hands-on operations leader responsible for running the day-to-day operation of a 24/7 security operations centre for a large US consumer lender. Working from AspenView's secure delivery suites in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires , you will lead roughly eighteen analysts and engineers across two cities, three tiers and three shifts. The client is regulated under NYDFS Part 500, GLBA, SOX and PCI DSS, so this role goes beyond keeping the lights on. You will make sure every investigation record stands up to examination, on the night shift as well as in the monthly report. You will report to a US-based SOC / Cyber Operations Lead and act as the operational link between the floor, partner governance and the client's security operations team.
What you will do:
Coverage & Team Operations

• Own rosters, coverage and handovers across three 8-hour shifts and two sites, including leave, sickness and training cover, so no shift runs short.

• Lead hiring, onboarding and coaching, and build the Tier 1 to Tier 3 career path that keeps the team together.

• Enforce the secure suite rules, including clean-desk policy and VDI-only access to the client environment.

Performance, Quality & Reporting

• Track operational performance live, including response times, escalation quality and case documentation, instead of discovering problems at month end.

• Ensure every ServiceNow case carries the hypothesis tested, the evidence, the reasoning and the disposition, so an auditor can follow it without asking.

• Build daily, weekly and monthly operational reports from the client's own ServiceNow and Elastic data.

Escalation & Change Control

• Own the escalation path from Tier 2 shift leads to partner governance and the client's security operations team, always escalating with evidence and a recommendation.

• Coordinate with the Incident Response Lead during major incidents.

• Run operational change control for detection rules, playbooks and escalation thresholds, which change only with client approval.

Tools & Technologies:

• SIEM & Case Management: Elastic, Abstract Security and ServiceNow SecOps.

• Endpoint & Identity: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender and Okta.

• Reporting: ServiceNow reporting and Power BI or an equivalent dashboard tool.

• Automation (Bonus): Automation or GenAI tools that reduce analyst toil without hiding work from the audit trail.

What you bring:

• Experience: Proven experience running or deputy-running a SOC, or a 24/7 NOC with security scope, against contractual service levels. You have kept a roster whole through attrition, holidays and sudden resignations, and you can spot a slipping metric before it becomes a missed one.

• Technical Judgment: The ability to read an investigation in ServiceNow, Elastic or an equivalent SIEM and tell whether the analyst actually proved their conclusion.

• Communication / Leadership: Direct people management experience, including hiring, hard conversations and performance plans, not only mentoring. English at B2 or above, strong enough to explain a missed target and its root cause to a US VP of security operations without an intermediary.

• Mindset: Accountable, structured and audit-minded. You treat documentation and change control as part of the job, and you follow and enforce security rules consistently.

• Availability: On-site work in Bogotá, Medellin or Buenos Aires during US Eastern business hours, plus your share of the management on-call rotation. Access requires identity, criminal background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Bonus Qualifications: Security operations experience in banking, lending, insurance or payments; exam or audit support under NYDFS Part 500, FFIEC, GLBA, SOX, PCI DSS or SOC 2; leading a team across two sites or countries; ITIL v4, CISSP, CISM or GCIH certification; and Spanish, since the floor is bilingual.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Customer Success Specialist in our team plays a critical role ensuring customer satisfaction, encouraging long-term relationships, and driving business growth. You will be the primary contact for customers, aligning their needs with our solutions while identifying opportunities for expansion and continuous improvement. If you succeed in a customer-focused environment and have experience delivering exceptional service, this position is for you.

Your Responsibilities

• You will manage a portfolio of assigned accounts, driving adoption, retention, expansion, and renewal activities.

• Partner with customers and Rockwell Automation Authorized Distributors to maximize customer value, improve adoption, and support business outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and key distributor contacts.

• Monitor customer health indicators, product usage, and engagement trends to proactively identify risks and growth opportunities.

• Conduct customer onboarding, health checks, business reviews, and value realization discussions.

• Support customers with inquiries related to services, pricing, subscriptions, licensing, and technical information.

• Provide budgetary quotations and service configurations according to regional requirements.

• Ensure on-time renewals and achievement of individual and team performance goals.

• Identify and support upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

• Collaborate with Sales, Customer Care, Business Units, and Channel Partners to resolve customer issues and improve customer satisfaction.

• Utilize Salesforce to effectively manage customer opportunities, forecasting, and account activities.

• Analyze customer and business data to support decision-making and portfolio management.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

• Communicate the value of Rockwell Automation solutions and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes.

The Essentials – You Will Have

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Sales Support, or customer-facing roles.

• Experience managing a portfolio of customers and driving customer engagement activities.

• Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce.

• Fluency in Spanish and English

The Preferred – You Might Also Have

• Experience in Customer Success roles.

• Familiarity with Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) processes.

• Strategic vision for the future of the brand and the company.

• Passion and for our products and services.

• Address complex commercial issues and develop solutions.

• Holistic approach to understanding interconnected systems.

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …

• Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm

• Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

• Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.

• Employee Assistance Program

• Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

• On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

Modality: Hybrid

You will report to: CUSTOMER SUCCESS TEAM LEADER

We believe that employee diversity is a key element of our common future. We provide opportunities for talent development and growth with the entire organization. We support equality by celebrating the individuality of every person, regardless of their origin and identity. We appreciate the unique cultural pattern and variety of experiences in each of us. We invite all who want to join and change the world of our organization.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

Sovos

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're building a world-class Renewals organization to strengthen the partnerships we've built with customers around the globe. As a Renewals Specialist, you'll own the renewal process for a portfolio of SaaS accounts, combining sharp negotiation skills with genuine relationship-building to drive retention, identify growth opportunities, and deliver a seamless customer experience. This is a quota-carrying role where your ability to balance advocacy, strategy, and execution will directly impact our success.

More Specifically, You Will

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders at customer organizations and collaborate with Account Management and Customer Success to create comprehensive account plans.

• Lead renewal negotiations with professionalism and clarity, partnering across teams to resolve account issues and remove obstacles to successful renewals.

• Proactively identify upsell and expansion opportunities within your assigned accounts, leveraging AI tools and customer insights to uncover growth potential.

• Implement renewals best practices that enhance the customer experience, streamline workflows, and improve retention outcomes.

• Maintain operational excellence and predictability in forecasting, consistently meeting or exceeding renewal targets and quota expectations.

• Adapt quickly to new systems, tools, and product offerings, using AI-assisted workflows where applicable to stay efficient and informed.

What You Bring to Sovos

• You've built solid experience in renewals management or account management within the software industry, specifically with SaaS solutions and services.

• You have a demonstrated track record of achieving sales or renewal quotas in a SaaS environment.

• You're a strong negotiator and communicator who can work independently or collaboratively, staying organized and effective even when timelines are tight.

• You're proficient with Microsoft Office applications and comfortable learning new systems; experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus, as is comfort with AI-assisted workflows.

• You're fluent in English and skilled at advocating for customers while upholding company policies and balancing competing stakeholder needs.

• You handle difficult situations with composure and resolve issues promptly, maintaining strong client relationships throughout.

• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

postings.title: Managed Services - PRC Support Specialist - Supervising Associates - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary:

The Pursuit Resource Center provides support to the firm’s deals across all sizes – saving time, driving efficiency and ensuring client servers have access to a broad range of well received and accurate materials to leverage in their pursuit efforts. This role actively supports our pursuit innovation strategy and contributes directly to the products and services to make pursuit efforts more effective.

The Pursuit Resource Center team is responsible for driving pursuit excellence across their domain (Service Line, Region, Sector), with a focus on empowering and supporting self-service pursuit teams. The PRC team require sponsorship from domain leadership and alignment with their strategic priorities. They act as a brand ambassador to ensure that EY’s pursuit self-help strategy meets the needs of pursuit teams.

The PRC team maintains EY’s curated global library of best practice pursuit content, PRC tools, and enablers, as well as providing high-touch pursuit support. The PRC team works closely with business leadership and internal functions to drive adoption of PRC products and services and co-develop pursuit self-help materials to meet the content needs of the business. Ongoing stakeholder engagement with region, service line, and sector leadership is a critical part of the team's success.

Essential Functions of the Job:

• Is responsible for executing pursuit excellence across their domain (Service Line, Region, Sector)

• Acts as a brand ambassador to ensure that GDH pursuit self-help strategy meets the needs of pursuit teams they work with

• Work with PRC Leadership to increase awareness and adoption of EY’s pursuit self-help products and services with domain teams and requestors

• Shares knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned with colleagues, and support presentations and training on pursuit excellence

• Actively contribute content and expertise to in-scope RFPs and proposals, ensuring high-quality responses including quality reviews of team members and applying leading practices and lessons learned

• Assist with pursuit content processes (outreach, harvesting and curation) to ensure materials align with business priorities and can be used effectively by pursuit teams and SMR networks

• Contributes to and maintains EY’s curated global library of best practice pursuit content, PRC tools, and enablers, as well as providing high-touch pursuit support

• Support PRC leadership to build relationships with stakeholders, co-deliver practical solutions and actively promote the value and impact of the PRC

• Works with PRC leadership and others to deliver initiatives and on day-to-day delivery

• Ensure inputs to KPI's/metrics are updated and without error

• Identify and share opportunities for continuous improvement, including ways to innovate, optimize, and enhance EY’s pursuit self-help resources

Supervision Responsibilities:

• Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others

• Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other team members in P&CE.

• Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.

• Oversee the work of the PRC team

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Essential

• Act as brand ambassador, promoting the PRC in various forums

• Collaboration & Relationship Building: Ability to engage effectively with pursuit teams, domain contacts and other Clients and Industry teams to understand needs and deliver practical support

• Content Management: Skilled in curating, maintaining, and updating pursuit content, tools, and enablers so they remain accurate, relevant, and easy to access

• Teamwork and collaboration: Works collaboratively, leads smaller projects, supports colleagues and contributes to overall team success

• Intermediate familiarity with AI; applies in daily tasks and identifies efficiency opportunities

• Execution and delivery: Strong focus on producing high-quality, brand-aligned pursuit materials (e.g., proposals, RFP responses, templates) with accuracy and attention to detail

• Performance Measurement & Analytical Skills: Ensuring quality inputs for tracking, and reporting KPIs/metrics, and helping drive improvements

• Adaptability and continuous improvement: Adapts and readily adopts new tools/processes, seeks ways to improve efficiency and share lessons learned

• Project management development and execution skills, managing projects, and working with virtual teams across geographies

• Communication & Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly in writing and verbally to support pursuit teams and contribute to deliverables

Desirable

• SharePoint skills

• Marketing communications, editorial/proof-reading skills

• Excellent project management and time management skills

Other Requirements:

• From time to time, internal and external obligations may require working after normal business hours.

Job Requirements:

Education:

• University/Bachelors’ degree, Masters Degree Preferred (MBA)

Experience:

• 5-7 years of relevant experience in pursuits, knowledge, or client service, demonstrating an understanding of pursuits and content navigation

• Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

• Knowledge of the bid process and experience in developing external marketing or pitch communications

About The Role

As a Crisis Team Lead , you will make an impact by leading a team responsible for managing critical customer situations and ensuring service excellence in a fast-paced operational environment. You will oversee team performance, drive operational outcomes, and foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional customer care.

You will be a valued member of the operations leadership team, collaborating with stakeholders, clients, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support while developing and empowering team members to achieve their full potential.

In This Role, You Will

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of support professionals to achieve operational goals and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

• Own team performance management, including monitoring operational metrics, schedule adherence, productivity, and quality standards.

• Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and development planning to support employee growth and success.

• Identify performance trends, analyze root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve team outcomes.

• Develop and execute action plans to maintain and improve operational performance and customer satisfaction.

• Prepare reports, root cause analyses (RCAs), and operational insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Present performance results, recommendations, and progress updates to internal and client stakeholders.

• Respond to client requests and operational escalations in a timely and professional manner.

• Foster a positive and engaging team environment that promotes collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

• Ensure compliance with Cognizant policies, processes, and operational procedures.

Work model

Hybrid

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a Cognizant or client office as needed.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

Schedules

4 AM to 1 PM: Tuesday to Saturday

8 PM to 5 AM: Tuesday to Saturday

12 PM to 9 PM : Sunday to Thrusday

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

• 2+ years of experience leading customer support, customer service, contact center, or operations teams.

• Demonstrated experience in performance management, coaching, mentoring, and employee development.

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate teams and drive operational excellence.

• Experience analyzing performance metrics and implementing improvement initiatives.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate challenging conversations professionally and effectively.

• Proven problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

• Experience creating and delivering presentations to leadership teams and stakeholders.

• Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

These will help you stand out

• Experience supporting crisis management, escalation management, or high-priority customer support operations.

• Previous experience in a contact center environment supporting phone, email, and chat channels.

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

• Experience using collaboration and productivity tools such as Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Calendar, and related platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and client-facing experience.

• Experience leading teams in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

postings.title: Especialista en Riesgos Tecnológicos (RiskIT) - Personal Pay
postings.descriptionText:
Quienes Somos
Cada vez más Personal
Somos Personal, una empresa que acompaña y potencia la vida de las personas a través de la tecnología. Nuestra propuesta está pensada para que cada persona, comunidad y organización pueda avanzar, conectarse, disfrutar y transformar su realidad.
En el equipo de Riesgos No Financieros, estamos sumando un Especialista en Riesgos Tecnológicos (RiskIT) para liderar la gestión del riesgo tecnológico, de seguridad de la información, de continuidad del negocio y de proveedores críticos de Personal Pay , como segunda línea de defensa.
Tenemos el orgullo de ser protagonistas de la evolución tecnológica y social del país y por eso te necesitamos en nuestro equipo.

Misión del Puesto
Ejercer, dentro de la Gerencia de Riesgos No Financieros (RNF) y con independencia de las áreas de Tecnología de la Información y de Seguridad de la Información, la segunda línea de defensa sobre el riesgo tecnológico integral de Personal Pay: tecnología, seguridad de la información, continuidad del negocio y proveedores críticos, desafiando el diseño y la efectividad de los controles.

Principales Responsabilidades

• Aplicar y mantener la metodología de gestión de riesgos de tecnología y seguridad de la información, incluyendo la evaluación previa a la incorporación de nuevos productos, procesos, sistemas o tecnologías.

• Identificar, evaluar y monitorear los riesgos tecnológicos y de seguridad de la información de la entidad, y mantener actualizada la matriz de riesgos de TI/SI con los aportes de Tecnología de la Información y de Seguridad de la Información.

• Evaluar el diseño y la eficacia de los controles existentes de Tecnología y de Seguridad de la Información, y proponer recomendaciones de mejora.

• Definir, junto con Tecnología de la Información, y monitorear indicadores clave de riesgo (KRI) de tecnología y seguridad de la información.

• Ejercer la responsabilidad metodológica del Análisis de Impacto al Negocio (BIA) y coordinar el relevamiento, mantenimiento y pruebas anuales del Plan de Recuperación ante Desastres (DRP).

• Ejecutar due diligence de riesgo sobre proveedores críticos — tecnológicos y no tecnológicos —, antes y durante la relación contractual.

• Coordinar evaluaciones periódicas de proveedores críticos, y mantener el registro de concentración y criticidad de terceros.

• Dar seguimiento a los planes de tratamiento de riesgos Alto/Crítico y a las medidas correctivas derivadas de hallazgos de auditoría e inspecciones regulatorias; registrar los eventos de pérdida operacional de origen tecnológico.

• Reportar periódicamente el perfil de riesgo tecnológico, de seguridad de la información y de terceros críticos a la Gerencia de RNF y a las instancias de gobierno vigentes (comités, Directorio).

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos asociados a la gestión y al gobierno de datos y a la adopción de inteligencia artificial, en procesos de negocio y de tecnología.

Buscamos Protagonistas Que Se Animen a

• Ejercer la segunda línea de defensa sobre el riesgo tecnológico integral de Personal Pay: tecnología, seguridad de la información, continuidad del negocio y proveedores críticos.

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos tecnológicos y de seguridad de la información, manteniendo actualizada la matriz de riesgos de TI/SI.

• Desafiar, con criterio técnico, el diseño y la efectividad de los controles de Tecnología y de Seguridad de la Información.

• Sostener el marco de continuidad del negocio (BIA/DRP) y coordinar sus pruebas anuales.

• Gestionar el riesgo de nuestros proveedores críticos — due diligence, notificaciones al BCRA, evaluaciones periódicas — en coordinación con Gobierno IT, Legales y Compras.

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos de gestión de datos y de la adopción de inteligencia artificial, agentes autónomos y automatización de procesos (RPA) en nuestros procesos de negocio y de tecnología.

• Reportar el perfil de riesgo tecnológico y de terceros a la Gerencia de RNF y a las instancias de gobierno (comités, Directorio).

Y Cuenten Con Estas Experiencias y Habilidades

• 5+ años de experiencia combinando riesgo tecnológico / seguridad de la información con gestión de riesgo de terceros, en entidades financieras, fintechs o proveedores de servicios de pago (PSP).

• Conocimiento de la Sección 10 de la RMGCTI (Com. “A” 8401) sobre tercerización, y de la normativa del BCRA aplicable a riesgo tecnológico y ciberseguridad (RMGCTI — Com. “A” 7724/8401/8398 — y RMRTSD — Com. “A” 7783).

• Conocimiento de marcos de gestión de riesgo TI/SI (ISO/IEC 27001/27002, COBIT, NIST o similares).

• Experiencia en continuidad de negocio (BIA/DRP) y en due diligence y gestión contractual de proveedores críticos.

• Experiencia trabajando con áreas Legales, Compras, Tecnología de la Información y Seguridad de la Información.

• Perfil de segunda línea: capacidad de desafiar con criterio técnico el diseño y la efectividad de controles ajenos.

• Conocimiento de riesgos vinculados a la gestión y gobierno de datos (calidad, privacidad, gobierno de datos) y a la adopción de inteligencia artificial, agentes autónomos y automatización de procesos (RPA) en entornos financieros o fintech.

• Deseable: formación en Sistemas, Ingeniería, o afines; certificaciones CISA, CISM, CRISC o similares.

¿Qué tenemos para ofrecerte?
🌏 Modalidades de trabajo flexible
🏆 Bono por performance
✈️ Una semana extra de vacaciones
📱 Descuentos y bonificaciones exclusivas en nuestras marcas Personal y Flow (internet, conectividad móvil y entretenimiento) para vos y tu familia
🏥 Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar a cargo
📕 Acceso libre a la plataforma digital de contenidos de aprendizaje
🎓Bonificaciones especiales en universidades de primer nivel
👫 Programa de referidos con reconocimiento económico
¡Y mucho más!
¡Súmate a la transformación digital más desafiante del país!

postings.title: Help Desktop Support
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Desktop Support to provide reliable and professional technical support to end users in a fast-paced corporate environment.

The role will primarily focus on Level 1 desktop and end-user support, covering hardware, operating systems, applications, connectivity, user access, and workplace technology. The position will support a mixed technology environment, including macOS and Windows devices, while working closely with Level 2 and specialist IT teams when required.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with a customer-focused approach, ensuring that users receive an efficient and professional IT support experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide Level 1 technical support through service desk, phone, email, chat, and in-person channels.

• Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, operating system, software, connectivity, peripheral, and user access issues across macOS and Windows environments.

• Configure, deploy, maintain, and replace laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.

• Support common business applications, including Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, browsers, VPN clients, and creative applications.

• Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN, basic network connectivity, authentication, MFA, and account-related issues.

• Manage incidents and service requests through the organization's ITSM / ticketing platform, documenting troubleshooting and resolutions accurately.

• Escalate more complex issues to Level 2 or specialist teams with appropriate diagnostic information.

• Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, equipment allocation, collection, and access-related requests.

• Assist with device management, software deployments, operating system updates, security policies, and IT asset management.

• Provide support for meeting rooms, video conferencing, presentation equipment, and other workplace technologies.

• Contribute to IT projects, hardware refreshes, technology rollouts, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Maintain a high level of customer service and ensure issues are handled professionally and within agreed service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

• Previous experience in IT support, desktop support, service desk, or a similar IT role.

• Good practical knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems and common desktop troubleshooting techniques.

• Experience supporting laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, monitors, docking stations, and other IT peripherals.

• Familiarity with common business applications, particularly Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools.

• Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN troubleshooting.

• Familiarity with user account, authentication, MFA, and access management.

• Experience working with an ITSM / ticketing system and understanding of incident and service request management.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

• Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and requests in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable Skills

• Experience with Apple device management or MDM platforms, such as Jamf Pro, Intune, Kandji, or Mosyle.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory and endpoint management.

• Experience supporting Adobe Creative Cloud or other professional/creative applications.

• Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and automated device enrollment.

• Experience supporting iPhone and iPad devices.

• ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL practices.

Personal Attributes

• Customer-focused, approachable, and service-oriented.

• Strong ownership and accountability when managing technical issues.

• Structured and methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical users.

• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with wider IT teams.

• Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to IT and security procedures.

Education & Certifications

• Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Apple, or Microsoft certifications are desirable.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

postings.title: Senior Manager, Engagement Delivery
postings.descriptionText:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Engagement Delivery Senior Manager collaborates with other leaders to ensure consistent delivery standard methodologies and influences the overall global engagement and delivery approach. They are responsible for meeting and exceeding business targets and providing leadership with accurate forecasts and metrics. They contribute to thought leadership and lead efforts to drive positive change, organizational initiatives, objectives and methods forward with executive-level engagement. They take ownership and personal responsibility for implementing change despite opposition or barriers and confidently make decisions in conditions of uncertainty. They are strong mentors who lead by example and embody the Salesforce values.

Engagement Delivery Sr. Manager (Program Management Sr. Manager), could join into a diverse team for the following industry verticals:

• Commercial and Enterprise (Manufacturing, Auto, Energy, Travel, Transportation, Hospitality, and Business Services).

• Communications, Media, and Technology.

• Financial Services including the Insurance industry.

• Healthcare and Life Sciences.

• Retail Consumer Goods.

• Public Sector, Non-profit, and Education.

Your Impact

• Lead programs by staying aligned on program scope, and release planning, as well as aligning one or more teams on vision, and business goals, creating the program structure, and securing cross-functional alignment.

• Drive teams through the Software engineering experience using Agile and demonstrated analytical and technical skills.

• Drive meetings with key team members for each program to help make key decisions, remove obstacles, and address key program issues. Be the key driver to ensure business goals are met and drive the strategic vision of each program.

• Develop strong partnerships with key functional team members to drive focus on business goals. Be a trusted partner for executive management to ensure program success.

• Partner with cross-functional teammates to drive workgroup alignment meetings to address tactical release issues, dependencies, team status, production issues, metrics review, etc. (cross-functional - Product Owners, Scrum Masters, TechOps, Release Eng, Capacity, Functional Managers, Release Management).

• Provide awareness of program status (issues, risks, metrics, etc.) on an ongoing basis through push status reporting.

• Handle "program/feature" dependencies across multiple teams, scrum teams, functions, divisions, and stakeholders.

• Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent teams from delivering on project goals.

• Provide monthly program reviews and updates at sprint reviews (give details into the current state of project goals, risks, and critical issues).

• Create a collaborative environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and learning.

• Operate as a catalyst within the organization to advance our Product & Technology strategy globally and drive team members across client organizations through change.

Minimum Requirements

• 15+ years of experience (with 5+ years leading multiple work streams) in a program management role leading enterprise-scale CRM (or similar) projects.

• 10+ years experience with management consulting or consulting services.

• SFDC experience is not required but parallel implementation experience is required.

• Demonstrated project leadership skills with direct responsibility for running project teams, budgeting, and scheduling against a customer or vendor contract.

• Lead internal and external project customers; conflict management, issues, executive communication, and leadership skills.

• Outstanding and effective communication skills; along with good executive presence. Verbal and written; ability to work with remote teams during non-traditional business hours.

• Ability to lead enterprise-wide engagements, facilitate meetings with client executives, mentor teams of senior team members, and proactively run project risk ability to weigh business and technical requirements to identify dependencies, produce project plans and estimates.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented environment.

• Ability to multi-task and perform effectively.

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and/or Information Technology or equivalent experience.

• Agile SCRUM Master Certification.

• PMP Certification preferred.

• Salesforce.com Certifications (Admin, Sales, Service, Marketing, etc.) preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bring strategic and tactical enterprise software project delivery experience to Salesforce clients.

• Provide senior-level consulting and counsel to client business and technology executives as a trusted advisor.

• Build strong executive-client relationships to enable them to persuade and influence the direction of the delivery and resolve key issues; lead client customer concerns and resolve through experience and relationship/trust-building.

• Align multi-cloud delivery standard methodologies, resourcing, team structure, knowledge, and assets.

• Oversight and mentorship of project leadership and practitioners.

• Support Delivery Assurance and the dissemination of Salesforce’s delivery standards and practices across programs.

• Coaching and training recommendations for Project Managers.

• Define and lead program governance (controls).

• Allocate and supervise the budget and resources.

• Align the organization or strategic direction that impacts the individual components and the overall program goals and objectives.

• Create and lead project plans; supervise and review project progress and timelines; adjust schedules and plans as needed, and identify and resolve issues to ensure project success.

• Ensure on-time and on-budget delivery of large-scale programs while also ensuring that program gates and governance are properly adhered to during the execution of the project.

• Track utilization of project resources against the prioritization and budget. This includes on-time entry and approvals for project timesheets.

• Run routine execution of project implementations. Assist with the planning, tracking, documentation, and status updates for the project.

• Lead scope changes and ensures the project is delivered on time and within budget.

• Able to run enterprise-level programs consisting of 50+ person teams with multiple delivery workstreams (3+) and sophisticated integrations requiring multi-functional collaboration and management

• Exercise solid program leadership skills combined with a good eye for business and in-depth analytical skills.

• Find opportunities to demonstrate all Salesforce technologies.

• Participate in end-to-end implementation planning including program management, issue management, communication, and organizational change.

• Leverage business knowledge and expertise to drive business process improvements.

• Have difficult conversations regarding budget, resources, and timeline and formally collect and communicate outcomes of those meetings.

• Accountable for all project aspects, reviewing those results prepared by the team prior to submission to the client.

• Identify, lead and mitigate program risk.

Possible travel of about 50%, but exact travel requirements will vary based on customer.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

postings.title: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
About EY

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

The Opportunity

Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.

The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.

This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.

Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.

The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Operations

• Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.

• Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.

• Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.

• Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.

• Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.

• Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.

Operational Excellence

• Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.

• Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.

En Cencosud, buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Gerente de Riesgos y Controles para el Centro de Servicios Compartidos (CSC), con base en Argentina y alcance sobre los procesos centralizados de la región.

Si tienes experiencia en control interno, auditoría, sólidos conocimientos de COSO/SOX y te motiva liderar el modelo de gobernanza operativa de un CSC regional este desafío es para ti 🚀

🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Diseñar, implementar y supervisar el marco de control interno y gobernanza operativa de los procesos del CSC de Cencosud, en coordinación con el área de Control Interno Regional, asegurando la integridad financiera, el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas y la gestión de riesgos de los procesos centralizados de todos los países donde opera el grupo.

🔍 Principales responsabilidades

🔹 Marco de Control y Riesgos

• Diseñar y mantener los controles de los procesos del CSC, en línea con el Modelo de Control Interno corporativo adaptado a la operativa del CSC.

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar riesgos operativos y financieros de los procesos centralizados, diseñando los controles para su mitigación.

• Documentar y mantener actualizadas las matrices de riesgos y controles (RCM) de los procesos del CSC (P2P, O2C, R2R, entre otros).

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de Segregación de Funciones (SoD) en los procesos del CSC y gestionar la remediación de conflictos conforme a la matriz corporativa.

• Velar por el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas y normativas locales e internacionales en la ejecución de los procesos del CSC.

🔹 Autoevaluación y Monitoreo de Controles

• Planificar y ejecutar periódicamente las autoevaluaciones de controles (CSA) del CSC, evaluando el diseño y la efectividad operativa de los controles.

• Definir, junto con los Service Delivery Owners, Planes de Acción Correctora (CAP) ante las deficiencias identificadas en las autoevaluaciones o en las pruebas de Control Interno Regional y/o Auditorias, y hacer seguimiento hasta su cierre.

• Impulsar la automatización de las autoevaluaciones y del monitoreo de controles mediante herramientas de análisis de datos.

🔹 Soporte a Auditorías y Cultura de Control

• Actuar como punto de contacto del CSC ante requerimientos de auditoría interna y externa, en coordinación con Control Interno regional y auditores internos y externos, facilitando evidencias e información.

• Asesorar a los Service Delivery Owners en el rediseño de procesos sin comprometer el control.

• Promover la cultura de riesgo, prevención de fraude y cumplimiento en el CSC

👀 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Formación en Contador Público, Administración de Empresas, Economía o carrera afín.
• 4 – 7 años de experiencia en Control Interno o Auditoría Interna/Externa en puestos de Liderazgo.
• Experiencia en Centros de Servicios Compartidos o procesos transaccionales centralizados.
• Dominio de COSO/SOX, SAP u Oracle, y herramientas de análisis de datos (ACL, Power BI, SQL).
• Inglés bilingüe (excluyente).
• Visión E2E de procesos, orientación a la ejecución y mejora continua, pensamiento analítico, comunicación asertiva y liderazgo de equipos.

💡 ¿Por qué este rol es único?

Porque el CSC de Cencosud está consolidando su modelo operativo y el control interno es una de sus piedras angulares. Tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar y monitorear los controles de procesos con alcance en 6 países, trabajando en coordinación con la Gerencia CSC, Control Interno Regional y equipos de Auditoria Corporativa.

Electrical QA/QC Specialist – BIM & VDC

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical Electrical QA/QC Lead to support our BIM/VDC team and ensure the quality, accuracy, and technical compliance of electrical deliverables for U.S.-based projects.

This is a technical QA/QC position. The primary focus will be reviewing electrical submittals, shop drawings, BIM content, and models to ensure they are accurate, coordinated, and aligned with project requirements and U.S. electrical standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Review electrical shop drawings, submittals, and technical documentation for accuracy and compliance.

• Review electrical BIM models and verify that model content is properly updated based on approved submittals.

• Review and validate Revit families and electrical BIM content for consistency and accuracy.

• Identify discrepancies, omissions, or technical issues between submittals, documentation, and BIM models.

• Ensure electrical deliverables align with applicable U.S. standards, codes, and NEC requirements .

• Perform quality control reviews of electrical BIM deliverables before final submission.

• Work closely with the BIM/VDC team to communicate QA/QC findings and required corrections.

• Use Revit and Navisworks as needed to inspect models, review model information, and identify coordination or quality issues.

• Maintain a consistent QA/QC process and help identify recurring quality issues within electrical deliverables.

• Independently manage assigned QA/QC tasks and meet established deadlines and quality standards.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a closely related field , or equivalent professional experience.

• Professional experience working with electrical systems and construction documentation .

• Previous experience with U.S.-based construction, engineering, or MEP projects .

• Strong knowledge of NEC and U.S. electrical standards/codes .

• Experience reviewing electrical shop drawings, submittals, and technical documentation .

• Strong understanding of electrical design and construction practices.

• Experience with BIM/VDC workflows and the relationship between electrical documentation, submittals, and BIM models.

• Ability to identify technical discrepancies and quality issues with a high level of attention to detail.

• Working knowledge of Revit (Plus)

• Basic to intermediate knowledge of Navisworks .

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience performing QA/QC for electrical BIM or VDC deliverables.

• Experience reviewing Revit electrical families and model content.

• Experience with electrical coordination and clash review.

• Experience working with U.S. contractors, engineers, architects, or MEP firms.

• Experience in commercial, industrial, or other technically complex construction projects.

What We're Looking For

Reporting directly to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Specialist will perform first level technical support services for all technology-based commercial services (customer facing solutions). This role will be responding directly to customers' support queries. The Technical Support Specialist will follow a standardized approach to understand the needs of the customer and recommend the proper utilization of the best solution or capability based on those needs. In handling of reported incidents, thorough symptom assessment will be employed to establish the root cause. Using a step-by-step process, this role will guide the customer through problem resolution and/or functional training as appropriate.

Responsibilities

• Ensuring service is provided in accordance with our client's Service Desk Operating Procedures and adheres to defined Service Level Agreements

• Actively seeking to understand the customer’s needs and/or the root cause of the current inbound request

• Acting as a customer advocate and seeking to take ownership of customer inbound requests through resolution

• Managing inbound requests from customers

• Resolving assigned customer inbound requests within established service levels and balancing workload

• Monitoring, balancing, and helping to resolve functional escalations from agents in partner locations

• Actively participating in the Customer Community of our client

• Continuously striving to become a subject matter expert in all customer facing applications and internal service desk tools and technologies

• Following established protocols to escalate appropriate requests to more advanced functions within the service model

• Providing after-hours support for priority incidents as needed

Requirements

• Two-year degree in a technical curriculum preferred

• 1+ years of experience with technical support or equivalent is required

• 1+ years of experience in a call center environment or equivalent is required

Desirable

• Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills

• Exceptional oral and written communication skills

• Solid teamwork qualities and ability to work effectively in a matrix environment

• Excellent technology problem-solving skills

• Experience in any of the following a plus:

• XML and Web Services solutions

• Database, SQL, JavaScript and HTML/CSS

What’s in it for you?
