• Flexibility: 100% remote work mode

• Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential

• Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients

• Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

postings.title: Product Manager 1
postings.descriptionText:
Policy, Risk and Control (PRC) Methodology Specialist

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

Furthermore, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team aims to establish policies and procedures that reflect the value we place on safeguarding our digital environment, while ensuring that these policies are effectively communicated and enforced across all levels of the organization. The PRC Methodology Program is part of the Global Information Security Policy & Methodology team within PRC Enablement & Awareness and supports the GRC program and its tooling by integrating and aligning the IT PRC Framework operating model to ensure that policies, standards, processes, risks, and controls remain consistent with the principles and data structure of the core GRC platform.

Your Key Responsibilities

The PRC Methodology Specialist will administer and enhance the IT PRC Framework, which underpins the Policy and Risk Management Programs through the structured integration of IT risk domains, risk categories, processes, control objectives, common controls, IS documents, and authoritative sources derived from industry standards, control frameworks, and regulatory mandates. The PRC Methodology Specialist will partner closely with the Global Methodology Program Lead to advance the Methodology Program's service offerings, strategy, goals, and objectives, including those related to IT Risk Management and associated methodologies. The Specialist will serve as a key contributor to the implementation, maintenance, and evolution of the PRC Framework operating model while facilitating its adoption and integration across relevant team and organizational projects, programs, and emerging initiatives.

A successful applicant will possess strong analytical judgement, be collaborative, and be an effective communicator with the ability to apply methodology expertise across complex risk and control environments. This role will partner with the Policy, Risk, Control, and Compliance teams, as well as global and cross-functional stakeholders, to identify, evaluate, and recommend innovative solutions and approaches that enhance the IT PRC Framework operating model and strengthen risk and control methodologies. The role will also require building and maintaining effective relationships with stakeholders across multiple organizational levels, including Information Security, Client and Enterprise Technology, Global and Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit, and Legal, to support the alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement of methodology-related initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert in IT risk management, governance, compliance, and control frameworks, leveraging practical experience and applied knowledge to promote consistency in the interpretation, application, and adoption of the IT PRC Framework and related methodologies.

• Lead the continuous improvement of the IT PRC Framework operating model through research into industry trends, emerging risks, and regulatory changes, and the integration of best practices into methodology enhancements.

• Identify and recommend process improvements, innovative practices, and operational efficiencies that enhance the effectiveness and scalability of the Methodology Program, while developing and maintaining related documentation, processes, procedures, and program artifacts throughout their lifecycles.

• Develop and refine cross-mappings of PRC common controls against Information Security policies and standards and applicable regulatory and industry requirements to establish a consistent mapping model, strengthen traceability and control coverage, and provide visibility into the organization’s security and compliance posture.

• Partner with Risk, Control, Compliance, and Assessment teams to support control gap assessments and methodology-related initiatives, strengthen control coverage, and drive alignment among risks, controls, and regulatory requirements.

• Support the integration, adoption, and effective use of GRC technologies and tools, including the Unified Compliance tool, to strengthen assessment activities, control alignment, and risk management processes.

• Help facilitate stakeholder engagement and cross-functional working sessions to influence methodology adoption, reinforce consistent risk and control practices, and advance strategic program objectives.

• Help promote a culture of risk awareness by supporting the Information Security & Awareness team’s risk-focused promotional campaigns and expanding organizational understanding of risk responsibilities and expectations.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Demonstrated knowledge of Information Security principles, IT risk management practices, and GRC methodologies and frameworks.

• Strong analytical judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

• Ability to build collaborative partnerships and work effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational levels.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to shifting demands, and perform effectively in ambiguous environments.

• Ability to leverage automation and technology solutions to improve efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance repeatable activities.

• Proven aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, tools, and methodologies.

To qualify for the role you must have

• 3 - 5 years of progressive experience in Information Technology, Information Security, Security Compliance, IT Audit, IT Risk Management, or related disciplines.

• Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Demonstrated knowledge of GRC principles and their application within technology, information security, and risk management environments, along with familiarity with Archer or comparable GRC platforms and tools.

• Working knowledge and practical experience with industry standards and control frameworks, including but not limited to ISO, NIST, COBIT, PCI DSS, and the Unified Compliance Framework, as well as regulatory requirements such as GDPR, DORA, CRA, and SOX.

• Experience applying risk and control concepts to evaluate control effectiveness, support methodology development, and recommend process or control improvements.

• Ability to interpret and apply regulatory, policy, control, and framework requirements within business and technology environments.

• Experience working effectively within global, cross-functional, and virtual teams.

• Strong English language skills, including excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Experience supporting methodology, governance, policy, or control framework initiatives.

• Experience working within highly regulated or compliance-driven environments.

• Experience in communicating to all levels of management, clients and vendors.

• Ability to appropriately balance internal functional needs with business impact and benefit.

• Experience developing and delivering executive-level presentations and briefings.

• Knowledge of policy governance activities, including the development, review, approval, publication, and lifecycle management of policies and standards.

• Skilled in Microsoft Office and M365 products; primarily Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, PowerApps, Power BI and Generative AI technologies.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

postings.title: OIC Region Inventory Specialist - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Lead Inventory Specialist Driving Inventory Excellence Through Strategic Planning and Supply Chain Optimization Do you enjoy driving operational efficiency through inventory management and supply chain excellence?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving customers in more than 120 countries. Our Supply Chain organization plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient flow of materials and products across our global operations. By leveraging advanced planning processes, inventory optimization strategies, and cross-functional collaboration, we enable operational excellence, improve asset utilization, and support business growth while delivering value to our customers.

Fuel your passion

The Lead Inventory Specialist is responsible for driving inventory optimization strategies that support business objectives while balancing customer requirements and operational efficiency. This role partners closely with supply chain, manufacturing, planning, and regional teams to ensure optimal inventory levels, reduce excess and aging inventory, improve inventory turns, and support business continuity through effective planning and execution.

As a Lead Inventory Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Monitoring inventory levels and ensuring weekly inventory fluctuations align with business requirements and operational targets

• Implementing inventory stocking strategies to optimize product availability while minimizing carrying costs

• Developing and executing methods and programs to maximize inventory utilization and operational efficiency

• Monitoring safety stock levels, global inventory, and aging inventory while partnering with regions and manufacturing plants to address risks and opportunities

• Providing updates on inventory projections and developing mitigation plans to address potential gaps or excess inventory

• Reviewing Slow Moving Inventory (SMI) with regional stakeholders and collaborating with cross-functional teams to minimize inventory-related risks

• Forecasting inventory reserves and creating action plans to mitigate inventory exposure

• Partnering with Demand Planning teams to develop and maintain effective net demand plans

• Collaborating with Supply Planning teams to implement stocking strategies for local suppliers and service providers

• Working with regional teams to support new product introductions and develop plans for managing replaced or obsolete inventory effectively

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have a Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Have a minimum of 5 years of experience in inventory management, supply chain operations, demand planning, or related disciplines

• Have experience in inventory optimization, order management, asset utilization, and inventory control processes

• Have strong knowledge of SAP systems and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) functionality

• Have the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple functions and regions

• Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Be able to balance strategic thinking with effective tactical execution while operating with a sense of urgency

• Have APICS, CPIM, CSCP, or similar supply chain certifications considered an advantage

postings.descriptionText:
En Pluspetrol potenciamos el desarrollo energético sostenible para el bienestar de las actuales y futuras generaciones.

Somos la empresa privada líder en producción de hidrocarburos de Latinoamérica y día a día buscamos alcanzar los objetivos de crecimiento y sostenibilidad con visión de largo plazo. Aplicamos creatividad y compromiso para afrontar las complejidades de nuestras operaciones.

Te invitamos a sumarte a nuestro equipo, estamos buscando un INGENIERO SR. DE RESERVORIOS .

Dentro del rol, serás el protagonista de desarrollar y ejecutar actividades de ingeniería de reservorios orientadas a maximizar el valor de los activos mediante la optimización de la producción, el monitoreo continuo del desempeño de pozos y reservorios, la generación de pronósticos de producción y la gestión de estudios técnicos que soporten la toma de decisiones operativas y estratégicas.

Los desafíos con los que te vas a encontrar serán:

• Liderar la estrategia de optimización de producción del activo maximizando valor bajo restricciones operativas, de facilidades y comerciales.

• Definir y monitorear estrategias de producción, incluyendo manejo de drawdown.

• Liderar el monitoreo continuo de la producción y el desempeño de pozos y reservorios mediante técnicas de surveillance y análisis de datos.

• Mantener, calibrar y asegurar el correcto funcionamiento de los modelos de Virtual Flow Metering (VFM).

• Elaborar forecasts de producción mensuales, ramp-ups diarios y escenarios de producción a demanda para soporte de decisiones operativas y económicas.

• Confeccionar y actualizar estimaciones de reservas y MAP de la base productiva.

• Participar en la elaboración y seguimiento del presupuesto de producción (BGT).

• Asegurar la calidad de los datos operativos mediante el seguimiento de KPIs asociados a mediciones físicas, controles de producción y sistemas de monitoreo.

• Evaluar la performance de pozos mediante análisis de datos de producción y técnicas de Rate Transient Analysis (RTA).

• Planificar, coordinar y ejecutar estudios técnicos definidos por áreas especialistas, incluyendo ensayos de interferencia, estudios PVT, muestreos geoquímicos y otras campañas de adquisición de datos.

• Generar análisis e informes técnicos que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora y maximizar el desempeño de los activos.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Graduados en la carrera de Ingeniería en petróleo / Química o carreras afines.

• Posgrado de Especialización en Ing. de Reservorios (deseable).

• Experiencia mínima de 10 años en Ingeniería de Reservorios, preferentemente en campos No Convencionales.

• Dominio Avanzado de Inglés.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Ofrecemos a nuestros colaboradores diferentes tipos de beneficios para cuidar de su bienestar físico, emocional y financiero. En nuestra propuesta incluimos:

+Valor

Plataforma de descuentos, reintegros por guardería y cuidadores, préstamos, seguro de vida adicional, obsequios por eventos especiales y nuestro programa de idiomas.

+Balance

Modalidad híbrida y flexibilidad en el horario de ingreso / egreso, vacaciones y licencias adicionales, licencias familiares extendidas y día de cumpleaños.

+Vitalidad

Gimnasio y planes de wellness on site.

Si crees que esta oportunidad es para vos, no dudes en aplicar.

postings.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Argentina & Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

Halter is heading to South America. Argentina and Uruguay are two of the most exciting cattle markets in the world, and we're starting from scratch: no customers, no pipeline and no local processes yet. That's exactly why this role matters.

As our first Revenue Operations Manager in region, you'll lay the foundations the whole market will grow on. That means working out how deals actually move from first conversation to installed customer, getting the market set up properly in Salesforce, and shaping local pricing and deal desk with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager. You'll also bring our first sales hires up to speed and build the reporting that tells us how the launch is going. Once things are up and running, the job shifts to keeping the market on plan and helping it grow.

You'll sit in our Revenue Operations & Enablement team, reporting into Auckland, with plenty of room to make your own calls. You'll quickly become someone senior leaders lean on, not just in sales and customer, but in finance, supply chain and right across the business

What your day could look like

As we get set up, your tasks may look different to when the market is fully established. Initially, it could look like…

• Working out how a deal will realistically move from first conversation to installed customer in Argentina and Uruguay, and ensure our globalised funnel stages and handover processes align with what is needed in region.

• Setting up the market in Salesforce with our Ecosystem team, including territories, currency, quoting and reports.

• Working with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager on local pricing and discount rules, taking currency and inflation into account

• Starting weekly pipeline reviews and forecast calls with the first sales hires, and agreeing what each stage means

• Training new sales team members on our tools and processes as they join

• Making sure launch and support are ready before the first customer signs, with our Customer Revenue Operations Manager

• Letting the team in New Zealand know what's different about this market and where our current approach needs to change

Then, once things are up and running your day could look like…

• Running pipeline reviews with sales leaders and checking deals and stages are accurate

• Looking into why conversion drops between stages and fixing the cause

• Building reports that give leadership a clear view of the market without them having to ask

• Supporting with the sales teams adoption of new tooling, or a feature that our Ecosystem team have just launched.

• Writing up what you've built so the next market launch has something to start from

• Feeding structured commercial intelligence back to HQ: what's working, what's not, what the market needs that our current playbook doesn't address

What we're looking for

Your background matters less than how you work. You might have come from sales or business operations, consulting or a customer-facing role, or been the person at a startup who kept everything running.

You may have built something from scratch before, whether that's a new market, team or function. You can move quickly without leaving a mess behind, and you set things up for scale, with the intention of giving these processes away when they are operationalised.

You care about data quality and the processes that drive it. In a new market, the habits set in the first few months are the ones we live with for years, so getting it right early matters to you. When something doesn't look right (whether it’s numbers or a customer experience), you look into it, find the root cause, resolve it, and reviewed that the fix actually worked.

People come to you for your opinion. You'll be a trusted partner to senior leaders across sales and customer, and well beyond them too, including finance, supply chain and other key parts of the business. You form a clear view, back it up with data, and help people make better decisions.

You're comfortable working autonomously, a long way from the rest of the team. Auckland is many hours ahead, so you'll sometimes need to make calls on your own from first principles.

You communicate clearly in Spanish and English with everyone from Territory Managers on farm to our Vice President of Sales, and you're happy to be direct.

You'll crush this role if you

• Enjoy starting from nothing. There's no funnel, data or habits yet, and you find that exciting

• Set things up to scale. What you build should work at 10 customers and at 10,000

• Hold people to the plan. You'll push back when execution drifts from it

• Spot where revenue is slipping before it shows up clearly in the data

• Get good habits in early. It's much easier than fixing bad ones later

• Share what you're learning. You give the team in New Zealand clear, useful insight about the market

• Write things down. You document as you go so others can reuse your work

• Already use AI day to day and keep looking for new ways it can help

• Can influence people you don't manage. A lot of what you need sits with other teams, so you get things done through relationships and good insight

Bonus points if

• You've launched a new market, region or business unit for a scaling company

• You've worked in agriculture, ag-tech, SaaS, or hardware-led businesses where the sales motion is complex

• You've operated in a multi-market or remote-from-headquarters setup before

• You've worked with pricing or deal approvals in a high-inflation or multi-currency environment

Our Benefits

• Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

• Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

• We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

• Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

• Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

• Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Senior Operations Manager
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US :
Tire Capital is an investment firm driving innovation in the $60B U.S. replacement tire market through technology and disruptive business models. Since 2020, Tire Capital has built and acquired a portfolio of tire-focused e-commerce, trading, and wholesale businesses and is now entering a phase of rapid expansion. The leadership team brings deep operational and technical expertise from hedge funds, consulting, private equity, and healthcare, with a shared commitment to building agile, tech-forward platforms that outperform traditional private equity models.
One of our core portfolio companies, Tires Easy , is a scaled e-commerce platform focused on the replacement tire market, with deep capabilities across tire sourcing, pricing, logistics, and fulfillment. Building on this foundation, we launched Garage Hub , a new subsidiary focused on the auto parts aftermarket, designed to leverage Tires Easy's infrastructure and ecosystem expertise while building a dedicated platform for rapid supplier onboarding and category expansion.
Together, Tires Easy and Garage Hub represent a diversified and growing automotive aftermarket platform, operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong emphasis on operational excellence, accountability, and disciplined growth. We are building a team capable of owning results, scaling complex businesses, and driving execution across a multi-entity platform.

SUMMARY :
Reporting to the Managing Director, the Senior Operations Manager owns the end-to-end order fulfillment experience for Garage Hub — from the moment an order is transmitted to a supplier through delivery at the customer's door — and is responsible for managing the supplier performance and order execution that sit behind it.
Beyond running the day-to-day, this person will take on special projects and cross-functional strategic initiatives alongside the Managing Director, moving the organization from reactive problem-solving to proactive risk management and identifying where automation and AI can remove manual work. Garage Hub is scaling quickly, and much of the job is making sure nothing breaks as it does.
This role manages one Operations Clerk today, with a clear trajectory to help build out the team as volume scales, and works closely with the Managing Director, COO, and President.
The right person will be a self-starter with a bias for action, ready to roll up their sleeves on cross-functional projects while also comfortable managing people, and will have a track record for building new processes from the ground up and getting things done.
The culture is startup-paced and intellectually honest. We work hard, we debate ideas at the whiteboard and make decisions the same day. If you want a slow-moving environment with lots of process, this isn't it. If you want to build something real, fast, with people who are just as bought in as you are — this is exactly it.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

• Owns the health of order transmission to suppliers and manages supplier performance, driving accountability for on-time processing and shipping against goals, with clear improvements of key cancellation and late order KPIs.

• Owns the daily cancellation process and the levers behind it, driving the rate down against goal.

• Owns late-order performance against our channel partners' standard, and can tell a real improvement from one with manual workarounds.

• Owns the returns-to-supplier workflow (RMA retrieval and tracking), coordinating with the Operations Clerk and the Returns Center Manager on the physical handoff.

• Owns the operational preconditions that make a claim recoverable working with Finance.

• Owns warehouse onboarding process execution — turning the current ad hoc handoffs into a defined, gated process with clear ownership at each step, so no location sits idle while each party believes it is waiting on someone else.

• Runs the operating cadence: the weekly warehouse performance review, the reporting behind it, and the follow-through between meetings.

• Manages the Operations Clerk, with the mandate to help grow the team as the function scales.

• Leads special projects and cross-functional strategic initiatives alongside the Managing Director and other leaders.

• Leads process optimization and automation, partnering with technical teams to apply AI and systems-based solutions that cut manual work and cycle times — including piloting agents against the highest-volume manual work and measuring what they actually save.

• Identifies structural and process inefficiencies across the fulfillment organization, developing and implementing targeted improvement initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Proactively identifies points of potential failure across the order lifecycle and puts safeguards in place before issues occur.

• Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS :

• Must be able to work until 2:00 PM PT

• Full professional fluency in written and spoken English

• 4-6 years of operations management experience, including some experience managing people or functions

• Experience owning supplier, logistics/carrier, or fulfillment relationships is strongly preferred

• A demonstrated track record of building or improving processes and SOPs, ideally in a fast-growing or startup environment — this person should be genuinely crafty about finding ways to make things more efficient and automated, not just execute an existing playbook

• Self-driven, comfortable in dynamic, fast-growing environments and able to implement solutions independently (start-up experience preferred)

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to anticipate issues before they surface

• Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making, and the discipline to trust a number only once you understand how it was produced

• Business acumen with the ability to relate financial and operational data to decisions

• Comfortable using AI tools as part of the job, not just aware of them

• Excellent communication skills to facilitate collaboration across teams

• Proficient in Google Suite products and data processing/reporting tools

• Bachelor's degree required

TRAVEL :

• Limited to no travel will be required for this position.

postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Operations Intern , you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do

• Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.

• Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For

• Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working At Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Chargeback Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

postings.descriptionText:
Queue Lead

Start date: TBC

End Date: TBC

Location: Remote

Type of contract: Freelance

Languages required: English

Hourly Rate: Include the rate you are comfortable with on your CV.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role

We are seeking a Queue Lead to join a high-priority initiative in partnership with a leading AI company. This is an operational, hands-on role, you will own day-to-day execution for one or more annotation queues on a live AI training/eval program: managing throughput, running quality calibrations, tracking contributor performance, and building out reporting systems that keep stakeholders informed in real time.

You will have experience running queues and quality on AI data programs. The selected candidate will be able to speak to specific projects, calibration processes they've built, and contributor performance systems they've run.

What you'll be doing

Queue Operations & Task Management

• Own work queues: intake, triage, prioritization, task assignment, and SLA delivery

• Monitor task queue and backlog control

• Identify and troubleshoot bottlenecks (unclear policy, tooling issues, supply gaps)

Quality Assurance & Performance Management

• Monitor quality at project and individual annotator or contributor level.

• Perform QA tasks such as making corrections, providing annotator feedback, flagging systematic confusion and suggestions to team lead.

• Manage annotator or contributor performance by performing tasks like unassigning underperformers, identifying and retaining high-performers.

Reporting & Dashboards

• Build and maintain dashboards to track throughput, disagreement rates, defect or rework rates, and contributor performance.

• Turn raw queue data into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders.

• Provide feedback for process improvements based on data trends.

Training & Support

• Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering participant questions, providing support, and escalating complex issues to the Client Delivery Lead.

• Train new annotators or contributors on project guidelines.

• Conduct live or recorded webinars as new participants join projects.

• Host "office hours" for participants.

• Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering questions, providing support, escalating complex issues to Client Delivery Lead.

What you'll bring

• Proven, direct experience running queues and quality on AI data programs, ideally at a competitor.

• 3+ years in high-throughput ops (data labeling, trust & safety, BPO, content ops, CX ops), with recent, specific AI data ops experience

• Able to identify shallow, low-effort, AI-generated, or phoned-in responses.

• Proven ability to design and run calibration processes from scratch.

• Ability to track record by building or maintaining dashboards or reporting systems (spreadsheets is required, SQL/BI/Looker/Tableau a strong plus)

• Experience managing contributor performance at scale including making retention or removal decisions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities on live programs.

What "good" looks like for us:

• Scale up to running a full AI end-to-end data program, owning pipeline, throughput, calibration, and contributor performance at program level.

• Operates as an AI training consultant, you are comfortable advising on processes and methodology.

Bonus

• Experience with ML data or LLM eval workflows (ranking, rubric-based judging, gold sets, calibration)

• Distributed team coordination across time zones; vendor or contract workforce experience

• Consulting-style experience of advising clients on AI training methodology.

Success looks like

Predictable SLA delivery, a stable backlog, improving quality and reducing rework, and proactive dashboards reporting that give stakeholders real-time visibility.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

About the role
Zenit Corp is an ecommerce group operating print-on-demand businesses. We are hiring an Operations Manager to take responsibility for day-to-day execution, lead the operational team and improve how work moves through the business.

Your mission is to turn the CEO’s objectives into clear plans and completed results. You will work directly with the CEO, agree on priorities and decision-making boundaries, and take ownership of execution within them. This is a hands-on role: you will lead people, resolve problems and personally move work forward when needed.

What you will ownExecution planning and team leadership

• Build execution plans from business objectives, with owners, deadlines, dependencies and expected outcomes.

• Set priorities across the team, delegate clearly and follow through until commitments are completed. Adjust plans when circumstances change.

• Give direction and feedback, remove blockers and address gaps in execution rather than allowing work to stall.

• Help recruit and onboard operational team members, clarify responsibilities and make sure they understand the processes they will use.

Order flow and provider coordination

• Coordinate customer support, illustration and design, production, fulfillment and external providers across the order journey.

• Make sure each handoff has the information, owner and next step needed to keep orders moving and resolve customer issues.

• Own the resolution of provider delays and quality issues, agree on corrective actions and verify that the problem is resolved.

Processes and operational improvement

• Review existing SOPs and operating guides, identify unclear or inefficient steps, and update documentation as workflows change.

• Investigate recurring errors and bottlenecks, implement practical improvements and verify that the team adopts them.

• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate repetitive work, including appropriate uses of AI. Check accuracy and reliability before making changes part of the process.

Performance, quality and risk

• Define useful indicators for the areas you oversee and use them to review execution quality and progress against agreed objectives.

• Detect risks, delays and capacity constraints early, decide what needs attention first and track corrective actions to completion.

• Give the CEO a concise view of progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate issues outside your authority with context and a recommendation.

What success looks like

• Priorities move from objectives to completed deliverables, with clear ownership and fewer unresolved dependencies.

• Recurring operational problems lead to lasting process improvements, rather than the same issue being addressed repeatedly.

• The CEO stays informed and can focus on business priorities without having to manage daily follow-up.

Required experience and skills

• Experience owning a comparable operation end to end and leading a team across multiple functions.

• Examples of plans you created, decisions you made and operational problems you resolved, with evidence of the results.

• Practical experience using operational data, improving processes and holding people accountable for commitments.

• Sound judgment when priorities compete, clear communication and willingness to combine management with detailed execution.

• Operational English at B2 level or above for suppliers, tools and documentation.

Valuable additional experience

• Ecommerce or print-on-demand operations. We also consider other sectors where responsibility and operational complexity are comparable.

• Using automation or AI tools to improve operational workflows.

• Spanish communication skills. Our team works primarily in Spanish, so Spanish is preferred; we also consider candidates who work in English.

Up to $40,000 annually
USD 2,500 fixed per month, plus an annual bonus of up to USD 10,000, conditional on meeting objectives. Maximum annual compensation is USD 40,000 if the full bonus is earned.

postings.title: Delivery Partner Manager, Account Manager, MEU Delivery Partner Management
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Our last-mile delivery partners are crucial to our service, and we work closely with them to make sure deliveries large and small get to where they need to be. As a Senior Delivery Partner Manager, you’ll make sure we have the best relationship possible with our partners. You’ll build connections, help them put processes in place for efficient delivery, and smooth out any issues they experience, all with the aim of creating a partnership that’s successful for many years.

Key job responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of customer accounts by analyzing performance data and key performance indicators, segmenting and prioritizing accounts, and developing plans with clear, measurable success criteria that align with shared goals.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders—both internal and external—by understanding their priorities, aligning on strategies, and providing tailored recommendations that improve the account and customer experience.

• Audit, monitor, and review business performance across your accounts, proactively identifying risks and opportunities while adjusting project plans to keep outcomes on track.

• Educate accounts on available tools, processes, and resources, and leverage generative artificial intelligence and other technologies to augment productivity and the quality of your insights.

• Collaborate with partner teams to clear blockers, drive timely decisions, and suggest process improvements that strengthen operational excellence across the organization.

A day in the life

You’ll be based at one of our sites. Being on site allows you to stay close to every part of the delivery process and means you have visibility of everything to guide our logistics partners. You’ll look after all elements of our partner relationships, from getting the contracts in place to keeping track of performance.

This role requires regular travel (minimum once per week) across your portfolio of delivery stations, primarily by train and rental car, with all travel expenses fully reimbursed.

About The Team

We belong to the international DSP Team and as Delivery Partner Managers own the relationship with our Delivery Service Providers in MEU (DE/AT/NL). We operate in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where every team member contributes ideas that shape how we serve our customers. As we continue to expand, we are focused on raising the bar for the account experience and building scalable practices that benefit customers across our portfolio. If you are excited about making a tangible difference for businesses while growing your own career at Amazon, we would love to hear from you.

By creating bearings and solutions for everything from industrial applications to vehicles, SKF plays an essential role in our everyday lives. In Q4 2026, SKF intends to spin off its Automotive business and list it as a separate company under the name of SKF Vertevo. A company created to support the future of the automotive market, and to co-drive the future of mobility faster.

This role will be a part of that new company. Would you like to join us, and move people further?

Digital Service Manager SAP GTS - SKF Automotive Business

Are you ready to shape the future of digital customs, trade compliance, and global trade operations?

At DSM Logistics & Customs Management, you will have the opportunity to help a global organization strengthen its customs and trade compliance processes using modern digital solutions. In this role, you will work with SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS) to ensure compliant, efficient, and automated cross-border trade operations.

You will contribute to building and maintaining an integrated landscape where customs processes, trade compliance, logistics, and ERP systems work seamlessly together, providing transparency, speed, and accuracy to global flows of goods. You will collaborate with global business teams, customs specialists, IT partners, and external authorities to drive initiatives that improve compliance reliability, reduce manual work, and enhance digital capabilities across the supply chain.

We are looking for someone with hands-on experience from an in-house IT organization, ideally gained as a Service Owner or IT Application Owner responsible for cross-functional solutions and global stakeholders.

If you want to influence decisions, take ownership, and support the future of customs and trade compliance in a dynamic organization, this role is for you.

What you can expect in the role
Solution Ownership

• Own SAP GTS across customs, compliance, risk, and preference processes.

• Ensure system stability, data accuracy, and effective lifecycle management, including upgrades and enhancements.

System Architecture & Integration

• Support the integrated architecture across SAP GTS, SAP S/4HANA, logistics systems, and customs authority interfaces.

• Oversee EDI, API, customs messaging, and connections to satellite applications, including Preferential Origin tools.

Customs & Trade Compliance Enablement

• Enable HS classification, preferential origin, embargo screening, and import/export processes through effective system configuration.

• Work with customs and business teams to optimize master data, compliance rules, and end-to-end trade processes.

Data & Digital Roadmap

• Drive the digital roadmap for customs automation, data governance, standardization, and regulatory readiness.

Project & Budget Leadership

• Lead GTS implementation, enhancement, and integration projects with global IT teams, business experts, consultants, and customs authorities.

• Plan and follow up budgets for GTS and customs digitalization activities.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. You will collaborate broadly across teams, but the position does not include direct personnel leadership.

You will enjoy working here if you have:

• Hands-on experience from an in-house IT organization, ideally as a Service Owner or IT Application Owner managing cross-functional solutions and global stakeholders.

• A relevant academic background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.

• Proven experience working with SAP Global Trade Services (SAP GTS) in global or regional environments.

• Strong understanding of customs management, trade compliance, HS classification, embargo checks, and preferential origin processes.

• Knowledge of integration between SAP GTS and SAP S/4HANA for master data, logistics, and document flows.

• Experience managing or supporting electronic customs declaration processes and external interface messaging.

• Solid understanding of process design, integration flows, and regulatory requirements.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy and compliance details.

• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

If you want to go further
This position will be located on a major SKF site in Tudela (Spain), Puebla (Mexico), Cajamar (Brazil), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Lima (Peru), Montevideo (Uruguay), or Bogota (Colombia).

You will report to Alan Pereira Reis, SCM Team Lead, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

Apply with your CV in English throughout the system, no later than November 1th 2026 . We will screen candidates continuously, so make sure to submit your application as soon as possible.

If you want to know more about SKF Automotive business, please visit our webpage. SKF Automotive: Bearings & aftermarket solutions since 1907

Transparency and fairness matter to us
At SKF, we see diversity in our workforce as an asset that supports better business results. We are committed to having a fair and inclusive recruitment process where all hiring decisions are based on objective, job-related criteria, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

To support a fair and transparent recruitment process, the process may include assessments, and before hiring, we may also carry out background checks and verify application information. We will discuss your salary expectations during the first interview, and our final offer will be based on an objective evaluation of your experience, skills, and potential, aligned with the scope of the role and our internal salary guidelines. Our recruitment process may differ from country to country and will always be in line with applicable country-specific laws and regulations.

Working with other LST team members across all three global hubs, including:

Offer of employment with American Express is conditional upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

postings.title: Jr. Plant Layout Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como Jr. Plant Layout Designer, vas a brindar soporte técnico al área de Layout de Planta, colaborando en la actualización de modelos 3D, preparación de documentación y asistencia en tareas de integración de disciplinas para el proyecto ACR300. El puesto está orientado a tu formación dentro del diseño de implantación de planta, modelado 3D y revisión espacial.
Este rol es ideal para arrancar tu carrera en un proyecto de gran escala donde el layout define cómo conviven las disciplinas en la planta. Vas a aprender con herramientas digitales de modelado, integración multidisciplinaria y verificación de interferencias.
Este puesto es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y quiere ser parte de un proyecto que electrifica a escala.

• Disfruta del modelado 3D, del trabajo con herramientas digitales y de la integración entre disciplinas.

• Tiene atención al detalle, orden documental y orientación al cumplimiento de plazos.

• Quiere aprender de equipos con experiencia profunda en diseño de plantas industriales.

Qué Harás
Soporte a Modelado y Documentación de Layout

• Asistir en la preparación y actualización de modelos y documentación del área de Layout.

• Diseñar, modelar y preparar documentación asociada a revisiones de layout e integración de modelos.

• Dar soporte a la organización documental del área.

Detección y Seguimiento de Interferencias

• Utilizar herramientas digitales para la revisión de modelos y la detección de interferencias físicas y funcionales.

• Colaborar en el registro, seguimiento y actualización del estado de las interferencias.

Verificación Espacial y Funcional

• Colaborar en la verificación básica de accesos, espacios libres, rutas de circulación, áreas de mantenimiento y zonas de operación, conforme a los criterios definidos por los especialistas del área.

Apoyo a Revisiones de Modelo

• Apoyar la preparación de vistas, capturas, reportes gráficos, mark-ups y listados de observaciones para reuniones de coordinación interdisciplinaria y revisiones de modelo.

Qué Buscamos
Aprendizaje y Rigurosidad Técnica

• Atención al detalle en el modelado 3D y en el seguimiento de interferencias.

• Compromiso con la trazabilidad documental y con la calidad de los entregables.

Iniciativa y Responsabilidad

• Capacidad para asumir tareas asignadas con orden, autonomía progresiva y foco en resultados.

• Capacidad para identificar interferencias, elevar consultas y documentar avances.

Trabajo en Equipo y Comunicación Intersectorial

• Capacidad de interactuar con Engineering (mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation y piping), Nuclear, Safety, Licensing y Planning.

• Perseverancia, disposición al cambio y flexibilidad.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte
Si estás listo/a para sumarte a nuestro equipo, enviá tu CV a hiring@meitner.energy con el nombre del rol en el asunto.

Redtree Engineering, part of CSI's global network, specializes in engineering, project management, and construction support services for power systems, industrial facilities, mission-critical infrastructure, and complex energy projects.

We are seeking a Junior Instrumentation & Control Engineer to join our Electrical Engineering team and contribute to industrial, energy, and process projects. This role offers the opportunity to learn alongside experienced engineers, develop hands-on technical skills, and build a career in automation and control systems.

Position Overview

As a Junior Instrumentation & Control Engineer, you will support the technical development and execution of instrumentation and control deliverables across industrial and energy projects. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, you will contribute to design documentation while progressively taking on greater technical responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and update instrument datasheets.

• Contribute to the development of P&IDs, loop diagrams, and control architectures.

• Support the selection and specification of field instruments.

• Collaborate on the design of PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems.

• Participate in technical reviews with clients and vendors.

• Perform technical follow-up of supplies and engineering documentation.

Required Qualifications

• Advanced student or graduate in Electronic, Automation, Instrumentation & Control, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• 0–3 years of experience in industrial, energy, oil & gas, chemical, or manufacturing projects (internships and early professional experience count).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Proactive, service-oriented, and organized, with a strong interest in teamwork and learning new tools.

Preferred Qualifications

We highly value candidates with exposure to:

• Fundamentals of industrial instrumentation: pressure, temperature, flow, and level.

• Interpretation of P&IDs and electrical diagrams.

• Fundamentals of PLC, DCS, and SCADA.

• Industrial networks and communication protocols.

• Basic knowledge of IEC 61131, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus, or Ethernet/IP (desirable).

• AutoCAD Electrical and Microsoft Office.

• Genuine interest in learning about complex projects and developing new technical competencies.

What We Offer

• Mentorship from leading professionals and access to modern engineering tools.

• Participation in international projects for top-tier clients under global standards.

• A collaborative culture within multidisciplinary teams that value innovation and technical excellence.

• Exposure to projects across power generation, industrial infrastructure, and process facilities.

• Flexible and hybrid work opportunities, depending on project requirements.

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience and qualifications.

Join Our Team

If you are starting your career in instrumentation and control engineering and want to develop your technical skills on projects that shape the future of energy and industry, we would love to hear from you.

postings.title: Food Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About The Team

We are a small, hardworking, dynamic, and purpose-driven team focused on improving the way CookUnity creates and produces food. Our work centers on reducing environmental impact through real, operational initiatives: lowering food waste across all markets, strengthening responsible sourcing, elevating ingredient quality and nutrient value in our meals, and advancing lower-impact packaging solutions.

We partner closely with Culinary Ops, Chef Success, Supply chain to turn these commitments into daily practice, building cleaner standards, improving processes, and scaling innovations that make our meals better for people and for the planet.

The Role

We are looking for a recent Food Engineering graduate (or equivalent degree in Food Science or Technology) to join our team. The ideal candidate is organized, respectful, collaborative, analytical, and critical-thinking , with the potential to take leadership in research-oriented projects . They should be eager to learn, capable of structured analysis, and able to translate research findings into practical applications within our operations.

This role does not require prior field experience but demands a methodical and team-oriented mindset , curiosity for continuous improvement, and the ability to contribute ideas while following structured workflows.

Responsibilities

• Actively work on the Food Science Lab Project (Ingredients Integrity + Nutrients Optimization) by researching, studying and analyzing every step of CookUnity’s food production process, from ingredients till meals are consumed by customers.

• Understand and evaluate how meals are produced, identifying opportunities to improve nutritional value and overall ingredient performance.

• Participate in the Ingredients Integrity program by evaluating ingredient quality, formulations, storage practices, and kitchen usage, while collecting and organizing data to strengthen standards, improve sourcing decisions, and support nutrient-forward upgrades.

• Gain in-depth knowledge of food additives, their functions in the industry, and their regulatory restrictions in different applications.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Chefs, Sourcing, Cullinary Ops and Nutrition) to ensure ingredient quality, safety, and consistency.

• Maintain clear, organized documentation and reports to support research and innovation projects.

• Contribute to the development of clean, high-standard recipes aligned with CookUnity’s mission to deliver better, healthier meals.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Engineering, Food Science, or a related field.

• Fluent English (written and spoken).

• Strong organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills. Strong data collection, communication, and problem-solving skills required

• Have the ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment - skilled at planning, organizing, prioritizing, and executing multiple projects and activities simultaneously.

• Experience and a high level of expertise in data entry, a food production enterprise resource or recipe management software, food labeling and compliance programs, GSuite, and Slack.

• Team player with a proactive, respectful, and detail-oriented attitude.

• Interest in food innovation, ingredient quality, and applied research.

• Optimistic, resourceful, and ready to take on any challenges

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.
